entries.zh: 赞。
entries.en: Fantastic.

entries.zh: 前邪教徒旗舰
entries.en: Former Cult Flagship

entries.zh: 小行星电波
entries.en: Asteroid Waves

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]小行星正在发射受控脉冲辐射。是不是有什么人，还是说有什么东西，想要和我们交谈？
entries.en: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?

entries.zh: 残骸场
entries.en: Debris Field

entries.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
entries.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 丰饶的星球
entries.en: A Lush Planet

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的颜色格外碧绿，初步扫描表明其表面可能存在一些有趣的物品。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] is exceptionally green, and preliminary scans indicate that there might be several articles of interest on the surface.

entries.zh: 碑塔
entries.en: Monoliths

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]表面散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
entries.en: Impressive structures litter [Root.GetName]'s surface, practically begging for some archaeological work.

entries.zh: 熔融
entries.en: Melting

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]剧热的表面传来了微弱的求救信号。
entries.en: A weak distress signal originates from the superheated surface of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 令人玩味的遗迹
entries.en: Playful Ruins

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]表面一小块地方散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
entries.en: Impressive structures litter a small area on the surface of [Root.GetName], practically begging for some archaeological work.

entries.zh: 被雕琢的小行星
entries.en: An Asteroid, Carved

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]被部分掏空，并且进行了精致细密的雕琢。岩石上的纹路有些眼熟……
entries.en: [Root.GetName] has been partially hollowed out and carved with exquisite precision. There is something familiar about the lines and curves etched into the rock...

entries.zh: 深夜天籁
entries.en: What Hums in the Night

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上有不同寻常的声波活动。
entries.en: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 冰冻冰巨星
entries.en: Ice Ice Giant

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]缺乏氢和氦，无法被归为气态巨行星，而是冰冻巨行星。
entries.en: It seems [Root.GetName] is lacking the hydrogen and helium to be classified as a proper gas giant and is, in fact, an ice giant.

entries.zh: 辐射小行星
entries.en: Radiating Asteroid

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]周期性地向太空发射出骇人的粒子辐射混合体。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] periodically spews an alarmingly eclectic mix of particles and radiation into the void.

entries.zh: 斑斓毒星
entries.en: Pigment Poison

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]充满毒性的生物环境赋予这颗行星一片独特的景貌。
entries.en: [Root.GetName]'s toxic biosphere gives the planet a unique color scheme.

entries.zh: 冰冻荒原
entries.en: Cold Wastes

entries.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]冰冻表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
entries.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s frozen surface.

entries.zh: 冰雪平原
entries.en: Icy Plains

entries.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]极地表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
entries.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s arctic surface.

entries.zh: 疾行
entries.en: Scurrying

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]茂密的热带丛林灌木中检测到了不规则的运动模式。
entries.en: Irregular patterns of movement have been detected within the dense tropical undergrowth of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 荒芜平原
entries.en: On the Barren Plains

entries.zh: 粗略扫描显示，行星表面有一个不断向茫茫太空发射的脉冲信号。
entries.en: A cursory scan of the planet's surface reveals a weak signal pulsing into the darkness of space.

entries.zh: 奇异无比
entries.en: Projecting

entries.zh: 根据初步扫描，[Root.GetName]有一些奇怪的特性，它的读数与我们对此类行星的预估相去甚远……
entries.en: According to preliminary scans, [Root.GetName] is exhibiting several strange properties and gives readings that are not at all in line with what one would expect from a planet of this type...

entries.zh: 变幻莫测
entries.en: Kaleidoscopic

entries.zh: 一个模糊的身影在[Root.GetName]的大海洋流之下翻腾着。
entries.en: Vaguely-defined shapes swirl with the currents in [Root.GetName]'s vast oceans.

entries.zh: 剧热律动
entries.en: Heated Rhythm

entries.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]剧热的表面扫描出有节奏的运动。
entries.en: Sensors pick up rhythmic movement on the hellish surface of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 蒸汽翻腾
entries.en: Steamrolled

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]似乎有且只有一个有趣的地质特征……
entries.en: [Root.GetName] seems to exhibit one, and only one, interesting geological feature...

entries.zh: 维度扰动
entries.en: Dimensional Disturbance

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]所在的残骸场在某种未知力量的影响下翻滚。
entries.en: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.

entries.zh: 点点绿意
entries.en: Spotty Greenery

entries.zh: 光学扫描显示，[Root.GetName]表面有几处不同寻常的翠绿。
entries.en: Optical scans indicate that the surface of [Root.GetName] is unusually verdant in places.

entries.zh: 金属闪烁
entries.en: A Glint of Metal

entries.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示行星地壳中存在珍贵物质。
entries.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances in the planet's crust.

entries.zh: 大气异常现象
entries.en: Atmospheric Anomaly

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]大气的实际读数与模拟数值不同。
entries.en: Atmospheric readings from [Root.GetName] do not match simulated projections.

entries.zh: 瞬息万变
entries.en: Winking

entries.zh: 对[Root.GetName]表面进行的反复扫描给出的读数都不一致，似乎行星本身就在不停发生剧变。
entries.en: Repeated scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface give inconsistent sensor readings, almost as if the planet itself was in a constant state of upheaval.

entries.zh: 冰雪发光
entries.en: Ice Lit

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]表面到处都是无法解释的光学现象，从太空中清晰可见。
entries.en: Inexplicable optical phenomena play across the surface of [Root.GetName], clearly visible from space.

entries.zh: 云舞
entries.en: Clouds Dance

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气特征在中等规模的气态巨行星中很不寻常。
entries.en: The atmospheric patterns of [Root.GetName] are highly atypical for a gas giant of modest size.

entries.zh: 似是天堂
entries.en: Paradise Anticipated

entries.zh: 这是一颗盖亚级行星，[Root.GetName]预计会有丰富的生命体……
entries.en: As a Gaia-class planet, [Root.GetName] is expected to teem with life...

entries.zh: 暗藏玄机
entries.en: Something Smells

entries.zh: 扫描显示在§H[Root.GetName]§!众多冰封的山巅之上存在异乎寻常的外星造物。
entries.en: Scans indicate the presence of a foreign, alien-made object on one of §H[Root.GetName]'s§! many frozen mountain tops.

entries.zh: 行星伤痕
entries.en: Planetary Scars

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的表面似乎布满凹痕，也并非不寻常。\n\n不寻常的是这些伤痕的形状，无规律的分布。不太可能是陨石撞击的结果。
entries.en: [Root.GetName]'s surface appears heavily pockmarked, which is not unusual.\n\nWhat is unusual is the regular shape of the scars, irregularly distributed. This is unlikely to be the result of meteorite impacts.

entries.zh: 尘暴区
entries.en: Dustbowl

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上有一系列撞击坑。但在其中较大的一个坑里，有什么东西带来了视觉上的不一致感……
entries.en: [Root.GetName] is home to a number of exquisite impact craters. However, something breaks the visual uniformity in one of the larger craters...

entries.zh: 俯瞰
entries.en: Looking Down

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]荒芜的表面上，光学传感器发现了一些可能是建筑的东西。
entries.en: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.

entries.zh: 剧毒外表
entries.en: Poison-coated

entries.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示[Root.GetName]的剧毒大气之下存在珍贵物质。
entries.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances beneath [Root.GetName]'s noxious clouds.

entries.zh: 矿群
entries.en: Mineral Cluster

entries.zh: 一群排列整齐的矿物飘过[Root.GetName]的残骸带，可能来自于外星人。
entries.en: An unusually deliberate, geometric configuration of minerals drifts through the debris belt by [Root.GetName], and is possibly of alien origin.

entries.zh: 扫雷
entries.en: Minesweeper

entries.zh: 对[Root.GetName]的图像扫描显示，整颗行星覆盖着网格般的纹路。
entries.en: Visual scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface reveal a grid pattern seemingly covering the entire planet.

entries.zh: 停泊
entries.en: Parked

entries.zh: 对[Root.GetName]粗略扫描有了令人震惊的结果。\n\n似乎有东西也在扫描我们……
entries.en: A cursory scan of [Root.GetName] yields surprising results.\n\nSomething seems to be scanning us back...

entries.zh: 沙丘
entries.en: Dunes

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气极其稀薄，但似乎有风一样的东西在吹拂着它表面的沙海。
entries.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] is extremely thin, and yet something not unlike wind seems to agitate the seas of sand that make up its surface.

entries.zh: 剧毒建筑
entries.en: Toxic Construction

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的毒云之下，某种非自然建筑结构伫立在剧毒的地表之上。
entries.en: Somewhere beneath [Root.GetName]'s unctuous clouds, unnatural structures silhouette themselves against the toxic surface.

entries.zh: 森林国度
entries.en: Wooden Hegemony

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]表面被一种外形奇特的树木覆盖着。
entries.en: The surface of [Root.GetName] is dominated by particularly impressive-looking trees.

entries.zh: 黑暗中的彩虹
entries.en: Rainbow in the Dark

entries.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]周边发现不寻常的读数，不该在离黑洞这么近的地方出现。
entries.en: Sensors pick up unusual readings in the vicinity of [Root.GetName] - readings that are hard to explain being this close to a black hole.

entries.zh: 多普勒效应
entries.en: Doppler Effect

entries.zh: 一个摇摆不定的信号萦绕在[Root.GetName]，而且并不来自星球表面。
entries.en: A wavering signal haunts [Root.GetName], though it does not seem to originate from the planet's surface.

entries.zh: 破釜沉舟
entries.en: Rubiconian Shores

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]充满绿意的平原十分寂静，除了那微弱但稳定的信标信号。
entries.en: [Root.GetName]'s verdant plains are quiet, save for a weak but steady beacon signal.

entries.zh: 古代工厂
entries.en: Ancient Manufactory

entries.zh: 一个古老、似乎被遗弃的建造结构漂浮在[Root.GetName]上空，除此之外那便是一颗普通的小行星。
entries.en: An old, seemingly abandoned structure looms over [Root.GetName], an otherwise unremarkable asteroid.

entries.zh: 石脑
entries.en: Rock Brain

entries.zh: 对巨型小行星[From.GetName]的扫描得出了有趣的结果。这块岩石的核心里含有携带微弱电流的导电晶体网络。[Root.GetName]上的成员辨认出这片晶体网络与原始神经网络具有相似性，认为就算该天体并不具有完全智能，也能进行某种程度的思考。他们请求将核心取出，并带到最近的轨道站以进行更仔细的研究。
entries.en: A scan of the particularly massive asteroid [From.GetName] yields fascinating results. The rock's core is shot through with a network of conductive crystals carrying a weak electric charge. The crew on the [Root.GetName] recognize this matrix as a primitive neural lattice and believe the celestial body to be thinking in some capacity, if not fully sapient. They seek permission to excavate the core and transport it to the nearest orbital station for closer study.

entries.zh: 就这么办。
entries.en: Make it so.

entries.zh: 尽可能调查表面就行。
entries.en: Make do with what you can study from the surface.

entries.zh: 为[From.GetName]添加§Y石脑§!修正：\n£physics£§G+8§!
entries.en: Adds the §YRock Brain§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\n£physics£ §G+8§!

entries.zh: 它跟我们有些相似。我们跟它来谈谈吧。
entries.en: It is not so unlike us. Let us talk.

entries.zh: 命令[Root.GetName]将表面探测器连接到[From.GetName]并解码其所谓的神经活动。
entries.en: Order [Root.GetName] to attach surface probes to [From.GetName] and decode its alleged neural activity

entries.zh: 由于§H[This.Owner.GetName]§!是§Y石质§!国家，该选项可用
entries.en: This option is available due to the §H[This.Owner.GetName]§! being a §YLithoid§! empire.

entries.zh: 我是[rock_scientist.GetName]。这项任务很有挑战性，但我认为我们已经成功将这些内容解析为类似于……也许不是语言，而是概念，或者想法。我们可以将类似的东西反馈给小行星，或许可以进行交流。\n\n我们将显示一些 §Y<过滤后的输出>§!，我将尽我所能对原始数据进行§G“§!更完整的解释§G”§!。
entries.en: [rock_scientist.GetName] here. It was a challenge, but I think we've managed to parse the readings into something like... not language perhaps, but concepts. Ideas. And we can feed something similar back to the asteroid, to maybe communicate.\n\nWe'll display some of the §Y<filtered output>§!, and I'll do my best to give a more §G"§!complete interpretation§G"§! of the raw data.

entries.zh: 转念一想，这似乎不明智。
entries.en: On second thought, this seems ill-advised.

entries.zh: 放弃直接与[rock_brain.GetName]的交流，保持距离进行研究吧。
entries.en: Abort any attempts at contacting [rock_brain.GetName] directly, and study it from afar

entries.zh: 就这么办。
entries.en: Patch us through.

entries.zh:
§Y<新><想法>。<原因>。<原因><令人困惑>。§!


§G“§!多说一句，[rock_brain.GetName]没有传统意义上的感觉器官。它将我们的输入认为是它自己的想法。至少某种程度上是这样的。§G”§!
entries.en:
§Y<new> <thoughts>. <reason>. <reason> <perplexing>.§!


§G"§!To provide some context, [rock_brain.GetName] has no sensory organs in the traditional sense. It is perceiving our input as its own thoughts. To an extent.§G"§!

entries.zh: <你还不明白我们不是你吗？>
entries.en: <Do you understand that we are not you?>

entries.zh:
§Y<想法>-<不同><协调>-<相同><分歧>-<不同>.§! 


§G“§!我怀疑石脑认为我们只是短暂认知偏差，但它过去确实曾经有过这样的想法。我们是转瞬即逝的消遣。§G”§!
entries.en:
§Y<thought>-<different> <reconciliation>-<same> <divergence>-<different>.§!


§G"§!It is unconvinced that we are anything but a cerebral blip, but it has entertained such cognitive ghosts in the past. We are a fleeting diversion.§G"§!

entries.zh: <你们在[rock_sun.GetName]的轨道上漂流多久了？>
entries.en: <How long have you been drifting in orbit of [rock_sun.GetName]?>

entries.zh:
§Y<不是>……<刚才><不是>。<不是>。§!


§G“§![rock_brain.GetName]不认识，甚至未曾感知过[rock_sun.GetName]的存在。它除了对连续发生的想法的有有限掌握之外，它还缺乏时间的概念。§G”§!
entries.en:
§Y<not>... <previous> <not>. <not>.§!


§G"§![rock_brain.GetName] does not recognize nor even perceive the existence of the star [rock_sun.GetName]. It also lacks a concept of time, outside of a limited grasp of the successive occurrence of thought.§G"§!

entries.zh: “我们从中得到什么有用的东西了吗？”
entries.en: "Are we getting anything useful out of this?"

entries.zh:
§Y<……>§!


§G“§!哦，有的，这种交流正在以难以置信的速度发展我们的模糊解码器网络。我很惊讶它的效果就像原生编码一样好，但我也收到了一些警告的读数……§G”§!
entries.en:
§Y<...>§!


§G"§!Oh yes, this exchange is evolving our fuzzy decoder nets at an incredible rate. I am amazed this is working as well as it is, but I am picking up some alarming readings...§G"§!

entries.zh: <让我们聊点别的……>
entries.en: <Let us talk about something else...>

entries.zh:
§Y<查--。<查询>§!


§G“§!正如我担心的一样。我们的探测器正在让驱动[rock_brain.GetName]意识的能量流失。[rock_brain.GetName]本身也不是一个完美的闭环系统，所以这种事迟早会发生的——尽管这需要成千上万年，但至少不是现在…§G”§!
entries.en:
§Y<quer--. <query>§!


§G"§!As I feared. Our probes are bleeding [rock_brain.GetName] of the energy that drives its cognition. [rock_brain.GetName] is not a perfectly closed system so this would have happened eventually - though in tens of thousands of years, rather than now...§G"§!

entries.zh: <我们有什么可以帮到你们的吗？>
entries.en: <Is there anything we can do to help you?>

entries.zh:
§Y<是>。§!


§G“§!它说它很好，但事实并非如此。我们曾尝试将一些能量反回神经网络，但这只会产生噪音更大的脑电波，而不是更强的脑电波。我们已经超过了阈值，无论我们做什么，剩下的一点能量很快就会消失。它没有办法检测到它的认知在减慢，也无法知晓这意味着它的终结。更不知道死亡意味着什么……§G”§!
entries.en:
§Y<am>.§!


§G"§!It says it's fine, but it's not fine. We have tried feeding some energy back into the neural lattice but that only produces noisier brain waves, not stronger ones. We've already crossed the threshold, what little energy remains will soon peter out no matter what we do. It has no means of detecting its cognition slowing down, nor any reason to predict that this spells its end. Nor any idea about what it means to die...§G"§!

entries.zh: <有什么遗言吗？>
entries.en: <Any last words?>

entries.zh:
§Y<重复><以> - <感知>。<[rock_fallen_empire.GetRealName]>。§!


§G“§!它会再次想起我们，或者是现在，再次，通过它的思想具象化我们？恐怕信号正在迅速衰减。我们也不确定如何理解“[rock_fallen_empire.GetRealName]”——它似乎是我们从[rock_brain.GetName]得到的最接近传统语言的语言，但它的含义仍然模糊不清。也许只是我们的解析算法因为目标神经网络失效而崩溃。§G”§!
entries.en:
§Y<perceive>-<within> <repeat>. <[rock_fallen_empire.GetRealName]>.§!


§G"§!It will think of us again, or it is now, again, embodying us through its thoughts? I'm afraid the signal is fading rapidly. We are also not sure what to make of "[rock_fallen_empire.GetRealName]" - it appears to be the closest to traditional language we've gotten from [rock_brain.GetName], but its meaning remains obscure. Maybe our interpretation algorithms are simply breaking down as the subject's neural lattice fails.§G"§!

entries.zh: $anomaly.78.b1$
entries.en: $anomaly.78.b1$

entries.zh:
§Y<重复><以> - <感知>。§!


§G“§!它会再次想起我们，或者是现在，再次，通过它的思想具象化我们？恐怕信号正在迅速衰减——也许只是我们的解析算法因为目标神经网络失效而崩溃。§G”§!
entries.en:
§Y<perceive>-<within> <repeat>.§!


§G"§!It will think of us again. Rather, it is now once again embodying us through its thoughts? I'm afraid the signal is fading rapidly - or maybe our interpretation algorithms are simply breaking down as the subject's neural lattice fails.§G"§!

entries.zh: “是时候说再见了。”
entries.en: "Time to say goodbye."

entries.zh: [rock_brain.GetName]沉寂了。科学专员[rock_scientist.GetName]尝试给这个小行星的矿物网络重新充能的所有方案均以失败告终；所有曾经激发其粗糙神经元的智慧火花都消失了，但我们从这个遥远的进化表亲那里学到了很多东西。
entries.en: [rock_brain.GetName] is silent. All attempts by Science Officer [rock_scientist.GetName] to recharge the mineral lattice within the asteroid have failed; whatever spark of sapience once animated its rough-hewn neurons is gone, but we have learned much from this distant evolutionary cousin.

entries.zh: 这是这个“物种”的最后一个，还是第一个？
entries.en: Was it the last of its kind, or the first?

entries.zh: 岩石偏头痛
entries.en: Rock Migraine

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]的核心刚从小行星外壳内部被小心取出，就对太空的真空环境产生了不良反应。在这块石疙瘩缓慢但不可逆地开裂之前，[Root.GetName]的设备检测到了一个突如其来的能量峰值。\n\n我们随后回收到了大量的导电性矿物，但曾赋予它们生命的神秘电荷却不复存在了。
entries.en: The core of [From.From.GetName], once coaxed from beneath the crust of the asteroid, does not respond well to the vacuum of space. The [Root.GetName]'s instruments read a sudden energy spike moments before the rocky lump gently, but decisively, fractures.\n\nLarge chunks of the conductive mineral are salvaged, but whatever spectral charge animated them is now gone.

entries.zh: 这些水晶本身还是有价值的。
entries.en: The crystals are still valuable in their own right.

entries.zh: 我们的死灵法师已经在小行星脆弱的矿物层上留下了新的痕迹，在上面刻下了粗糙的咒文，并充满了脉冲电流。然而，曾为[rock_brain.GetName]的意识并没有回来。\n\n现在它成了另一个东西，沉眠于一个邪恶的梦境中——被装上方向推进器，等待这我们控制。
entries.en: Our necromancers have scored new traces across the asteroid's delicate mineral seams, crude invocations hewn in stone and suffused with a pulsing current. Yet, the consciousness that was [rock_brain.GetName] remains lost to us.\n\nIt is something different now, suspended in a sinister dream - fitted with directional thrusters and awaiting our command.

entries.zh: 窃语的行星
entries.en: Gossiping Planets

entries.zh: [From.GetName]和它附近行星不规则的电磁信号引起了[Root.GetName]成员的注意。进一步研究表明这些信号是些内容十分平淡无奇的加密通讯。随后似乎察觉到了窃听一样，电磁活动突然中止了，但在此之前，[Root.GetName]已经纪录下[From.GetName]和其星系内其他行星的状态。
entries.en: Irregular electromagnetic bursts from [From.GetName] and its neighboring planets intrigue the crew of the [Root.GetName]. Further study reveals that the bursts are coded communications, though the contents are fairly banal. The electromagnetic activity suddenly ceases, as if in response to the eavesdropping, but not before the [Root.GetName] has cataloged the self-reported statuses of [From.GetName] and every other planet in the system.

entries.zh: 使用这些数据进行进一步的研究远距离通讯。
entries.en: Use the data to further research long-range communications.

entries.zh: 将数据匹配到该星系内的所有行星。
entries.en: Map the status data to every planet in the system.

entries.zh: 藤蔓缠绕
entries.en: Grasping Vines

entries.zh: [From.GetName]上浓密的青草在接触[Root.GetName]的探针后，异常凶猛地将其撕碎。这些强壮的藤蔓努力地伸向远方的飞船，给了这颗行星缺少动物的情况合理的解释。\n\n已发起§Y特殊项目§!来进一步调查这个行星上的植物生命。
entries.en: The dense grasses of [From.GetName] respond to the [Root.GetName]'s exploratory probes by disassembling them in a spectacularly violent manner. As sinewy vines reach for the ship far above, the relative lack of animal life on the planet starts making sense.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued for further study of the planet's plant life.

entries.zh: 这种食人植物是个威胁。
entries.en: A triffidian menace.

entries.zh: 青草军团
entries.en: Grassy Militia

entries.zh: 缜密的检查揭示了[From.From.GetName]上的青草和藤蔓的剧烈行为并非无意识的自卫反应。\n\n这些植物有着复杂的内部社会秩序。不同地区不同种类的植物有着不同的使命，其中最重要的一种植物似乎是负责驱赶当地的食草动物和来自天空的入侵者的。
entries.en: Careful examination reveals that the violent behavior of the vines and grasses of [From.From.GetName] is no dumb self-defense reflex.\n\nThe plants have a complex internal social order. Depending on geographical region, different phyla assume a number of different tasks, the most important one seemingly being staving off native herbivores and would-be invaders from the skies.

entries.zh: 已向[From.From.GetName]添加§Y狡猾的植物§!修正：\n£society£§G+6§!
entries.en: Adds the §YCunning Flora§! modifier to [From.From.GetName]:\n£society£ §G+6§!

entries.zh: 他方之宝
entries.en: Important to Someone Else

entries.zh: 一块铝板被发现于[From.GetName]周围漂浮的碎石中，它的阳极化表面使它从周围的金属残骸中脱颖而出。它上面绘有两只模样滑稽的哺乳动物，还有一些无趣的几何形状。
entries.en: An aluminum plaque is found drifting among the detritus around [From.GetName], its anodized surface standing out from the metal debris surrounding it. It depicts two ridiculous-looking mammalian figures and some rather tasteless geometric shapes.

entries.zh: 也许可以当我酒杯的杯垫。
entries.en: It might make a good coaster for my drink.

entries.zh: 解析这块铝板。
entries.en: Decipher the plaque.

entries.zh: 肯定有人愿意出价购买。
entries.en: I'm sure someone would be willing to pay for it.

entries.zh: 将太阳系坐标加入情报日志。\n
entries.en: Adds the coordinates of the Sol system to the Situation Log.\n

entries.zh: 地球大陆
entries.en: Terra Firma

entries.zh: 铝板上雕刻的坐标大体准确。\n\n这是太阳系，而这块铝板显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
entries.en: The directions inferred from the inscribed plaque were largely accurate.\n\nThis is the system of Sol, with the plaque apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

entries.zh: 我们已经找到了那些可疑破旧金属废料的源头。太阳系是一个以一颗黄矮星为中心的小星系，一个和[Root.Owner.GetName]的辉煌毫不相称的穷乡僻壤。
entries.en: We have found the alleged source of the tacky metal scrap we recovered. The system of Sol is a pinprick in space centered on a pitiful yellow dwarf, a backwater completely eclipsed by the splendor of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们最终到达了太阳系，那里的人在沥尽心血地用极其原始的方式与外界交流。铝板所标记的源头似乎是从恒星往外数第三块岩石，应该是一颗大陆行星。
entries.en: We have finally reached the system of Sol, a destination some being went to great pains to communicate through a very primitive medium. The plaque's point of origin is seemingly the third rock from the sun, which should be a continental planet.

entries.zh: 真是路途遥远啊。
entries.en: Far shores indeed.

entries.zh: 发表声明。然后把铝板丢到他们的恒星里去。
entries.en: Make a statement. Jettison the plaque into their sun.

entries.zh: 你们向虚空呼唤，我们便来了。
entries.en: You shouted into the void, and we came.

entries.zh: 超越先驱者
entries.en: Catching up with a Pioneer

entries.zh: 一块阳极镀金的铝板被发现于[From.GetName]的表面。在进行任何分析和数据对比之前，[Root.GetName]上的所有成员就已经认识到了它的来源。
entries.en: An aluminum plate, anodized gold, is recovered from the surface of [From.GetName]. Everyone aboard the [Root.GetName] recognize it long before analysis and database cross-referencing confirm its origins.

entries.zh: 铝板来自……先驱者11号。
entries.en: The plaque from Pioneer... 11.

entries.zh: 旧日之曲
entries.en: Old-Timey Tunes

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在调查[From.GetName]微弱引力场时发现了一张金色碟片。碟片已被收回，初步分析表明其表面的细槽可能是由某种外星文明所创作的经过加密的音频和视频数据。
entries.en: A golden disc strikes the forward viewport of the [Root.GetName] as it is surveying the weak gravitational field of [From.GetName]. The object is recovered, and cursory analysis indicates that the minuscule grooves on the disc's surface might be encoded audio and video data, authored by some alien civilization.

entries.zh: 也许可以当大酒杯的杯垫。
entries.en: It might make a good coaster for a very big drink.

entries.zh: 进行解析。
entries.en: Decode it.

entries.zh: 外星音乐爱好者肯定会出大价钱。
entries.en: Xeno-audiophiles would pay a lot for this.

entries.zh: 将太阳系坐标加入情报日志。\n
entries.en: Adds the Sol system coordinates to the Situation Log.\n

entries.zh: 地球大陆
entries.en: Terra Firma

entries.zh: 碟片上刻录的坐标大体准确。\n\n这是太阳系，而这块碟片显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
entries.en: The directions inferred from the audiovisual record were largely accurate.\n\nThis is the system of Sol, with the disc apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

entries.zh: 我们找到了那张被我们修复的破旧的光盘的可能的来源。只是这个星系在太空实在是太过于渺小了，以一颗可怜的黄矮星为中心。在壮丽的[Root.Owner.GetName]面前，这只是一个根本不值得一提的蛮荒之地。
entries.en: We have found the alleged source of the tacky disc we recovered. The system of Sol is a pinprick in space centered on a pitiful yellow dwarf, a backwater completely eclipsed by the splendor of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们最终到达了太阳系，一些生物通过很原始的媒介艰难的通讯的地方。这块徽章的来源看起来是太阳的第三颗行星，那是一个大陆行星。
entries.en: We have finally reached the system of Sol, a destination some being went to great pains to communicate through a very primitive medium. The disc's point of origin is seemingly the third rock from the sun, which should be a continental planet.

entries.zh: 真是路途遥远啊。
entries.en: Far shores indeed.

entries.zh: 发出声明。把碟片丢到他们的恒星里去。
entries.en: Make a statement. Jettison the record into their sun.

entries.zh: 你们向虚空呼唤，我们便来了。
entries.en: You shouted into the void, and we came.

entries.zh: 往日之声
entries.en: Voices From the Past

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面一座被早已逝去的[Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]民族所抛弃的堡垒内，一张金色碟片静躺在一座石台上，被厚厚的孢子尘埃覆盖着。\n\n起初它被认为是一件微不足道的外星制品，可能有着某种宗教意义，但一台档案计算机很快辨识出它是当初旅行者号探测器发射时携带的镀金唱片。
entries.en: In an abandoned fortress on the surface of [From.GetName], evidently the stronghold of some long-dead race of [Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural], a golden disc rests on a pedestal beneath a thick covering of spore-dust.\n\nFirst designated to be stowed away as an alien artifact of minor, possibly xeno-religious significance, an archival computer soon identifies it as the golden phonograph record originally launched with the Voyager probe.

entries.zh: 马上回放。
entries.en: Play it back. Now.

entries.zh: 细胞仓库
entries.en: Cell Cells

entries.zh: [From.GetName]部分中空。其内部是密集的蜂窝结构，由某种未知的合金打造。其中存放着许多储存外星基因物质的容器。这显然是一座生命档案馆，记录着一个失落的文明的基因资料。多数遗传因子都已严重损毁无法复原，但我们仍能从中学到许多。
entries.en: [From.GetName] is partially hollow. Within its interior spaces sprawls a dense honeycomb structure crafted of some unknown alloy, housing containers of alien genetic material. By all appearances this is an archive of life, the genetic record of some earlier civilization come and gone. Most of the DNA is hopelessly degraded, but there is still much to learn here.

entries.zh: 真是体贴！
entries.en: How considerate!

entries.zh: 埃迪克巨石
entries.en: Eddic, Monolithic

entries.zh: [From.GetName]无人居住，也确实无法居住，但却并非无人造访过。它的表面散布着许多高耸的尖碑，由某种非本星球的矿物雕刻，显然是由某种热衷艺术的太空文明所置放于此。这些碑塔流动的曲线雕琢出了一段如此如梦似幻的历史，其一定是虚构的。 \n\n一定是。
entries.en: [From.GetName] is uninhabited and indeed uninhabitable, but not unvisited. Its surface is littered with tall cenotaphs carved from some mineral not native to the planet; evidently placed here by some artistically-inclined spacefaring race. The monoliths' flowing lines deftly chart a history so fantastical it must surely be fictional.\n\nSurely.

entries.zh: 拍摄后存入档案。
entries.en: Image them for the archives.

entries.zh: 它们……好美。
entries.en: They are... beautiful.

entries.zh: 将这些碑文的数字版复制品广泛投放到我们的§Y帝国§!中去。
entries.en: Make digital reproductions of the monoliths widely available in our §YEmpire§!.

entries.zh: 这些来自[From.From.GetName]的碑塔图像的注解版在[Root.GetName]广受欢迎。\n\n许多人表示这些美妙的史册完全改变了他们对外星生物的看法。
entries.en: The annotated reproductions of the monolithic imagery found on [From.From.GetName] prove immensely popular in the [Root.GetName].\n\nMany citizens state that the fantastical annals have completely changed how they feel about aliens.

entries.zh: 约§Y600§!£pop£§H人口§!获得§Y亲外主义§!思潮。
entries.en: Approximately §Y600§! £pop£ §HPops§! gain the §YXenophile§! Ethic.

entries.zh: 约§Y300§!£pop£§H人口§!获得§Y亲外主义§!思潮。
entries.en: Approximately §Y300§! £pop£ §HPops§! gain the §YXenophile§! Ethic.

entries.zh: 来路不明
entries.en: Unsolicited Mapping

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]截获求救信号后，向[From.GetName]那不稳定的表面派送了探测器。似乎有一艘未注册的货船最近曾撞毁在这颗行星上。无论它当时运了什么东西，皆已化为尘土。不过其导航电脑中的该星系的调查数据仍然可以恢复。
entries.en: Intercepting the distress signal, the [Root.GetName] sends a probe down to the volatile surface of [From.GetName]. It seems an unregistered freighter recently crashed on the planet; whatever it was carrying has been reduced an ashen sludge, but some data from the navigation computer can be recovered and survey data for this system reconstructed.

entries.zh: 就这么办。
entries.en: Make it so.

entries.zh: 引力坠机
entries.en: Gravity Crush

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]对小行星的调查暂时停止，因为一架探测器被突如其来的引力异常捕获。\n\n在被极度巨大的力量摧毁之前，这架探测器成功传回了一些数据。而这股力量很快就消失不见了。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName]'s survey of the asteroid is temporarily halted as a probe is caught by an errant gravitational anomaly.\n\nThe probe manages to transmit some data before it is brutally crushed by the extreme forces - forces that completely dissipate soon after.

entries.zh: 至少没人受伤。
entries.en: At least no one got hurt.

entries.zh: 废弃游乐场
entries.en: Abandoned Amusement Park

entries.zh: [From.GetName]上的建筑并没有我们最初想的那么古老。它似乎是某种游乐场。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]表示，这些奇妙的装置异常复杂，我们能从中学到很多。在它们建造者的视角中，这可能是尖端的传感阵列，也可能是巨大的艺术设施。\n\n然而，在我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]看来，这看起来更像是你会带着小孩子去玩的地方。
entries.en: The structures on [From.GetName] are not as old as we first believed. It is a playground or amusement park of some sort. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] notes that many of the contraptions are highly complex creations that we can learn much from and that, from the builders' alien point of view, this might have been a cutting-edge sensor array or even a gigantic art installation.\n\nRegardless, to us [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it looks mostly like a place where you would take your young and let them amuse themselves.

entries.zh: 熟悉的古龛
entries.en: Familiar Shrine

entries.zh:
小行星的大部分地方都被激光精细雕刻过，看上去像小型的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]庙宇：这是一座供奉着§Y未叙尊者§!的古龛，祂是诸多[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]古旧信仰中专司毁灭的神祇。

这座古龛已经在太空中盘旋了许久，比我们掌握太空航行技术的时间还要更加久远——这个发现让我们很多的研究者们百思不得其解。

由于发现的这一物体仍正体不明，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议我们寻找更多与这个宇宙古龛有相似特征的天体。[Root.leader.GetHeSheCap][Root.leader.GetHasHave]准备了一份附近恒星系中可能的候选列表。
entries.en:
Most of the asteroid has been laser-chiseled with great precision into the likeness of a small [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] temple: a shrine to §Ythe Untold§!, great destroyer-deity of several old [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] faiths.

The temple has been tumbling through the quiet of space for longer than we have been capable of space-flight - a finding which disturbs more than a few of our researchers.

Despite the unsettling nature of this discovery, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has suggested we search for more objects matching the characteristics of this space temple. [Root.leader.GetHeSheCap] [Root.leader.GetHasHave] prepared a list of likely candidates in nearby star systems.

entries.zh: 不去管这些东西也许是最好的。
entries.en: Perhaps it would be best if we did not.

entries.zh: §L就让沉睡的神灵继续沉睡着吧。§!
entries.en: §LLet sleeping gods lie.§!

entries.zh: 我们看看就走。
entries.en: Then a-looking we shall go.

entries.zh: 我们不会受这种异端的影响。
entries.en: We will not suffer this heresy.

entries.zh: 命令[Root.GetName]把神殿夷为平地。
entries.en: Order the [Root.GetName] to raze the shrine.

entries.zh: 古神：接近恩赐女神
entries.en: Old Gods: Approaching the Benefactress

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出那颗恒星周围确实环行着另一个与未叙尊者的神龛别无二致的物体。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system. Its crew reports the star is indeed orbited by another object not dissimilar to the shrine of the Untold.

entries.zh: 开始调查。
entries.en: Let us investigate.

entries.zh: 古神：接近勇气之神
entries.en: Old Gods: Approaching the Undaunted

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出另一个在轨道上的物体与未叙尊者的古龛有很高的相似性。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system, where its crew report another object in orbit bearing strong resemblance to a shrine to the Untold.

entries.zh: 干得好。
entries.en: Good work.

entries.zh: 古神：接近洞察女神
entries.en: Old Gods: Approaching the Percipient

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员们本以为搜寻洞察女神的神殿会更费功夫一些，没想到刚一进入[Root.GetStarName]就看到了非常明显的指引。这个星系中的星体上被雕刻着人工矿物的图案，纷纷指向了一片中央区域。
entries.en: Expecting perhaps for a more difficult search when scanning for the shrine to the Percipient, the crew of [Root.GetName] were not ready to see it obviously signposted when entering [Root.GetStarName]. Artificial mineral patterns have been carved around on stellar bodies in the systems pointing to a central location.

entries.zh: 我知道了。
entries.en: I see.

entries.zh: 所奏为何
entries.en: What Music They Make

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]上的动物——不论是捕食者还是猎物——都会在夜幕降临的时候聚集在一起，然后……唱歌。

嚎叫、咔哒声、叽喳声、咆哮、嘘声混在一起，初听来呕哑嘲哳难为听，但其细听却能发现潜藏着一种可以辨认的旋律。[Root.GetName]上的船员也说那种音乐甚至还挺好听的。

我们认为必然有外来影响干涉才能创造出这种非智慧生物的合唱。我们无法放理解其原因，但至少我们可以研究他们是如何做到的。
entries.en:
The animals of [From.GetName] - predator and prey alike - gather together as night falls and... sing.

The howls, clicks, chirps, roars and hisses seem discordant at first, but underneath lies a recognizable melody. The crew of the [Root.GetName] suggest it's even rather pleasant to hear.

We believe an external influence must have interfered in order to develop this non-sapient choir. We cannot fathom as to why, however we may be able to figure out how they did it.

entries.zh: 还是通过化学来交流比较好。
entries.en: Better communication through chemistry.

entries.zh: 泽珞之下
entries.en: Below Zro

entries.zh: [From.GetName]不是一颗寻常的冰巨行星，这颗冰巨行星由极其罕见的冰构成。冰内部包裹着许多泽珞，在行星大气层的上层便可以展开开采。
entries.en: [From.GetName] is not only an ice giant, but an ice giant made up of highly unusual solids. There are pockets of Zro trapped in the within reach of the upper levels of the planet's atmosphere.

entries.zh: 发现§Y泽珞冰晶§!矿藏。
entries.en: §YZro Ice§! deposit found.

entries.zh: 不法勾当
entries.en: Illicit Matter

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]在小行星表面的坑洞中发现了令人不安的隐藏科技。

显然有人——用简单粗略的方法——在此处稳定创造了一个单向虫洞。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]得出结论，这颗小行星是一个出口。虫洞的另一端是一块距离某个黑洞几光年远的未知区域，并有少量暗物质——因为受到虹吸——从虫洞中泄漏。

不管是谁建立虫洞，他们似乎已经放弃了此项行动。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetName] finds a disturbing tangle of technology hidden in a deep crater on the asteroid's surface.

Evidently someone has - by rather simplistic means - managed to stabilize a one-way wormhole. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests that the asteroid is an exit point. The other end opens up somewhere in uncharted space some light-years away from a black hole, and small quantities of dark matter are leaking - being siphoned - through the wormhole.

Whoever set this up seems to have abandoned the operation.

entries.zh: 发现§Y暗物质§!矿藏。
entries.en: §YDark Matter§! deposit found.

entries.zh: 紫雨
entries.en: Purple Rain

entries.zh: 由[Root.GetName]的地表探测器拍摄的[From.GetName]上迷人紫雨的图像，辗转流传到了[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的文化精英手中。\n\n虽然这个发现毫无科研价值，但令人浮想联翩的斑斓降雨图像在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的艺术领域依然擦出了一点复兴的火花，这一事件也许多年后才会开花结果。
entries.en: Images capturing [From.GetName]'s mesmerizing purple-colored rain, taken by the [Root.GetName]'s surface exploration probes, somehow find their way into the hands of the cultural elite on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].\n\nWhile the discovery is of no scientific value, the evocative imagery of the colorful precipitation sparks a minor renaissance in the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] art world, the positive effects of which shall be felt for years to come.

entries.zh: 古神：恩赐女神的神殿
entries.en: Old Gods: Shrine to the Benefactress

entries.zh: 破解恩赐女神神殿中的象形文字要比预计的顺利许多。负责该项目的语言学家们称，这些文本莫名地令人亲切：能轻易地“触动”他们的心弦，尽管其中的语法古老又冗杂。\n\n然而，他们指出，这些信息暗示了一些非常晦涩难懂的主题和上下文。我们除非与关于这位四位一体的神的其他文本结合起来，否则很难完全理解他们的信息。
entries.en: Deciphering the pictograms in the Benefactress' shrine went more smoothly than anticipated. The linguists assigned to the project describe these texts as somehow familiar: "clicking" easily for them, despite the grammar's age and complexity.\n\nThey note, however, these written messages allude to some truly obscure themes and contexts. We cannot fully understand their messages until they are combined with other texts associated with this quadrumvirate godhead.

entries.zh: 古神：勇气之神的神殿
entries.en: Old Gods: Shrine to the Undaunted

entries.zh: 在经过了连日的仔细、甚至好几次令人崩溃的工作之后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]取回了勇气之神的宗卷：一个普通的织物卷轴用用坚固塑料膜封存。这个卷轴被带回[Root.GetName]进行进一步研究。
entries.en: After days of careful, and at times excruciating effort, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has retrieved the Doctrine of the Undaunted: a humble textile scroll coated with a sturdy plastic polymer. The scroll has been brought back to the [Root.GetName] for further analysis.

entries.zh: 古神：洞察女神的神殿
entries.en: Old Gods: Shrine to the Percipient

entries.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报了有关洞察女神神殿的情况。

它的墙壁上镶嵌着表语文字，被一层层的保护漆严重地扭曲了。工作人员试图初步破译这种文字，但是失败了；它的语法与我们遇到的其他语言体系截然不同。[Root.GetName]的船员试图去除保护漆，希望能看得更加清楚，但没有成功。

在任务即将宣布失败的时候——在恼怒即将爆发的边缘——[Root.GetLeaderName]突然开始感知到一段段的连贯文本。

船员们没有花很长时间就利用这些线索编成了索引。很快，他们就把天花板、墙壁和地板描绘成了一个螺旋形的图案：这是一幅更广泛的图画的一部分，我们相信可以用其他神殿的文字来完成。
entries.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has reported back from the Percipient's shrine.

Its walls are inlaid with logographic script, heavily distorted by layers of a protective lacquer. Initial attempts to decipher this text failed; its grammar is too distinct from other linguistic groups we've encountered. The crew of the [Root.GetName] tried removing the protective lacquer for a clearer view, but to no avail.

The mission was about to be declared a failure when - on the cusp of an irritated outburst - [Root.GetLeaderName] suddenly began to perceive discrete lines of coherent text.

It did not take the crew long to utilize these insights as a codex. Soon they had the ceiling, walls and floor imaged in a spiral pattern: part of a broader picture which we believe may be completed using texts from the other shrines.

entries.zh: 古神：揭示
entries.en: Old Gods: Revelation

entries.zh: 完整的众神教条——因为我们认为被恢复的文本就应该被这样视作——对我们具有启示意义，它对于我们古老宗教赖以建立的那些幻想基础是具有毁灭性的。\n\n当放在以[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]为中心的情景中时，这些文本清楚地表明，我们注定要在一位宗教领袖强有力的手段的引导下实现伟大的功业。我们注定要成为神，但我们的过去充斥着流产的预言和因无知而产生的罪恶。救赎是短暂的。
entries.en: The complete doctrine of the gods - for that is how we believe the recovered texts should be regarded - is as revelatory to us as it is devastating to the fantasies upon which our ancient religions were founded.\n\nWhen placed within a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]-centered context, these texts make it clear that we were meant for greatness, guided by the strong hand of a religious leader. We are destined for godhood, but our past is littered with unfulfilled prophecies and sin born of ignorance. Redemption is ephemeral.

entries.zh: 封锁发现。
entries.en: Suppress the findings.

entries.zh: §L知识就是力量。神秘的知识是神秘的力量。§!
entries.en: §LKnowledge is power. Secret knowledge is secret power.§!

entries.zh: 我们可以拿这个换点钱。
entries.en: We can monetize this.

entries.zh: 但是我们能从中了解到什么？
entries.en: But what can we learn from this?

entries.zh: 我们追随神意的脚步前进！
entries.en: We walk in the footsteps of the Divine!

entries.zh: 流亡者
entries.en: The Exile

entries.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]表面探测到一个小型研究站发出的信号，但[Root.Owner.GetName]既没有这个研究站的成立记录也没有对其授权记录。里面只有一位[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]科学家，如果在[FromFrom.GetName]的研究可信的话，平心而论确实是一位颇有才华且成果丰硕的研究者。但其身份存在一个问题，我们无法在帝国正式记录匹配到相关信息，此人也拒绝公开身份，只说自己是一个“流亡者”。\n\n其表达了回到[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]直接为[Root.Owner.GetName]服务的愿望，条件是[Root.GetName]立刻离开[FromFrom.GetName]，并且任何[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]飞船都不能返回那里。
entries.en: The readings originate from a small research outpost - which the [Root.Owner.GetName] has no records of establishing or indeed authorizing - on the surface of [FromFrom.GetName]. It is staffed by one [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] scientist, a fairly talented and industrious one if their research on [FromFrom.GetName] is anything to go by. There is a problem with regards to their identity however; we have been unable to match them against official state records, and they refuse to identify themselves save for stating that they are "an exile."\n\nThey have expressed an interest in returning to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and serving the [Root.Owner.GetName] directly, on the condition that the [Root.GetName] immediately depart [FromFrom.GetName] and no [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] ships ever return there.

entries.zh: 想都别想。给我把那个研究站翻个底朝天。
entries.en: Out of the question. Search every nook and cranny of that outpost.

entries.zh: 逮捕§Y流亡者§!，彻查未授权的研究站。
entries.en: Detain §YThe Exile§! and ransack the unauthorized research outpost.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]欢迎流亡者回归编制。
entries.en: The [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] welcomes the exile back into the fold.

entries.zh: 一位3级$scientist_with_icon$流亡者加入了我们的帝国。
entries.en: The Exile, a Level 3 $scientist_with_icon$, joins our empire.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!被发现于[Root.GetHomeWorldBiome]§Y[Root.GetBackgroundPlanet]§!上的一座研究哨站中。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! was found in a Research Outpost on the [Root.GetHomeWorldBiome] §Y[Root.GetBackgroundPlanet]§!.

entries.zh: 冷清空旷
entries.en: Cold and Empty

entries.zh:
研究站本身没什么特别。它规模很小，只是用来对抗严酷环境的一个临时庇护所，仅能在严酷的环境拖垮之前，进行时间有限的表面级的星球研究。

[From.From.From.GetName]的研究站已经接近生命的尽头，但那颗星球的严寒还未压下最后一根稻草。那些功能正常、廉价且可抛弃的器材得到了充分使用，本地数据库中填满了详尽却极为寻常的行星数据，以及在严酷环境下进行的简单试验。

有趣的是，似乎研究站地基下的矿脉并没有得到深入检查。[Root.GetName]的扫描表明这座大部分被冰雪覆盖的山脉可能是中空的。更令人警觉的是，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告这座研究站唯一的栖居者，那位神秘的“流亡者”消失不见了。
entries.en:
There is nothing unusual about the research outpost itself. It is little but a temporary shelter erected against the savage elements, allowing surface-level planetary study for a limited time before it wears down and conditions become untenable.

The outpost on [From.From.From.GetName] is nearing the end of its lifespan, but the planet's intense chill has yet to critically degrade the impermanent structure. The equipment - functional, cheap, intended to be abandoned - is well-used, and the local databanks are filled with detailed but ultimately mundane accounts of the planet as well as the simple experiments that were carried out in its harsh environment.

Curiously, no closer examination seems to have been made of the mineral outcropping the outpost's foundations rest on; scans by the [Root.GetName] indicate that the geological formation, a mountain mostly buried under ice, may be partially hollow. More alarmingly, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the sole inhabitant of the outpost, the mysterious "exile," has gone missing and is nowhere to be found.

entries.zh: 想不通。
entries.en: Puzzling.

entries.zh: 深入地下
entries.en: Down Below

entries.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]上的研究站有点不寻常。建筑本身并无奇怪之处——用来对抗严酷环境的小型临时庇护所，仅能在严酷的环境拖垮之前，进行时间有限的表面级的星球研究——但它恰巧建在突破星球表面冰海的岩石之上。

[Root.GetName]的成员发现，这座山的内部有复杂的洞穴和通道，由研究站内部便可进入。

在一个较大的岩洞里，他们发现了研究站原成员脱水的遗体。这些[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]研究员原先被派往别处，但显然，他们却来到了这个无人居住的危险行星。

当然，那个所谓的“流亡者”如今已经不见踪影。[Root.GetName]发射了一所逃生舱，将逝者的遗体送回[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]。
entries.en:
There is something unusual about the research outpost on [From.From.From.GetName]. The structure itself is commonplace enough - a temporary shelter erected against the harsh elements, allowing surface-level planetary study for a limited time before it wears down and conditions become untenable - but it is situated on top of a rocky formation poking through the sea of ice that covers the planet.

The crew of the [Root.GetName] found an intricate system of caves and narrow passages leading into this mountain, accessible from inside the research outpost.

In one of the larger cavern-halls, they found the desiccated remains of the outpost's original staff. This contingent of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] researchers had originally been dispatched elsewhere, but evidently diverted to this uninhabited and hostile planet to set up shop.

Of course, the self-proclaimed "exile" is now nowhere to be found. The [Root.GetName] has launched one of its escape pods, transporting the bodies of the deceased back to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 咸咸的
entries.en: Salty

entries.zh:
科研船[Root.GetName]找不到我们在[From.From.GetName]上探测到的奇怪读数的来源，这些读数似乎只是传感器的回声。不过，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]——一位自称的美食家和历史爱好者——声称在那里有了重大发现。

在几块巨大的地表冰层中发现的矿藏似乎与[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]星盐关系密切：星盐曾经是许多传统[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]菜肴中不可或缺的调料，但长期以来一直被认为在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上已经枯竭。

烹饪史学家长期以来一直怀疑这种矿物调味品不是我们母星的原产物，而科学专员在[From.From.GetName]上的发现则为这一理论提供了一些支持。至于这种盐的味道是否真的像以前的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]星盐，这并不是最重要的：仅仅是用如此相近的调味料恢复传统食品的想法，就一定会让我们的经济和味觉非常兴奋。
entries.en:
Science ship [Root.GetName] could find no source for the strange readings we detected on [From.From.GetName], which appear to be mere sensor echoes. Nevertheless, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] - a self-proclaimed gourmet chef and history buff - claims to have made a significant discovery there.

A mineral deposit found in several vast patches of surface ice appears closely related to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Stellar Salt: once an essential ingredient in many traditional [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] dishes, long thought depleted on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Culinary historians have long suspected that this mineral condiment was not native to our homeworld, and the Science Officer's discovery on [From.From.GetName] lends some credence to this theory. Whether or not the salt actually tastes like the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Stellar Salt of old is ultimately of little consequence: the mere idea of reviving traditional foodstuffs with such closely-matched ingredients is bound to excite our economy and our palates.

entries.zh: 可口。
entries.en: Savory.

entries.zh: 小家伙
entries.en: Nimkip

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]上满是微小且斑斓的生命体，介于植物与动物之间。它们缺乏真正的进化潜能，但与体型相比，它们的力量和组织协调性令人震惊。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]迷上了他们，并承认对那个“红色的小家伙”情有独钟。
entries.en: [From.From.GetName] is populated by tiny, colorful lifeforms that straddle the divide between flora and fauna. They lack any serious evolutionary potential, but their group coordination and great strength relative to their size is impressive.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken a shine to them, admitting a particular soft spot for "the red ones."

entries.zh: 令人愉悦。
entries.en: Delightful.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]不能容忍这些生物的存在。
entries.en: The [Root.Owner.GetName] will not suffer these creatures to live.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的工作人员们进行了详尽迅速的驱除工作，保证这些可爱的外星生物再也不会侵犯[Root.Owner.GetName]。\n
entries.en: A swift extermination campaign carried out by the crew of the [Root.GetName] will ensure that this cutesy alien menace can never rise to threaten the [Root.Owner.GetName].\n

entries.zh: 我们只能旁观，不能干涉。
entries.en: We need to remain a passive observer.

entries.zh: 别动那些可爱的小生物，[Root.GetLeaderName]。
entries.en: Leave the poor critters alone, [Root.GetLeaderName].

entries.zh: 他们将被吞噬。
entries.en: THEY WILL BE DEVOURED.

entries.zh: 这些“可爱的”外星人的营养会喂饱我们的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]。\n
entries.en: The nutrients from these cutesy aliens will feed our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].\n

entries.zh: 生死弥留
entries.en: Limbo

entries.zh:
信号似乎是从某个类似信号天线的结构中传来的。我方已经从[Root.GetName]发射了探索无人机，希望能够在星球表面发现更多线索。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]所发现的洞穴仓库十分容易地就被撬开。他判定这座仓库为某种早已灭亡的外星种族所用，似乎是其族群最后的一处避难所。该种族的科技水平虽然较为先进，但似乎从未进行太空探索，结果因为某种涉及到整颗星球的自然灾害而消亡了。库房面积广大，其中充斥着成千上万个黑匣子。据[Root.GetName]判定，这些匣子都是数据储存装置。

已发起§Y特殊项目§!来进一步对这些匣子进行解读。
entries.en:
The signal originates from the remains of an antenna-like structure. Exploratory probes were dispatched from the [Root.GetName] to the surface to investigate the matter more closely.

What Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] found was a cavernous vault that, while easily pried open, was evidently the last safehouse and refuge of some long-dead race of aliens. While reasonably technologically advanced, it seems they never reached for the stars and perished to some planet-wide natural disaster. The vault is immense, housing thousands upon thousands of black boxes that the [Root.GetName] has determined to be data storage devices.

A §YSpecial Project§! has been prepared to decode their contents.

entries.zh: 卫星勘测项目
entries.en: Moon Projection

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报说，他们觉得在[Root.GetName]上采集的感应数据一点也不可靠。其中最为可疑的就是[From.From.GetName]的卫星，他们已发起§Y特殊项目§!来进行进一步的调查。\n\n详情请查看情报日志。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that they do not trust the sensor readings they've gathered aboard the [Root.GetName], not one bit of it. They are especially suspicious of [From.From.GetName]'s moon, and have outlined a §YSpecial Project§! for further investigation.\n\nConsult the Situation Log for details.

entries.zh: 卫星勘测结果
entries.en: Moon Projected

entries.zh: 在卫星上发现了十分不可思议的装置。其中心为三进制电脑，其程序似乎在不断地根据其收集的行星数据进行新的排列运算。计算后产生的数据经过强力通讯列阵调制后，被发射到卫星所环绕的星球表面。虽然这信号乍一看来似乎只是乱码，但这种调制方式却能让信号进入行星大气层并被反射后变得和普通的感应采集数据没有区别。\n\n虽然我们无法判定这装置的用处，但通过此次调查，我学习了外星生物的工程技术，受益匪浅。
entries.en: There is a device on the moon, and it is mystifying. At its core lies a ternary computer, seemingly tasked with endlessly calculating new permutations based on a core set of planetary readings. These values are then passed to a powerful comm array, which modulates the data before blasting it at the surface of its parent planet. The raw signal appears nonsensical at a casual glance, but the careful modulation ensures that it becomes nearly indistinguishable from legitimate sensor readings once the signal is reflected from the parent planet's surface and filtered through its atmosphere.\n\nThe purpose of this set-up is difficult to deduce, but provides a good opportunity to study alien engineering techniques.

entries.zh:
卫星获得了§Y卫星勘测§!修正：
£engineering£§G+6§!
entries.en:
Adds the §YProjecting Moon§! modifier to the moon:
£engineering£ §G+6§!

entries.zh: 薄暮海岸
entries.en: Misty Shores

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说，在[From.From.GetName]海域之中有人为制造的大型且柔韧的几何网格，材料主要为某种复合塑料。\n\n这些塑料网格从大气层外的轨道上依然清晰可见，其作用暂时不明，似乎只是用来装饰的。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that large, flexible geometric grids made up of some plastic polymer - clearly artificial in nature - have been placed in the seas of [From.From.GetName].\n\nVisible from orbit, they seem to serve no purpose other than, possibly, an aesthetic one.

entries.zh: 地热能源
entries.en: Geothermal

entries.zh: 轨道上监测到的规律性敲击声原来是行星上十分古老的巨大地热采集器，仍然在垂死运行着。很久前就被遗弃的这些机器虽然已经不太坚固，但仍然在源源不断地从星球核心泵出超高温的液体。\n\n虽然其储能单元已经全部破损泄露，但仍然能够从中获取少量能源。
entries.en: The measured pounding observed from orbit is the motion of immense and ancient geothermal extractors, breathing their last. Built and then abandoned at some point in the distant past, the vast batteries of disintegrating machinery have been pumping up superheated fluids from the planet's core ever since.\n\nTheir storage capacitors are all broken or leaking, but some energy can still be siphoned from them.

entries.zh: 一马平川
entries.en: Completely Leveled

entries.zh: 在彻底调查[From.From.GetName]的地理状况后，[Root.GetName]并未能找到任何值得注意的现象。\n\n倒不如说，此处的地理状况平淡得让人惊讶……其唯一特征就是一点特征都没有。虽然地势稍有高低之分，但[From.From.GetName]的整个地表都十分不自然地平整。同时，星球上的各种植被也十分平淡，令人过目就忘。
entries.en: A thorough geological survey of [From.From.GetName] by the [Root.GetName] reveals nothing of interest.\n\nIn fact, it is extraordinarily uninteresting - its only defining feature is its lack of defining features. There are depressions and elevations, yes, but on the whole the surface of [From.From.GetName] can be regarded as unnaturally flat. Likewise, the native flora and fauna are strikingly docile and unworthy of attention.

entries.zh: 这算是……好事吧？
entries.en: That's... good?

entries.zh: 所有£blocker£§Y地块障碍§!已从[From.From.GetName]被移除。
entries.en: All £blocker£ §YTile Blockers§! have been cleared from [From.From.GetName].

entries.zh: 维度陷阱
entries.en: Dimensional Pocket

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]本应前往[From.From.From.GetName]研究其附近的异常状况，但途中却遭遇了不测。包括科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]及船员在内的整艘舰船在调查太空废墟时突然消失不见了。

而在数分钟后，舰船又重新出现。

据[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报，他们在一瞬之间到达了某个超维度空间。他们从外部观察口看到其附近布满了各式各样的外星舰船，都一动不动地被困在无限的虚空之中。在船员能够判定所在位置之前，船外的景色突然消失，而舰船又重新回到了普通空间之中。

但不幸的是，船上的一半工作人员都消失了——科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些船员应该是因为某种不可知的机制而永远地被困在那里了。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetName] never made it all the way to [From.From.From.GetName] to study the anomalies surrounding it. The ship, along with Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and crew, blinked out of existence as it was navigating the debris field.

And then reappeared minutes later.

[Root.GetLeaderName] reports that they found themselves, briefly, in some extra-dimensional space. External viewports revealed that they were surrounded by countless ships of alien design, suspended in a seemingly endless void. Before the crew could get their bearings, the vision abruptly faded and they found themselves back in regular space.

However, roughly half of the crew are missing - Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that they may have been selectively trapped, by some unknowable mechanism, in that strange space.

entries.zh: 维度漂移
entries.en: Dimensional Drift

entries.zh:
原本被认为迷失在维度裂缝中的[Root.GetName]失踪船员重新出现了。

所有失踪船员都被放置在一艘与我方科技飞船相似的飞船上，漂浮在[Root.GetName]原本遇到维度陷阱的地方。船员们全数声称，并不记得这期间发生了什么事情，只是隐约觉得自己离开了一段时间。

船员们希望能够回到科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]手下工作，并将飞船移交给了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。
entries.en:
The missing members of the [Root.GetName]'s crew, thought lost to the dimensional rift, have reappeared.

They hailed us from aboard an unknown vessel, not entirely dissimilar to our own science ships, idling close to where the [Root.GetName] originally experienced the dimensional disturbance. They claim to remember nothing of their time outside our dimension, aside from a vague awareness of having been away for some time.

They wish for nothing but to return to service under Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], and intend to surrender their ship to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] authorities.

entries.zh:
原本被认为迷失在维度裂缝中的[Root.GetName]失踪船员重新出现了。

他们从一艘有机舰船上向我们呼叫，这艘船诡异地与我们的科研船相似，但又微妙地……不同。它的移动方式、脉搏完全不遵循任何已知的基因蓝图，仿佛是某种扭曲的外星意识对我们舰船的怪异理解。它静静的在[Root.GetName]第一次遭遇扰动的坐标附近漂浮、等待着。

船员们什么也不记得。只是有一种模糊的缺席感，一种去了别的地方的感觉，比感受到的时间长得多。然而，它们又没有改变，至少他们自己是这么说的。

船员们希望能够回到科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]手下工作，并将他们怪异而沉默飞船毫不犹豫地移交给了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。但当我们接收到它们的信息时，一种深沉而陌生的共鸣在通信中嗡嗡作响。船虽然静止不动，但感觉好像在倾听。
entries.en:
The missing crew of the [Root.GetName], long presumed lost to the dimensional rift, have inexplicably reappeared.

They hailed us from aboard an unfamiliar organic construct, its form eerily similar to our own science vessels, yet subtly... off. The way it moves, the way it pulses, it follows no known genetic blueprint, as though it were a reflection of our ships seen through a warped, alien mind. It drifted silently near the coordinates where the [Root.GetName] first encountered the disturbance, waiting.

The crew remembers nothing of their time beyond. Only a vague sensation of absence, of having been somewhere else, for far longer than time should allow. And yet, they are unchanged. Or so they claim.

They wish to return to service under Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], and they offer their strange, silent vessel to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] authorities without hesitation. But as we receive their transmission, a deep and unfamiliar resonance hums through the comms. The ship, though still, feels as though it is listening.

entries.zh: 很好。
entries.en: Very well.

entries.zh: 获得一艘科研船。
entries.en: Gain a Science Ship.

entries.zh: 为了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人民的安全必须毁灭它。
entries.en: The safety of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] people hinges on their destruction.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人民的安全与否取决于是否毁灭它们。
entries.en: The safety of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] hinges on their destruction.

entries.zh: 他们开始攻击了！
entries.en: They turn hostile!

entries.zh: 丰饶景色
entries.en: Cornucopicturesque

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]的表面充斥着许多处过于茂盛的植被，十分不自然。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]仍然无法解释这颗星球的土地为部分地区异常肥沃的机理，但认为此处的植物稍经加工就能够被[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]正常食用。
entries.en: [From.From.GetName]'s surface is dotted with irregular patches of intense greenery.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is not yet ready to explain the mechanics behind the soil's localized hyperfertility, but asserts that much of the native flora is suitable for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] consumption with only minimal processing needed.

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]的地表散布着不规则的密集植被。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]尚无法对土地局部性异常肥沃背后的原理作出解释，但声称大多数本地植物适合供[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]活体陈设食用，而且几乎无需进行加工。
entries.en: [From.From.GetName]'s surface is dotted with irregular patches of intense greenery.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is not yet ready to explain the mechanics behind the soil's localized hyperfertility, but asserts that much of the native flora is suitable for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Bio-Trophy consumption with only minimal processing needed.

entries.zh: 向[From.GetName]添加§Y丰饶§!修正：\n增加§G食物§!
entries.en: Adds the §YCornucopia§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\nAdditional §GFood§!

entries.zh: 矿产丰富
entries.en: Mineralistic

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]就[From.GetName]的矿藏进行了详细报告。由于独特的地壳构造进程，[Root.GetName]的地表附近聚集了大量的珍贵矿脉。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has provided us with a detailed report on [From.GetName]'s geological riches. Apparently the planet's unique tectonic history has served to concentrate many minerals of interest to the [Root.GetName] near the surface.

entries.zh: 向[From.GetName]添加§Y原矿石§!修正：\n增加§G矿物§!
entries.en: Adds the §YRaw Materials§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\nAdditional §GMinerals§!

entries.zh: 游荡阴影
entries.en: Swirling Shadows

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]的表面总会有大片的阴影掠过。

造成这些阴影的并非是云朵，而是大气层上方漂浮着的一层有机物质，为了便于活动，上面还有关节一般的结构。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]仍然无法判定这些有机物质是植被还是动物，也不能解释其造成的阴影到底有什么作用。
entries.en:
Immense, ragged planes of shadow drift across [From.GetName]'s face.

They are cast not by clouds but by sheets of organic material drifting through the upper layers of the atmosphere, hinged - or rather jointed - to allow for a small degree of articulation.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is as yet unwilling to say whether these things are flora or fauna, or what possible purpose, if any, their elaborate shadow-casting might serve.

entries.zh: 添加§Y皮影戏§!修正至[From.GetName]：\n£society£ §G+4§!
entries.en: Adds the §YShadow Play§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\n£society£ §G+4§!

entries.zh: 诡变多端
entries.en: Grimacing

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的地理构造的确是处在变动之中。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这是地壳活动造成的。这一地壳活动虽然有趣但是却极其深奥。不过[Root.Owner.GetName]所感兴趣的，是某种可以停止星球这一无尽且无序的自我变构的方法。简单来说，使用此方法转化星球不仅用时极短，而且理论上也有可能让星球变得更加易于居住。\n\n[Root.GetLeaderName]需要额外的200能量币进行地理活动勘测，以证明科学专员所提出的外科手术刀式精准改造方案是否真的可行。当然，如果以后想要使用现有的环境改造科技，也是可以的。
entries.en: The very geological structure of [From.GetName] is indeed in flux, driven by what Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] assures us is a tectonic process as fascinating as it is esoteric. What is of more interest to the [Root.Owner.GetName] is that we may be able to strategically halt the planet's ceaseless, chaotic self-transformation. In short, a near-instant terraforming of the planet into something slightly - if not entirely - more habitable, is theoretically possible.\n\n[Root.GetLeaderName] estimates that an additional 200 Energy Credits will be needed to power a thorough mapping of planetary activity and determine the validity of what the Science Officer has termed "a surgical terraforming strike." Of course, we can always choose to terraform it using existing technologies at a later date.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的地理构造的确是处在变动之中。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这是地壳活动造成的。这一地壳活动虽然有趣但是却极其深奥。不过[Root.Owner.GetName]所感兴趣的，是某种可以停止星球自我变更的步骤。简单来说，使用此步骤转化星球后，不仅用时极短，而且理论上也有可能让星球变得更加易于居住。\n\n[Root.GetLeaderName]需要额外的200能量币进行地理活动勘测，以证明科学专员所提出的方案是否真的可以使用。目前我们还无法进行常规性的环境改造，所以这次真的是千载难逢的机会。
entries.en: The very geological structure of [From.GetName] is indeed in flux, driven by what Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] assures us is a tectonic process as fascinating as it is esoteric. What is of more interest to the [Root.Owner.GetName] is that we may be able to strategically halt the planet's ceaseless, chaotic self-transformation. In short, a near-instant stabilization of the planet into something slightly - if not entirely - more habitable, is theoretically possible.\n\n[Root.GetLeaderName] estimates that an additional 200 Energy Credits will be needed to power a thorough mapping of planetary activity and determine the validity of what the Science Officer has termed "a surgical terraforming strike." Actual terraforming lies beyond our grasp at present, so this is an exciting opportunity.

entries.zh: 仅仅研究其变化的自然过程。
entries.en: Just study its natural processes.

entries.zh: 添加§Y诡变多端§!修正至[From.GetName]：\n£physics£§G+4§!
entries.en: Adds the §YGrimacing§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\n£physics£ §G+4§!

entries.zh: 给予[Root.GetName]200能量币。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will have its 200 credits.

entries.zh: 花费能量币，尝试稳定星球并使之更宜居。大约有§Y50%的成功几率§!。\n
entries.en: Spend Energy Credits to attempt to stabilize the planet in a more favorable state, with roughly a §Y50% chance of success§!.\n

entries.zh: 我们不想在这种不确定的假设上浪费能量币。
entries.en: We have no credits to spend on vague hypotheses.

entries.zh: 战术性环境改造
entries.en: Tactical Terraforming

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报说，[From.From.GetName]的确能够进行改造！在星球的自身转化进入时长几个月的不稳定阶段时，我们有一个非常短暂的时机。[Root.GetLeaderName]认为可以将小型炸药植入星球地壳中，再加上星球大气层的战略性辐照作用，便可以停止[From.From.GetName]永不停歇的自我转化过程，将其转变为更加易于居住的星球。\n\n已经设立了§Y特殊项目§!，但时间十分紧迫。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that [From.From.GetName] can indeed be terraformed! A narrow window of opportunity is expected to open shortly, as the planet enters a particularly unstable phase of its cycle lasting a couple of months. [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that miniaturized explosive charges delivered to the planet's crust and strategic irradiation of the atmosphere during this time will halt [From.From.GetName]'s tumultuous changes and stabilize it in a form somewhat more suitable for sustaining life.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued, but we do not have much time.

entries.zh: 战术性环境改造失败
entries.en: Tactical Terraforming Failed

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员遗憾地汇报：虽然我方成功判定了环境改造的时机，但最终仍然没赶上改造[From.From.GetName]的机会。这样的机会大概几个世纪之内是不会再有了。
entries.en: The crew of the [Root.GetName] are disappointed to report that the window of opportunity for terraforming [From.From.GetName] has closed, despite their best efforts to identify it in time. Another opportunity is unlikely to arise for another few centuries.

entries.zh: 战术性环境改造成功
entries.en: Tactical Terraforming Successful

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]十分骄傲地汇报：[From.From.GetName]可以被重新定位为干旱星球，而不再是荒芜星球了。此次试验的成功大大促进了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的科学发展。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is proud to report that [From.From.GetName] can now be re-classified as an Arid rather than Barren planet. This grand experiment has greatly enriched the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] sciences.

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]自豪地报告称[From.From.GetName]现在已可被重新分类为机械星球而不是荒芜星球。这次大实验极大地丰富了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的科学知识。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is proud to report that [From.From.GetName] can now be re-classified as a Machine planet rather than Barren planet. This grand experiment has greatly enriched the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] sciences.

entries.zh: 光影艺术
entries.en: Lightshow

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报说，覆盖[From.GetName]的冰层下遍布的闪光波浪源于外星科技。\n\n在这颗星球上曾经发生过上古战争，当时有一架外星战机解体后在此处坠落，只有露在船身外的主武器核心没被摧毁。看起来这个外星种族所运用的激光武器与[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]舰队目前正在使用的相似，其武器核心不定期地向[From.GetName]的冰层表面放射低能射束，但因为行星的气候过于恶劣，激光无法融化冰层，所以就产生了十分美丽的光影艺术。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the luminous waves coursing through the ice that blankets [From.GetName] are of alien origin.\n\nSome ancient battle has deposited scattered wreckage from an alien fighter on the frozen planet, and only the exposed core of its main weapons remains intact. It seems this alien race used lasers similar to the ones currently in use by [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] fleets, and the fizzling innards periodically discharge low-powered beams into the ice of [From.GetName]. The planet's harsh climate prevents the lasers from actually melting the ice, allowing the chilly matrix to act as a brilliant prism.

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报说，覆盖[From.GetName]的冰层下遍布的闪光波浪源于外星科技。\n\n在这颗星球上曾经发生过上古战争，当时有一架外星战机解体后在此处坠落，只有露在船身外的主武器核心没被摧毁。看起来这个外星种族所运用的激光武器比[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]舰队目前正在使用的先进许多，其武器核心不定期地向[From.GetName]的冰层表面放射低能激光，但因为行星的气候过于恶劣，激光无法融化冰层，所以就产生了十分美丽的光影艺术。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the luminous waves coursing through the ice that blankets [From.GetName] are of alien origin.\n\nSome ancient battle has deposited scattered wreckage from an alien fighter on the frozen planet, and only the exposed core of its main weapons remains intact. It seems this alien race used lasers somewhat more advanced than the ones currently in use by [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] fleets, and the fizzling innards periodically discharge low-powered lasers into the ice of [From.GetName]. The planet's harsh climate prevents the lasers from actually melting the ice, allowing the chilly matrix to act as a brilliant prism.

entries.zh: 我们可以利用此科技。
entries.en: We could use that technology.

entries.zh: 虚假的巨行星
entries.en: Deceptive Giant

entries.zh:
我们曾经以为这颗星球是十分少见的小型气体星球，但事实并非如此。

在大气层上方浮动着的一层厚厚的粉尘欺骗了科学专员们，粉尘层下面掩盖的只不过是一颗贫瘠但十分普通的行星而已。

这一发现让[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的天文学家们十分尴尬。
entries.en:
What we had assumed was an abnormally small gas giant is, in fact, not.

Beneath a deceptive cover of thick dust swirling in the upper atmosphere lies a regular planet. A barren planet, but a planet nonetheless.

This has proven quite embarrassing to the astronomical community on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]：被定位为§Y荒芜§!星球。
entries.en: [From.GetName]: Revealed to be a §YBarren§! planet.\n

entries.zh: 盈乐园
entries.en: Eden Overrun

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]上的确勃勃生机。

只不过这些生物全部都极为残忍。

虽然星球十分适于殖民，但[Root.GetName]的船员警告说，可能会遭遇当地生物的大肆袭击。
entries.en:
[From.GetName] is indeed teeming with life.

Dangerous life.

While ripe for colonization, the crew of the [Root.GetName] warn that we are likely to run into problems with the local wildlife.

entries.zh: 不明气体
entries.en: A Whiff of Something

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]从[From.GetName]的表面回收了一只长方形的金属匣子。这只匣子的五个面上都有一些小孔，而科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]也因此判定这并不是装东西用的匣子，而是用来散发气味的某种工具。初试测试表明，这匣子中原本存放的气味现在仍然在缓慢地释放着。\n\n为了查明此匣子的具体功用，已经设立了§Y特殊项目§!。或许外星物种是用味道来传递信息，然后再通过大气中的化学物质接收信息，从而进行交流也不一定呢。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has recovered an elongated metal box from the surface of [From.GetName]. Clusters of small perforations on five sides lead Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] to believe it is not a container, but some sort of aerosol dispersal device. Initial tests seem to confirm their suspicions as trace aromatics still emanate from the object.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to confirm whether this might be an information-carrying device constructed by some alien race communicating primarily through the secretion and reception of atmosphere-borne chemical compounds; smells.

entries.zh: 臭不可闻。
entries.en: Malodorous.

entries.zh: 不明气体
entries.en: A Whiff of Something

entries.zh:
这匣子的确是存放了某种数据。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]承认，本来大家都希望匣子中存放的是星球的历史或者某种文化的重要资料，但结果却令人十分失望。

这散发着芳香的匣子中存放的乃是十分短小的几段故事，故事每一章节快到末尾的时候气味都会快速变化，而这一转变似乎是为了惊吓或逗乐读者，也就是笑话了。虽然匣子储存气味的技术值得研究，但其中的笑话却毫无价值。

[Root.GetName]的船员们因为闻了外星生物所产生的某种气味而感到不太舒心。然而，对于匣子为什么会被扔在这了无人烟的荒凉星球上，[Root.GetLeaderName]却不愿进行猜测。
entries.en:
The box is indeed a document, of a sort. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] admits that they had been hoping for a historical record or some other kind of codex significant to whatever culture left it behind, but they were disappointed.

The true nature of the aromatic box seems to be a collection of fairly short narratives which, going by the rapid changes in odor towards the end of each sequence, are intended to surprise or be interpreted as comedic. The techniques used to store and reproduce specific smells is of some interest, but the tales it tells are not.

The crew of the [Root.GetName] are left with the uncomfortable feeling that they have unwittingly become intimately familiar with what certain gaseous byproducts of alien digestion smell like. However, [Root.GetLeaderName] is unwilling to speculate as to why the box was dumped on this frozen hellscape of a planet.

entries.zh: 过去的世界末日
entries.en: Apocalypse Past

entries.zh:
在[From.GetName]上曾经居住着某个智力较为发达的外星物种，或许再过几十年就能够研发出太空旅行，但在那之前他们就已经把自己终结了。虽然星球本身已经从毫无意义的大肆毁灭中恢复了过来，但表面上仍然有十分明显的伤疤。

地表上残存着几处遗迹，其中有座保存得较为良好的石碑。[Root.GetLeaderName]十分轻松地解读了上面的讯息，原来是世界末日的幸存者们为后来之人所刻下的一则警告。其种族灭亡的直接原因便是“终极武器”的发明。这个种族的某种心理学特征导致共同毁灭机制不再有效。

因为最终武器很难被摧毁，那些最终由于不明原因迅速死去的幸存者们在临死前便将其藏在了地底深处，并留下讯息劝告后人不要去寻找它们。
entries.en:
[From.GetName] was once home to a race of reasonably intelligent beings who destroyed themselves when they were seemingly only decades away from space flight. The planet has recovered from what must have been immense acts of senseless destruction, but it still bears very visible scars.

One of the few remaining ruins on the surface holds a reasonably well-preserved stone monolith inscribed with a message, quickly decoded by [Root.GetLeaderName]. It is a warning, from the last of the extinct species to whoever they believed would arise after their passing. It was the development of an "ultimate weapon" that was their downfall; some quirk in the psychology of this species evidently rendered deterrence through mutually assured destruction impossible.

Survivors, before dying of unknown causes soon after, hid this weaponry deep underground as destroying them was difficult, and left this message dissuade us from going looking for them.

entries.zh: 那我们还是别去找了吧。
entries.en: Then dissuaded we shall be.

entries.zh: 去找那些武器吧。
entries.en: Find those weapons.

entries.zh: 有趣的发现
entries.en: An Interesting Find

entries.zh: 看起来这颗星球上的“最终武器”只不过是我们眼中最为基本的武器科技而已。\n\n他们能运用这些科技导致世界末日，或许只是因为十分爱好杀戮而已吧。
entries.en: It seems the people of this planet were experimenting only with what we would consider to be fairly basic weapons technologies.\n\nThe havoc they wrought is more a testament to their incredible, genocidal tenacity than it is to the power of their weaponry.

entries.zh: 虽然普通，但十分有用。
entries.en: Basic but useful.

entries.zh: 获得科技：§Y质量投射器§!
entries.en: Gain Technology: §YMass Driver§!

entries.zh: 获得科技：§Y导弹§!
entries.en: Gain Technology: §YMissile§!

entries.zh: 获得科技：§Y红色激光§!
entries.en: Gain Technology: §YRed Laser§!

entries.zh: 对于[Root.Owner.GetName]来说，都没什么用处。
entries.en: None of this is of any use to the [Root.Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: 残酷的发现
entries.en: A Brutal Find

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为幸存者们隐藏武器的决定十分正确。在地底洞穴中找到的这些武器虽然与[Root.Owner.GetName]的现役装备原理相同，但更为先进。这些科技一定会对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]战争机器大有帮助。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] remarks that the previous inhabitants of this place were right to hide these weapons, recovered from a cave beneath the ruins, away. They build on the same basic principles as weapons already in use in the [Root.Owner.GetName], but are far more advanced. These technologies are sure to be a boon to the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] military machine.

entries.zh: 什么？我们已经有这些科技了。
entries.en: What? We already possess this technology.

entries.zh: 升级我们的激光武器。
entries.en: Upgrade our laser weapons.

entries.zh: 升级我们的质量投射器。
entries.en: Upgrade our mass drivers.

entries.zh: 升级我们的导弹。
entries.en: Upgrade our missiles.

entries.zh: 空手而归
entries.en: Empty-handed

entries.zh: 搜查无果。不管是怎样强大的武器，现在都没了。
entries.en: The search proves fruitless. Whatever these mystical weapons were, they are now gone.

entries.zh: 矿物工厂
entries.en: Mineral Factorial

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上发现了全星球仅有一座的外星建筑。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为星球上所有的其它建筑都因为某种原因被移到了别处，但不知为何只留下这么一座建筑。\n\n这建筑乃是处理星球上丰富矿脉的加工厂，经过[Root.GetName]初步勘测后，认定可以十分轻松地重新运作。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has found an alien structure on [From.GetName]. It seems to be the only one of its kind on the planet - Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that all other xenoarchitectural traces may have been moved off-world, with this sole building left behind for reasons unknown.\n\nIt is a processing plant working the planet's abundant mineral resources, and preliminary scans by the [Root.GetName] indicate that it can be reactivated with relative ease.

entries.zh: 太好了。
entries.en: Most excellent.

entries.zh: 添加§Y古代工厂§!至[From.GetName]。\n
entries.en: Adds an §YAncient Factory§! to [From.GetName].\n

entries.zh: 外星汽车赛
entries.en: Alien Drag Racing

entries.zh: [From.GetName]浅层松软表面上的坑洞中有着不规则的长条印记。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]在印记的附近发现了十分令人惊讶的各种废品：被撞毁的轮式载具。它们看起来并不像是科研用品，而是载人用的。\n\n[Root.GetName]的船员们认为这里应该是外星人用作赛车的地点。在这几乎零重力的地方，外星生物们驾着自己车辆互相对抗，测试车辆的强度与速度，真是激动人心。
entries.en: The crater on [From.GetName] exhibits long, irregular marks imprinted into the relatively soft upper layers of the asteroid. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has recovered some interesting unexpected wreckage from the edges of the depression; wheeled vehicles, seemingly personal transports rather than research craft.\n\nThe crew of the [Root.GetName] speculate that the crater may once have been used for sport, with some alien species pitting their personal locomotion devices against each other in tests of mechanical strength or speed in near-zero-G.

entries.zh: 真厉害。
entries.en: Vroom.

entries.zh: 添加§Y刹车印记§!修正至[From.GetName]：\n£engineering£§G+6§!
entries.en: Adds the §YSkid Marks§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\n£engineering£ §G+6§!

entries.zh: 撞车大事故
entries.en: Fender Bender

entries.zh: 虽然此处的陨石坑应该只是普通的陨石撞击造成的，但陨石坑中复杂的纹路应该是产生于撞击之后。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些地表的印记应该不是陨石造成的，而是小行星[From.GetName]与某种未知的轨道设施或外星飞船之类的东西撞击后造成的。
entries.en: While the crater in question was most likely the result of a regular meteorite impact, the complex patterns in the resulting depression originated at a later time.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] argues that these surface-level patterns are not the result of an impact but a collision, one between asteroid [From.GetName] and some unspecified orbital installation or ship of alien make.

entries.zh: 真奇怪呢。
entries.en: How odd.

entries.zh: 添加§Y死亡赛道§!修正至[From.GetName]：\n£engineering£§G+3§!
entries.en: Adds the §YCircuits in the Dust§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\n£engineering£ §G+3§!

entries.zh: 遗弃的推动装置
entries.en: Abandoned Thrusting

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的其中一个大坑中心有外星工艺制造的金属机械。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些大型机械是用于推动整颗星球的。其目的便是将[From.GetName]从原先轨道中推出，但目的地不明。[Root.GetName]正在待命，可以将这些推动装置进行拆卸与分析，或许可以提升我方的推进科技。
entries.en: In the center of a particularly large crater on [From.GetName] lies a cluster of metal shapes, doubtlessly of alien origin.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is convinced that they are massive, planetoid-mountable propulsion devices, intended to push [From.GetName] from its orbit for purposes and destinations unknown. The [Root.GetName] is on standby, its crew ready to begin disassembly and analysis of the alleged propulsion systems with the hopes of improving our own thruster technology.

entries.zh: 就这么办。
entries.en: Make it so.

entries.zh: 就这么放着别动了吧。
entries.en: Leave the alien devilry be.

entries.zh: 殖民失败
entries.en: Colonial Failure

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]上曾经有过外星殖民地，至少是一次早期的殖民尝试。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说该次殖民明显还不成熟，建立的建筑也绝对无法抵御[From.GetName]的恶劣气候。\n\n[Root.GetName]不想空手而归，便随船带回了一个报废了的大气过滤装置，想着或许能做些研究。
entries.en: There was an alien colony on [From.GetName] once, or at least an early attempt at one. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the effort was obviously premature, the ramshackle structures never standing a chance against the hostile climate of [From.GetName].\n\nNot wanting to leave empty-handed, the [Root.GetName] has recovered a defunct atmospheric filtration unit that may be of some interest.

entries.zh: 我们可以吸取他们的教训。
entries.en: We can learn from their mistakes.

entries.zh: 这东西一点用都没有。
entries.en: This thing's useless.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]永远不会犯下这样的错误。
entries.en: The [Root.Owner.GetName] would never make such mistakes.

entries.zh: 不寻常的地壳
entries.en: Unusual Tectonics

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上找到的并非是建筑，而是十分普通的矿物岩层。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些岩层之所以会露出地面，是因为不同的地壳构造版块互相撞击而形成的，其形状的特殊性是由行星地壳中不同寻常的物理构造造成的。\n\n因为其形状过于工整，看起来某种外星生物似乎曾经对[From.GetName]的地壳进行过改动。
entries.en: What the [Root.GetName] found on [From.GetName] were not buildings, but surprisingly regular mineral outcroppings. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] asserts that these angular blocks of rock are the product of interactions between tectonic plates, their shapes the result of the unusual tectonophysics inherent in the planet's crust.\n\nThe perfect angularity of these thrust faults implies a possibility of aliens tampering with [From.GetName]'s crust at some point in the past.

entries.zh: 还真有意思。
entries.en: Most intriguing.

entries.zh: 添加§Y异常地壳§!修正至[From.GetName]：\n£engineering£§G+2§!\n£physics£§G+2§!
entries.en: Adds the §YUnusual Tectonics§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\n£engineering£ §G+2§!\n£physics£ §G+2§!

entries.zh: 潜在矿脉
entries.en: Rock Potential

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]的矿脉资源十分丰富。

不幸的是，其中大部分矿石对我们都没用。然而，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为[From.GetName]地壳中的许多元素都可以通过正电子轰炸转化成对我方有用的矿石。

[Root.GetName]希望[Root.Owner.GetName]能拨出1000能量币实行此计划。
entries.en:
[From.GetName] is exceptionally rich in minerals.

Minerals that are, unfortunately, of no use to us. However, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes the many elements in the crust of [From.GetName] can be transformed into potentially more useful forms through positron bombardment.

The [Root.GetName] has requests that the [Root.Owner.GetName] set aside 1000 Energy Credits for the purposes of this project.

entries.zh: 不行，不批准。
entries.en: No. No, we will not.

entries.zh: 很好，准备正电子轰炸。
entries.en: Very well, ready the positron charges.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员们汇报了试验的成功。[From.From.GetName]上的许多矿脉现在都可以被我们所使用了。
entries.en: The crew of the [Root.GetName] are pleased to report that the experiment was a success, and a significant number of dense mineral veins on [From.From.GetName] have been transmuted into usable resources.

entries.zh: 上下颠倒
entries.en: Up is Down

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]穿过小行星带前往[From.GetName]的路上时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报飞船经历了几次来势突然的重力变化。因为好奇，[Root.GetLeaderName]派遣了无人机前去勘测原因。

结果，无人机发现了几只老旧的外星重力生成器。因为极性反转，电池又不足，这些重力生成器时常会对着虚空放射出反重力波。但其效果不强，无法造成任何实质性的伤害。我们无法将生成器的效果恢复至其原本具有的强度。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些生成器本来是为小行星带中某颗较大的小行星提供人造重力用的，但因为某种故障，这颗小行星已经四分五裂了。
entries.en:
As the [Root.GetName] passed through the asteroid belt on its way to [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reported that the ship experienced a number of sudden gravitational shifts. Ever curious, [Root.GetLeaderName] dispatched a number of probes to scan the debris field to discern the cause.

It turns out that the culprit is a number of gravity generators of old, alien make. Sputtering on dying energy sources and with their polarities inverted, they occasionally spew reverse-gravity into the void, though not with enough force to cause any serious harm. Not anymore.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] theorizes that the generators once provided artificial gravity for a large asteroid in the belt, but some malfunction eventually tore the rock apart.

entries.zh: 这主意真是扰人。
entries.en: A disturbing thought.

entries.zh: 低级错误
entries.en: Careless Pawing

entries.zh: 据[Root.GetName]的船员汇报，他们的任务失败了。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]心血来潮想手动操纵无人机采集矿石样本，结果不小心撞上了矿石，虽然撞击力度并不大，但矿石还是粉碎殆尽了。\n\n船员还提到，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]对此十分内疚，并且那些粉碎的矿石还有些价值。
entries.en: According to a report from the crew of the [Root.GetName], their mission was a failure. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] allegedly took manual control of the probe sent to retrieve a sample from the cluster, resulting in a collision between drone and mineral cluster that, while mild, resulted in the mineral cluster breaking apart completely.\n\nThe crew is careful to note that the experience has left Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] somewhat shaken, and the mineral shards should still be of some value.

entries.zh: 碎了的矿石也还是矿石。
entries.en: Its parts are equal to the sum of its parts.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]无法接受这么粗心的行为。
entries.en: The [Root.Owner.GetName] finds such carelessness unacceptable.

entries.zh: 金色牢笼
entries.en: Gilded Cage

entries.zh:
这块矿物的构造就像是个房间，没有其他更贴切的词能形容了。

构成房间的矿物在[Root.Owner.GetName]十分常用。这块矿石是中空的三十二面体，磁共振扫描显示其内部中空，很可能曾有人居住过。但是矿石内部与其光鲜的外表并不相同，看起来被人破坏的混乱不堪。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称由于这些破坏，我们很难从矿石内部找到有价值的信息。但其建筑的外部结构能够抵御深空压力，其构造技术一定十分先进。
entries.en:
The mineral construct is, for lack of a better term, a room.

Made out of the same type of minerals in common use in the [Root.Owner.GetName], the construct is a hollow icosidodecahedron. Resonance scans indicate that it is mostly hollow, and was likely inhabited at some point in time. Unlike its pristine exterior, the interior is in complete disarray, possibly the result of an intentional act of sabotage.
