Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that this makes it difficult to learn anything of value from the construct's insides, but stresses that the engineering techniques involved in creating the outer shell, eminently capable of withstanding the stresses of deep space, must have been tremendously advanced.

entries.zh: 想不通。
entries.en: Puzzling.

entries.zh: 晶体抄本
entries.en: Crystal Codex

entries.zh: 这块矿石是个全息记录仪，外表棱角分明，呈半透明状。其目前被安全地放置于[Root.GetName]的牵引光束中，但解码其内容仍需假以时日。\n\n已经设立加速该进程的§Y特殊项目§!。
entries.en: The mineral cluster is a holographic record, multi-sided, many-edged, and translucent. It remains secure in the [Root.GetName]'s tractor beam, but our experts will need some time to decode its contents.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to expedite this process.

entries.zh: 肯定没好事。
entries.en: Nothing good would come of it.

entries.zh: 很好。
entries.en: Very well.

entries.zh: 全息记录仪中的数据文档乃是一份曾经称霸此区域的三个大国之间的贸易协议。其中的内容我们无法理解也毫无意义，但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这可以大大提高我们与外星人的沟通能力。
entries.en: The holographic data documents the terms and conditions for a trilateral trade treaty between three major alien powers that once dominated this quadrant of the galaxy. Context eludes us and the details are meaningless, but Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] feels that this find will prove invaluable to improving our own ability to communicate with alien forces.

entries.zh: 外星军营
entries.en: Alien Barracks

entries.zh: 轨道上探查出的影像的确是建筑。进一步调查后发现建筑显然是用于军事用途。虽然被遗弃了一段时间——从星系尺度上看并不算久——但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为从尘土下的废弃军营和空旷的军火库中仍然可以找到外星战术秘密。\n\n已经设立了研究废墟的§Y特殊项目§!。
entries.en: The silhouettes discernible from orbit are indeed buildings, and closer inspection reveal them to be of an obvious martial nature. While abandoned for some time - though very recently on a galactic timescale - Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that secrets of alien tactics may yet be exhumed from beneath the dust that covers the decaying barracks and looted armories.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! may be issued to study the remains.

entries.zh: 了解。
entries.en: Acknowledged.

entries.zh: 既然已经化为废墟，那就不要多管了。
entries.en: That this outpost is dead and buried speaks volumes.

entries.zh: 外星军营
entries.en: Alien Barracks

entries.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]对于[From.From.GetName]进行了详尽的外星历史分析，但最终结果不佳。该兵营早在行星变得贫瘠之前就被建立了，但不知是因为自然原因还是战争原因，才变成了今天这样的废墟。

可以得出的结论是：这些外星人使用的武器与战略并不比我们现在使用的要先进。

不过，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]说自己因为这次勘探，获取了不少灵感。
entries.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s thorough xeno-historical analysis of the military installation on [From.From.GetName] has yielded few tangible results. The base was constructed before the planet turned completely barren, but it is unclear if its current inhospitality is the result of armed conflict or some more peaceful or even natural process.

What can be deduced of their strategies and tactics in armed conflict does not seem to have been far in advance of our own.

On the upside, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] claims to have drawn much inspiration from the alien remnants.

entries.zh: 还是有用的嘛。
entries.en: Always something.

entries.zh: 格子
entries.en: Checkered

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的特殊拓扑结构整齐地将星球划分为无数个不同的群落，各群落的气候以一种微妙的方式维持着周边环境的平衡。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]强烈怀疑这是先进的环境改造的结果，但我们无法解释这是如何做到的。\n\n尽管如此，环境改造的结果对[Root.GetLeaderName]和[Root.GetName]的船员来说显而易见。
entries.en: The unique topology of [From.GetName] neatly divides the planet into innumerable distinct biomes, micro-climates that interact only in subtle ways seemingly engineered to sustain neighboring climes. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] strongly suspects advanced terraforming techniques at work, but few clues remain regarding the process itself.\n\nIts effects, however, remain plainly visible to [Root.GetLeaderName] and the [Root.GetName]'s crew.

entries.zh: 还真有意思。
entries.en: Most intriguing.

entries.zh: 远古自动设施
entries.en: Ancient Automata

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]一处植被非常茂密的地域的中心发现了被植物掩盖的外星建筑，起初我们以为它已被摧毁，但经过[Root.GetName]仔细勘察发现，它还没有被这颗星球上格外茂盛的植物所侵蚀。\n\n已发起§Y特殊项目§!来寻找建筑入口。
entries.en: One of the major areas of extreme verdancy on [From.GetName] is centered on an overgrown alien structure. Initially thought ruined, closer observations by the [Root.GetName] reveal that the building has mostly survived the crushing embrace of the planet's flora.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to find a way into the structure.

entries.zh: 很有意思。
entries.en: Very interesting.

entries.zh:
这座杂草丛生的建筑是外星人的矿物加工厂。位于[From.From.GetName]的工厂尽管早已被废弃，但似乎曾基本实现了自动化，工厂的地上还躺着大量全自动机器人的残骸——他们的身体主要由有机化合物组成，体内以高分子内骨骼作为支撑，现在也一并腐烂了。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为正是这些有机残余物在液化后渗入了地面，使得土壤变得肥沃，星球上的各种植物也才会如此繁茂坚韧。

工厂可以被重新激活，但是[Root.GetLeaderName]感兴趣的那些迷人的，全自动的工人们却再也不能活过来了。
entries.en:
The overgrown structure - an alien mineral processing plant - on [From.From.GetName] was, prior to its abandonment in the distant past, mostly automated. Husks of artificial workers litter the floor, their organic components - for their bodies were largely of a biological nature, held upright by polymer endoskeletons - long since rotted away.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that it is the organic remains of these automatons that, soon liquefied and drained into the ground, provided an intense boost to soil nutrition and allowed the native flora to grow both abundant and resilient.

The plant can be reactivated but the automatons, fascinating as they may be to [Root.GetLeaderName], will never walk its halls again.

entries.zh: 明白了。
entries.en: Understood.

entries.zh: 添加§Y古代工厂§!至[From.GetName]。\n
entries.en: Adds an §YAncient Factory§! to [From.GetName].\n

entries.zh: 临时停泊
entries.en: Hard Shoulder

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]的平原发现了一艘无人船只，其传感器对星球轨道上的[Root.GetName]做出了回应。\n\n[Root.GetName]的船员未能确认此船何时被弃，也不知道此船是何人所弃。至于原船员的下落更是无从调查。根据科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]所说，若想将其收编入我方舰队，远程激活这艘轻装飞船应该不成问题。
entries.en: There is a ship idling on the plains of [From.GetName], its sensors reacting to the [Root.GetName] in orbit around the planet.\n\nThe [Root.GetName]'s crew have been unable to confirm exactly when the craft was abandoned - for it is abandoned - or who left it there, or where they are now. According to Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], remotely activating the lightly armed ship would be trivial, should we wish to add it to our fleets.

entries.zh: 当然，反正也没人要。
entries.en: No one will miss it, surely.

entries.zh: 获得一艘§Y护卫舰§!。
entries.en: Gain a §YCorvette§!-class ship.

entries.zh: 我们既不知道这是哪儿来的，也不知道这玩意要到哪儿去。拆掉吧。
entries.en: We don't know whence it came or where it is going. Dismantle it.

entries.zh: 清点存量
entries.en: Taking Stock

entries.zh:
事实证明，荒芜的[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]毫无有趣之处。

当船员们监视着了无动静的仪器时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]闲来无事查看了[Root.GetName]的能源储备情况。根据他们的报告，[Root.GetName]上次离港时获得的能量补给少于标准量，不过更有可能是[Root.GetLeaderName]对于资源管理的松懈造成了此次窘境。

不管怎么说，这艘船需要更多的能量作为补给。
entries.en:
The desert [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] turned out to be rather unremarkable.

While the crew monitored silent instruments, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] was idly eyeing the [Root.GetName]'s energy reserves. According to their report the [Root.GetName] was issued less than the standard amount of energy when it last left port, but is more likely that [Root.GetLeaderName]'s carefree approach to resource management is to blame for the deficit.

Regardless, the ship does need additional Energy Credits.

entries.zh:
事实证明，荒芜的[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]毫无有趣之处。

当船员们监视着了无动静的仪器时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]对[Root.GetName]的能源储备进行了认真盘点。根据他们的报告，[Root.GetName]上次离港时获得的能量补给多于标准量，这很可能是书写错误造成的。

[Root.Leader.GetName]已提出要自愿将多余的能量交还给[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]当局。
entries.en:
The desert [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] turned out to be rather unremarkable.

While the crew monitored silent instruments, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] was conscientiously taking inventory of the [Root.GetName]'s energy reserves. According to their report the [Root.GetName] was issued more than the standard amount of energy when it last left port, probably due to some clerical error.

[Root.Leader.GetName] has volunteered to return the excess to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] authorities.

entries.zh: 意外的收获。
entries.en: Unexpected windfall.

entries.zh: 果然不出所料。
entries.en: Typical.

entries.zh: 被流放的海盗
entries.en: Pirate Exiles

entries.zh: 我们误以为是矿物簇的物体实际上是两艘外星护卫舰的金属外壳，它们正悄悄飘过小行星带。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已经与其建立联系，这两艘船的船员自称他们以前都是海盗，现在被首领放逐了。他们听说[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]是[Root.Owner.GetName]的统治者，为人亲民，特来寻求庇护。
entries.en: What was thought to be a cluster of minerals are the metal hulls of two alien corvettes, stealthily drifting through the asteroid belt.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] established contact, and the two ships are crewed by alleged former pirates, now cast out from their robber-clan. They have heard whispers that [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName] is a champion of the people, and seek asylum.

entries.zh: 我们误以为是矿脉的物体实际上是两艘外星护卫舰的金属外壳，它们正悄悄飘过小行星带。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已经与其建立联系，这两艘船的船员自称他们以前都是海盗，现在被匪帮首领放逐了。很神奇的是，他们相信我们会妥善对待他们，因此特来寻求庇护。
entries.en: What was thought to be a cluster of minerals are the metal hulls of two alien corvettes, stealthily drifting through the asteroid belt.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] established contact, and the two ships are crewed by alleged former pirates, now cast out from their robber-clan. Curiously, they believe that we will be well-disposed towards them, and are seeking asylum.

entries.zh: 他们可以派上用场。
entries.en: They can make themselves useful.

entries.zh: 收编被放逐的海盗并获得两艘§Y护卫舰§!。
entries.en: Enlist the exiled pirates and gain two §YCorvette§!-class ships.

entries.zh: 我们不需要他们的帮忙。把他们的东西都没收，只留他们一条命吧。
entries.en: We do not need their services. Take what they have but their lives.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]不能容忍他们这种家伙存在。
entries.en: The [Root.Owner.GetName] will not suffer the existence of their kind.

entries.zh: 被放逐的海盗变为敌对状态！
entries.en: The exiled pirates turn hostile!

entries.zh: 我们必须拒绝他们的避难请求。
entries.en: We must deny their asylum claim.

entries.zh: 刺耳格栅
entries.en: Grinding Lattice

entries.zh: [From.GetName]遍布着此起彼伏的矿物复合带，用高耸且富有弹性的架子高悬于其本就十分崎岖的表面上。由于经常受到气流的扰动，摆动的架子和层叠的带状物互相摩擦，产生了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无法听到的声波。\n\n科研专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称将此声波从星球的背景噪音中分离出来时遇到了困难，同时也提出如果有意进行开采，建议将矿物带破坏，从而由[Root.Owner.GetName]进行回收利用。
entries.en: [From.GetName] is crisscrossed by overlapping mineral-composite bands that are elevated above the harsh surface by tall, flexible pylons. Constantly agitated by atmospheric winds, these pylons sway and the overlapping bands rub together to produce sonic waves at what are - to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - inaudible frequencies.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports some difficulty in isolating this audio from the natural background noise of the planet, but notes that the mineral bands could - should we so choose - be broken down and efficiently recycled by the [Root.Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: 将声音分离出来并进行研究。
entries.en: Isolate and study the alien sounds.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]：\n£society£§G+9§!
entries.en: [From.GetName]:\n£society£ §G+9§!

entries.zh: 准备回收矿物带。
entries.en: Make preparations for salvaging the mineral bands.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]：\n£minerals£§G+6§!
entries.en: [From.GetName]:\n£minerals£ §G+6§!

entries.zh: 森林国度
entries.en: Wooden Hegemony

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]是一颗生态丰富的热带星球。对其表面植被的近距离分析却表明其生物异常缺乏多样性，一种特殊的高大树木成为了生态系统的主体部分。

虽说这种树木本身并不会造成什么危害，但其单一的主导地位却会对该星球小型动物的生存带来不利影响，若要进行殖民，想在其表面有效率地培育农作物也会异常困难。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]作为享有盛誉的外星生物学专家，制定了重新平衡此星球生态系统的计划。
entries.en:
[From.GetName] is a tropical planet with a thriving biosphere. A close analysis of surface flora reveals an unexpected lack of diversity, as one particular family of tall trees dominate the ecosystem.

Though not harmful in and of themselves, their monocultural hegemony appears to have a detrimental effect on the survivability of the planet's small animals, and it would be difficult to efficiently cultivate food crops on the surface should colonization ever be attempted.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], a xeno-biologist of some repute, has put together a plan for re-balancing this alien biosphere.

entries.zh: 同意该计划。
entries.en: Approve the plan.

entries.zh: 添加§Y生态失衡§!修正至[From.GetName]：\n£food£§R-20%§!\n
entries.en: Adds the §YUnbalanced Ecosystem§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\n£food£ §R-20%§!\n

entries.zh: 还是保持原状吧。
entries.en: Leave the planet be.

entries.zh: 添加§Y生态失衡§!修正至[From.GetName]：\n£food£§R-20%§!
entries.en: Adds the §YUnbalanced Ecosystem§! modifier to [From.GetName]:\n£food£ §R-20%§!

entries.zh: 平衡已恢复了——或许是首次达到了。[Root.GetName]的放射射线消除了长久以来覆盖了这颗星球的那些多年生木本植物的繁殖能力。还有一些树木被彻底烧成了灰烬，以求尽快达到真正的平衡。
entries.en: Balance has been restored - or perhaps achieved for the first time - as large swathes of the dominant perennials have been rendered infertile by targeted radiation emissions from the [Root.GetName]. Additional specimens have been reduced to ash to further hasten the arrival of a truer equilibrium.

entries.zh: 激进地消灭一直以来覆盖着[From.From.GetName]的树木造成了意想不到的后果。\n\n之前被这些树木搞得生计艰难的小动物们数量急剧上升，也越发富有攻击意愿——或者说是变得更加野蛮了。被隔离开来的焦土曾是茂密森林的所在，现在却成了领地争端的战场。
entries.en: The inelegant elimination of wide swathes of the dominant trees on [From.From.GetName] have had unintended consequences.\n\nThe small animals that previously suffered under the perennial tyranny of the trees are growing both more plentiful and more aggressive - some would say savage. The isolated ashen fields that used to be home to lush forests now play host to heated territory battles.

entries.zh: 也许我们本不该介入的。
entries.en: Perhaps we should have known better than to meddle.

entries.zh: §R危险野生动物§!现已遍布[From.From.GetName]。
entries.en: §RDangerous Wildlife§! now roams [From.From.GetName].

entries.zh: 金砂藏舰
entries.en: Head in the Sand

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称，我们犯了个愚蠢的错误，在[From.GetName]沙漠看到的沙海涟漪其实是启动的飞船推进器造成的。\n\n有一艘外星飞船头朝下埋没在沙海中，其断断续续工作的推进系统在上方的沙丘激起了阵阵波涛。看来这玩意已经困在这里有段时间了，它在推进器的作用下渐渐插进了沙丘深处。[Root.GetName]没有能够将此船吊出的设备与方法，[Root.GetLeaderName]建议派遣一只飞船到[From.GetName]，以对其进行发掘。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the waves seen rippling across the sandy seas of [From.GetName] are, bizarrely enough, the result of active ship thrusters.\n\nAn alien vessel lies buried in the sand nose-down, its sputtering propulsion systems weakly agitating the dunes above. It appears to have been down there for some time, slowly driving itself deeper into the desert dunes. The [Root.GetName] lacks the means to excavate the struggling ship, and [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends sending a military vessel to [From.GetName] to unearth it.

entries.zh: 了解。
entries.en: Acknowledged.

entries.zh: 这么明显的陷阱，我们可不会上当。
entries.en: We will not take the obvious bait.

entries.zh: 任何剩余的有机生物都将被消灭。
entries.en: If there are any organics left they will be terminated.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]终于成功将外星飞船打捞了出来。

但它是空的，或者可以说，被拆的什么都没剩了。

原船员一定是将不是很重要的东西全拆掉后便弃船而去，留下这艘空壳在[From.From.GetName]沉没。[Root.GetFleetName]的工程师忙活了好一阵子，终于将其能量补充完毕并重启了飞船。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] eventually succeeds in raising the submerged alien vessel.

It is empty. Almost stripped bare, in fact.

Its crew must have abandoned ship before it was left to burrow into the particulate surface of [From.From.GetName], and they took most of the ship's non-critical internals with them. The engineers of the [Root.GetFleetName] have managed to essentially hotwire the vessel, and have replenished its dwindling energy stores.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]舰队有了新成员。
entries.en: A fresh commission for the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] fleet.

entries.zh: 获得一艘§Y护卫舰§!。
entries.en: Gain a §YCorvette§!-class ship.

entries.zh: [Root.GetFleetName]使用高强度拉索最终成功打捞起了沉没的外星飞船，却同时也听到了其武器系统启动的轰鸣声！
entries.en: The [Root.GetFleetName]'s high-tensile wires eventually managed to raise the submerged alien vessel, only to be met by the recognizable whirring of weapons systems powering up!

entries.zh: 快回避！
entries.en: Evasive maneuvers!

entries.zh: §Y“鸵鸟号”§!发起了进攻！
entries.en: The §YOstrich§! attacks!

entries.zh: 回收行动失败了。[Root.GetFleetName]绕在舰船上的高强度拉索在向上提拉时的瞬间就将腐蚀殆尽的舰体切成了数段。\n\n单独的碎块回收起来还相对容易，但整个飞船已变成了废铁。
entries.en: The salvage attempt failed. The high-tensile tethers that the [Root.GetFleetName] had wrapped around the burrowing ship effortlessly sliced through the vessel's corroded hull as raising was attempted.\n\nThe individual pieces were then relatively easy to retrieve, but the whole thing is reduced to scrap.

entries.zh: 又搞砸了。
entries.en: Bungled again.

entries.zh: 无效通讯
entries.en: Illicit Communications

entries.zh: 一个拼凑的通讯中继器被很外行地绑在了[From.GetName]上。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这是海盗通信网络的一部分。初步分析表明通信内容并不包含什么敏感的战术信息，只是些海盗船船员间的寻常通话。
entries.en: A cobbled-together comms repeater has been inexpertly strapped to [From.GetName].\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is confident that this is part of a relay network for pirate communications. Initial analysis indicates that the messages relayed are not of a particularly strategically sensitive nature, but rather private inter-ship communications between individual crewmembers.

entries.zh: 也许我们可以一窥深空的生活。
entries.en: Perhaps we can learn something about life in deep space.

entries.zh: 也许我们可以一窥深空的生活。
entries.en: Perhaps we can learn something useful about life in deep space.

entries.zh: 付诸东流
entries.en: Down the Drain

entries.zh:
读数来自于一个小型金属舱，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]判定这是一艘远古外星救生艇。

这东西显然是许久以前就被黑洞外围的引力井困在此处，因为角度问题无法弹射出来——至于这是故意为之还是偶然至此尚不得而知——救生艇的推进器从那时起就一直在竭力逃离黑洞视界。目前它已离黑洞视界太近，无法进行回收了。

[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告突然中断，随后[Root.GetName]船员发来通讯称，该科学专员浑身颤抖，似乎是对此救生艇的悲惨命运感到十分难过。
entries.en:
The readings originate from a small metal pod; Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has determined it to be a lifeboat of ancient and alien make.

Evidently caught on the outskirts of the black hole's gravity well eons ago, at an angle just short of a slingshot maneuver - whether this was the intent or happenstance is difficult to judge - and the pod's automated thrusters have been fighting its descent to the event horizon ever since. It is now too close to the horizon to salvage.

[Root.GetLeaderName]'s report ends abruptly, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] communicate that the Science Officer appears shaken and deeply troubled by the tragic fate of the lifeboat.

entries.zh:
读数来自于一个小型金属舱，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]判定这是一艘远古外星救生艇。

这东西显然是许久以前就被黑洞外围的引力井困在此处，因为角度问题无法弹射出来——至于这是故意为之还是偶然至此尚不得而知——救生艇的推进器从那时起就一直在竭力逃离黑洞视界。目前它已离黑洞视界太近，无法进行回收了。

[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告突然中断，随后[Root.GetName]船员发来通讯称，该科学专员似乎深受这一新数据的影响，因其已显著改变了[Root.GetName]的风险评估统计与生存率预测。
entries.en:
The readings originate from a small metal pod; Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has determined it to be a lifeboat of ancient and alien make.

Evidently caught on the outskirts of the black hole's gravity well eons ago, at an angle just short of a slingshot maneuver - whether this was the intent or happenstance is difficult to judge - and the pod's automated thrusters have been fighting its descent to the event horizon ever since. It is now too close to the horizon to salvage.

[Root.GetLeaderName]'s report ends abruptly, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] communicate that the Science Officer appears deeply affected by this new data, as it has significantly altered the [Root.GetName]'s risk assessment statistics and survival rate predictions.

entries.zh: 可以理解。
entries.en: Understandable.

entries.zh: 零散辐射
entries.en: Peddling Radiation

entries.zh:
惊人的是，此系统获取的数据居然是来自[From.GetName]本身。

作为黑洞来说，其体积较小，似乎可以解释为何会有辐射从其视界逃逸出来。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为此黑洞正在崩解，不久便会消失，但很难说这个过程会不会在宇宙的热寂之前完成。

用[Root.GetLeaderName]的话说，黑洞幼年期受到的重力扰动搞得它“动荡不安”，从而进一步加强了其视界流出的能源。
entries.en:
The readings picked up in the this system come - somewhat surprisingly - from [From.GetName] itself.

As black holes go it is fairly small, which could account for some of the unexpected radiation leaking from its event horizon. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that the black hole is on its way to "bleeding out" and will eventually disappear entirely - though it is difficult to say whether this process would be complete before the heat death of the universe.

Some gravitational upset in the hole's youth has rendered it - to quote [Root.GetLeaderName] - "wobbly," further increasing the flow of energy from its event horizon.

entries.zh: 我们可以从中学到很多东西。
entries.en: There is much we could learn.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]：\n£physics£§G+9§!
entries.en: [From.GetName]:\n£physics£ §G+9§!

entries.zh: 玩具工厂
entries.en: Toy Factory

entries.zh:
虽说[From.GetName]上的大部分建筑都已成废墟，但还有少数得以留存。[Root.GetName]初次经过该星球时只发现了一座还算完整的建筑，孤零零地耸立在[From.GetName]的废墟之中。

这便是噪音的来源。

该建筑不仅结构完整，据科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]称，似乎还存在活动迹象。

那是一座生产设施，专门将塑料聚合物制成不明的物体，不过似乎是用于装饰的。其生产原料与最终产品对[Root.Owner.GetName]来说没有研究价值，但我们可以对其自动化的生产过程进行研究。
entries.en:
There are structures on [From.GetName], though most are less than ruins and more akin to rubble. The [Root.GetName]'s initial pass over the planet reveals only one building that can be considered intact, seemingly spared whatever calamity robbed [From.GetName] of its buildings and builders alike.

This is the source of the noise.

Not only is the building intact, reports Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], but it is active.

It is a production facility of some sort, turning plasticine polymers into mute objects of uncertain, but possibly ornamental, purpose. The raw materials and end product are largely uninteresting to the [Root.Owner.GetName], but we could doubtlessly stand to learn something from the automated manufacturing process itself.

entries.zh: 也许我们应该建立据点并进行观察。
entries.en: Perhaps we should establish a foothold and observe.

entries.zh: 添加一座§Y外星玩具工厂§!至[From.GetName]。
entries.en: Adds an §YAlien Toy Factory§! to [From.GetName].\n

entries.zh: 《君主论》
entries.en: The Prince

entries.zh: 巨大的[From.GetName]周围的缓轨道上漂浮着一个可移动的数据库。[Root.GetName]将其打捞后发现其中似乎包含某种外星语言写就的内容。其词汇组成并非完全陌生，但其语法则是十分复杂。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议对其进行进一步研究，以便解密该文本的内容与起源。
entries.en: In gentle orbit around the massive [From.GetName] floats a portable databank. Scooped up by the [Root.GetName], it is found to contain text in some alien language. The vocabulary is not wholly unfamiliar, but the syntax is disconcertingly complex.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends a more thorough study to decipher the text's contents and origins.

entries.zh: 在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上进行分析。
entries.en: Analyze it on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 不用管它。
entries.en: Leave it.

entries.zh: 《君主论》通读本
entries.en: The Prince, Legible

entries.zh: 该文本的标题大致可以译为“地区统治者”，通篇似乎是以[book_writer.GetSpeciesAdj]古方言写就，该方言一般使用于[book_writer.GetName]。\n\n内容无疑对他们具有一定历史价值，搞不好还能带来些什么启发。
entries.en: The text - its title roughly translates to "Regional Ruler" - is written in a presumably ancient dialect of the [book_writer.GetSpeciesAdj] tongue spoken in the [book_writer.GetName].\n\nThe text is doubtlessly of some historical import to them, and might contain valuable insights.

entries.zh: 这秘密还是不要说出去了——不需要让他们知道的。
entries.en: Let us divine its secrets - they need not know.

entries.zh: 我们要物归原主。联络他们。
entries.en: We will return it to its proper owners. Hail them.

entries.zh: 他们的文笔如此空洞，思维自然也不堪一击。联络他们。
entries.en: Their prose is pedestrian, their ideas weak. Hail them.

entries.zh: [book_writer.GetName]
entries.en: [book_writer.GetName]

entries.zh:
我们听说你找到了《君主论》的最后一份拷贝。这可是我们社会十分重要的历史文化遗产。
我们曾以为它已在多年前的海盗袭击中被毁掉了，但它如今能落入文明人的手中，我们倍感欣慰。

可以将其交还给我们吗？我们会以能量币作为报酬。
entries.en:
We understand that you have found the only surviving copy of "The Prince," a text of significant historical and cultural importance to our people.
We thought it irrevocably lost to a pirate raid years ago, but we are grateful to see that it found its way into civilized hands.

Will you return it to us? We will gladly transfer some Energy Credits for your trouble.

entries.zh: 当然可以。
entries.en: But of course.

entries.zh: [book_writer.GetName]
entries.en: [book_writer.GetName]

entries.zh:
我们听说你找到了《君主论》的最后一份拷贝。这可是我们社会十分重要的历史文化遗产。

我们曾以为它已在多年前的海盗袭击中被毁掉了，但它如今能落入文明人的手中，我们倍感欣慰。

可以将其交还给我们吗？
entries.en:
We understand that you have found the only surviving copy of "The Prince," a text of significant historical and cultural importance to our people.

We thought it irrevocably lost to a pirate raid years ago, but we are grateful to see that it found its way into civilized hands.

Will you return it to us?

entries.zh: 不。说起来，我们认为这东西不怎么样。
entries.en: No. In fact, we think it is bad.

entries.zh: 不。这些文字正是骗子的工具。
entries.en: No. The written word is the tool of liars.

entries.zh: 带着你的书一起下地狱吧。
entries.en: You and your words will be destroyed.

entries.zh: [book_writer.GetName]
entries.en: [book_writer.GetName]

entries.zh: 绝不容许你批判我们的文学！\n\n你们会后悔的！
entries.en: You can't criticize our literature!\n\nYou will regret this!

entries.zh: 哼，一群书虫。
entries.en: Heh, bookworms.

entries.zh: 可怜的有机生物。
entries.en: Pitiful organics.

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：紧急信标
entries.en: The Ransomeers: Emergency Buoy

entries.zh:
在[From.GetName]和缓的运行轨道上竟漂浮着一枚紧急信标。其外壳已被严重损坏，似乎是被武器火力击中或是被大爆炸波及。

这似乎是来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的民用飞船专属型号——用于在通讯系统故障时作为紧急措施进行发射——但其受损的严重程度使具体情况都不得而知了。

它一直在重复一个微弱而失真的信号。
entries.en:
An emergency transmission buoy floats in gentle orbit around [From.GetName]. Its outer casing is heavily damaged, seemingly by glancing weapons fire or a powerful explosion.

It might be a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] model for civilian ships - designed to be ejected as an emergency measure should the comms systems fail - but the extent of the damage makes it impossible to know for certain.

It is repeating a weak, distorted signal.

entries.zh: 调查传输信号。
entries.en: Clean up the transmission.

entries.zh: 也许是陷阱——最好不要以身犯险。
entries.en: It could be a trap - best leave it be.

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：SOS
entries.en: The Ransomeers: SOS

entries.zh: 信标已确定来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]，其发射的信号已趋于稳定。
entries.en: The buoy has been verified as one of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] make, and the signal it's relaying has been stabilized.

entries.zh: 这里是[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。请亮明身份。
entries.en: [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] authorities. Identify yourselves.

entries.zh: 打开通讯系统。
entries.en: Open comms.

entries.zh: 彻底关掉。这件事到此为止。
entries.en: Shut it down. No one is to speak of this.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives

entries.zh: 有、有人吗？这里是[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]民用运输船“卢克西昂号”的舰长。\n\n啊，应该说是前舰长。卢克西昂已经不复存在了。我们被海盗登船，我们在飞船爆炸前就被掳走成了人质。
entries.en: He- hello? This is the captain of the Luxion, a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] civilian transport.\n\nUh, former captain. The Luxion is gone. We were boarded by pirates and taken captive before they blew up the ship.

entries.zh: 你们是被谁抓了？
entries.en: Who captured you?

entries.zh: 他们……我、我听他们好像自称星际什么来着？星际绑架者是吧？\n\n他们可不是善茬。如果他们认为不能从[Root.GetName]手中得到些什么来换取我们的性命就会干掉我们。我偷听到他们已经在讨论要开什么条件了……
entries.en: They, I- I think they call themselves the ransomers? The Ransomeers?\n\nAt any rate they're a vile bunch, we'd all be dead already if they didn't think they could get something for us from the [Root.GetName]. I've overhead them discussing their demands...

entries.zh: 我们不会救你们的。
entries.en: We will not rescue you.

entries.zh: 我们会来救你们的。
entries.en: We will rescue you.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives

entries.zh: 什么？什么？！你们不能见死不救！\n\n要是他们认为不能用我们向[Root.GetName]索取赎金的话，绝对会连眼都不眨就宰了我们的！就连真的付了赎金的话我们的性命也没有保障啊！你们不能——
entries.en: What? What? You can't. You can't not save us!\n\nIf they get it into their heads that they won't be able to ransom us back to the [Root.GetName] they won't hesitate to kill us. They'll probably kill us even if the ransom is paid! You can't--

entries.zh: 永别了。
entries.en: Farewell.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives

entries.zh: 哦，真是太感谢了，太感谢了啊！[Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们似乎被关在某个空间站，但具体位置我也不知道。\n\n我这就加强传输频率，你们应该可以通过紧急信标进行三角测量，确认我们被绑架的位置……
entries.en: Oh thank you! Thank you, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We're being held in some space station, but I have no idea where we are beyond that.\n\nI will increase the transmission burst now, it should let you triangulate the location of this prison from the emergency buoy...

entries.zh: 位置已记录于情报日志。
entries.en: Position recorded in the Situation Log.

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：最佳计划
entries.en: The Ransomeers: Best Laid Plans

entries.zh: 虽说海盗的基地十分隐蔽，但若知道如何寻找的话就十分明显了。\n\n一支舰队排着奇怪的队形慢慢从重新运行的采矿设施后慢悠悠飘了出来——显然是并没想到会有不速之客。
entries.en: The pirate base, while fairly inconspicuous, is obvious when you know what to look for.\n\nA fleet in confused formation slowly drifts out from behind the re-purposed mining complex - they were obviously not expecting company.

entries.zh: 打开通讯系统。必须让被囚者做好准备。
entries.en: Open comms. The captives need to be ready.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives

entries.zh:
你好啊，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。看来这一切都是因为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的飞船而起的了？

我们好客的主人们似乎即将离开他们当前的位置。登上这地方对各方都不利，但是……如果你直接对基地发起攻击，我觉得我们倒是可以拼一拼，看看能不能弄到一艘救生艇。

我们出来的时候可别把我们给炸飞了！
entries.en:
Hello again, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. I take it [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships are the cause of all this commotion?

Our hosts seem about ready to leave their posts. Boarding this place would probably end badly for everyone involved, but... If you attack the base directly, I think we can make a break for one of the lifeboats.

Please try not to blow us up on our way out!

entries.zh: 很好。
entries.en: Very well.

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：尘归尘，土归土
entries.en: The Ransomeers: Dust and Echoes

entries.zh: 索取赎金的海盗们的基地被摧毁了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的俘虏们也一道消失了。俘虏们似乎成功联系到了发动进攻的外星飞船，却被对方忽视了。
entries.en: The Ransomeer pirate base has been destroyed, and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] prisoners along with it. It appears the captives managed to hail the alien ships that attacked, but were ignored.

entries.zh: 我们绝不会忘记这个悲剧。
entries.en: We will never forget this tragedy.

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：意外的救星
entries.en: The Ransomeers: Unexpected Saviors

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。\n\n[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏在交战中成功逃出，目前已登上一艘救生艇，即将与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]救援飞船接头。
entries.en: Military action by the [From.From.GetName] has destroyed the Ransomeer forces.\n\nThe [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives made a successful escape attempt during the attack, and are now safely on board a lifeboat well on its way to be a rendezvous [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] rescue vessels.

entries.zh: 我们对此感激不尽。
entries.en: We are eternally grateful.

entries.zh: 生俘
entries.en: Live Captives

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：质疑
entries.en: The Ransomeers: Assailed

entries.zh: 不知何方发起的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。\n\n[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏们奇迹般地逃出生天，在攻击行动中偷去了一艘救生艇，即将返回[Root.Capital.GetName]。
entries.en: Military action by an unknown force destroyed the Ransomeer pirates.\n\nMiraculously, the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives managed to break out and steal a lifeboat during the attack, and are now well on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 真是神秘而偶然的遭遇啊。
entries.en: Most fortuitous, and mysterious.

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：捡拾碎片
entries.en: The Ransomeers: Picking Up the Pieces

entries.zh: 海盗的基地在我方飞船造成的连锁效应中缓慢地分崩离析。与此同时，我们开始了对卢克西昂号生还者的搜索。\n\n如果他们真的上了救生艇，现在也该联络我们了……
entries.en: As the pirate base slowly tears itself apart in a savage chain reaction instigated by our military vessels, the search for the captive crew of the Luxion begins.\n\nIf they made it to a lifeboat, they should be attempting to hail us by now...

entries.zh: 扫描所有频率。
entries.en: Scan all frequencies.

entries.zh: 已解救[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏
entries.en: Freed [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]，这里是卢西安号的船员。\n\n计划进行得十分顺利。在你们展开对基地的袭击后，卫兵们都跑上船了，于是我们也成功破坏了囚室大门。救生艇无人看守，看来你们给这群海盗造成了不小的麻烦，完全没人注意到我们逃跑了。
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle], this is the crew of the Luxion.\n\nThe plan went off without a hitch. Once you started bombarding the base directly, the guards took to their ships, and we were able to break down the cell door. The lifeboats were unguarded, and it seems you kept the pirates busy enough that they did not care much about our escape.

entries.zh: 欢迎回家，脱狱者。
entries.en: Welcome home, jailbreakers.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives

Hel-


-re no lifeboats, we-


-andoned, collapse im-





------------------------

entries.zh: 舰长？
entries.en: Captain?

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：化为灰烬
entries.en: The Ransomeers: Smoke and Ashes

entries.zh: 被关押的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]最终未能逃出海盗基地。我们并未能确认他们到底是如何死亡的——是救生艇未能成功发射，还是他们压根没有逃出囚室——但这不妨碍我们确认他们已死亡的事实。\n\n[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]们一定会十分感激[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]采取的迅速行动，但感觉他们短时间内也不会遗忘这出惨剧。
entries.en: The kidnapped [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] never made it off the pirate base. We are unable to determine exactly where they met their end - if the lifeboat failed to launch, or if they never made it out of their holding cell - but fact remains that they are dead.\n\nThe [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people are sure to appreciate the swift actions undertaken by the [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the [Root.GetName], but they are also unlikely to soon forget this tragedy.

entries.zh: 确实如此……
entries.en: Indeed...

entries.zh: 星际绑架者：一切都好？
entries.en: The Ransomeers: All's Well?

entries.zh:
卢克西昂号的船员安全的回到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，一场灾难就此避免，[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]的果断行动让[Root.GetAdj]人民十分自豪。

海盗的绑架勒索事件已经成功划上句点，海盗团也被消灭了，但还有一些事没搞清楚，比如被俘虏的人声称他们在被抓后曾经从飞船窗口中看到了更大型的海盗舰队。从目前情况来看，可以确定威胁比我们实际看到的还要大的多。

进行这次勒索行动的家伙们已经被处理了。
entries.en:
With the crew of the Luxion safely on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName], disaster has been averted. The [Root.GetAdj] people are sure to glory in the decisive actions of the [Root.GetName]'s [Root.GetRulerTitle].

The situation with the kidnapping Ransomeer pirates, as well as the pirate band itself, has come to an end. Some questions remain, mainly relating to the much larger piratical navy the captives claim to have seen through portholes shortly after their capture. But, considering the circumstances, it can safely be assumed that the threat appeared to be much greater than it actually was.

The Ransomeers are over and done with.

entries.zh: 发人深省……
entries.en: I wonder...

entries.zh: 关于过去的信号
entries.en: Of Transmissions Past

entries.zh:
不出所料，[Root.GetName]成功定位了[From.GetName]信号的来源。

虽说整颗星球看似完全未被外星生物开发过，不过星球南半球一座山丘顶部却发现了一座光滑的白色矿物柱体。信号正是从该柱体中发出，柱体也明显是为了避免共振而设计。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已停下手边工作，开始筹备§Y特殊项目§!，以期能够解密该信号携带的信息。
entries.en:
As expected, the [Root.GetName] has located the source of the transmission emanating from [From.GetName].

While the planet is otherwise seemingly untouched by alien hands, a lone monolith of some sleek off-white mineral stands atop a hill in the southern hemisphere. It is from within this monument that the signal emerges, the enclosure clearly built for longevity rather than resonance.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has gone out of their way to establish the parameters for a §YSpecial Project§! that would decode the information the signal carries.

entries.zh: 不错的提议。
entries.en: An appropriate initiative.

entries.zh: 死人的话有什么好听的。
entries.en: We have little to gain by listening to the dead.

entries.zh: 拆除柱体，寻找发射器。
entries.en: Raze the monument, find the transmitter.

entries.zh: 湮灭的信号
entries.en: Of Transmissions Crushed

entries.zh: 我们原以为所发现的巨石只是发射器的保护性外壳，但事实并非如此。\n\n在被单独取出后，发射器本身毫无用处。已被摧毁的巨石有某种内部结构，能够使其运转。现在我们已经无法恢复其功能了。
entries.en: We believed the monolith to be only a protective housing for the transmitter, but we were wrong.\n\nThe transmitter, once isolated, turned out to be useless on its own. Something about the internal structure of the now-razed monolith made it work, and we have no hope of restoring its function.

entries.zh: 令人失望。
entries.en: Disappointing.

entries.zh: 出人意料，巨石很轻易地就被解体。与最初的猜想相反，其中心的小型发射器为巨石的矿质结构供能，使得信号发射得以进行。
entries.en: The monolith disassembles with surprising ease. Contrary to earlier assumptions, the tiny transmitter at its center energizes the mineral structure of the monolith, enabling the transmission.

entries.zh: 真是有趣。
entries.en: Interesting.

entries.zh: 很不幸，这算不上什么新闻。
entries.en: Old news, unfortunately.

entries.zh: 被解密的信号
entries.en: Of Transmissions Decoded

entries.zh:
科学专员[From.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.From.GetName]发出的信号已经解密完成了。

这是一段记录性质的信息，记载了千年前一场造成数百人死亡的战斗。一支原本坚定的联盟由于背叛与欺骗最终分崩离析，他们的大型舰队在敌人到来之前就自相残杀殆尽。

看来这些残骸作为墓碑被保留在了这里。敌人精准地命中了舰体的弱点，而船员们在那个时候就被消灭了。
entries.en:
Science Officer [From.GetLeaderName] reports that the signal broadcast by the transmission beacon on [From.From.GetName] has been decoded.

It is a memorial message, decrying the loss of hundreds of lives in a battle millennia past. A stalwart alliance apparently fell victim to treachery and deceit, and a massive fleet wiped itself out before the enemy had even arrived, as ally turned on ally.

Apparently these desiccated hulks were left in place as floating grave-markers, the crews having been destroyed by surgical strikes to weak points in their ships' hulls.

entries.zh: 研究这些记录。
entries.en: Study these records.

entries.zh: 计算舰队残骸的轨道与当前位置。
entries.en: Calculate the wrecked fleet's trajectory and current position.

entries.zh: 海盗暗涌
entries.en: Of Pirates Current

entries.zh:
到达[From.GetName]星系后，显而易见，[Root.GetName]来得太迟了。

不久前一支来路不明的海盗舰队发现了这片战场并将其拆除，用所得的材料在附近一颗小行星上建立了基地。

我们的研究宣告结束，看来一场好斗冲突已不可避免。
entries.en:
Upon arriving in the [From.GetName] system, it becomes clear that the [Root.GetName] is too late.

A pirate fleet of unknown origin discovered the straying battlefield some time ago, and cannibalized it to build a base on a nearby asteroid.

Our search ends, as a violent confrontation seems unavoidable.

entries.zh: 漂流的舰队
entries.en: Of Fleets Drifting

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]已找到了[From.GetName]星系内漂移的残骸。信息中提到的飞船许多已在长年侵蚀下化为尘埃，但仍有少数保存得相当完整。

其中有六艘可以让工程师进行抢修。

打开§Y情报日志§!以查看详情。
entries.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the drifting wrecks in the [From.GetName] system. Many of the ships referenced in the memorial beacon message have been reduced to dust and ashes over the centuries, but a few still remain remarkably intact.

Between them, six military vessels should have enough engineers to restore the better-preserved hulks to working order.

Consult the §YSituation Log§! for details.

entries.zh: 还真有意思。
entries.en: Most intriguing.

entries.zh: 征用舰队
entries.en: Of Fleets Commandeered

entries.zh: 部分古代舰队残骸已恢复运转，尽管派去的工程师无法对如何完成这一点达成一致。\n\n舰队已经收编入[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]舰队。
entries.en: The ancient rag-tag armada has been partially resurrected, although the dispatched engineers cannot agree on exactly how this feat was accomplished.\n\nThe vessels have been commissioned into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] fleets.

entries.zh: §Y古代联合舰队§!已修复。
entries.en: The §YAncient Alliance fleet§! is restored.\n

entries.zh: 舰队启动
entries.en: Of Fleets Turned

entries.zh:
工程师们首先将精力放在了大型无畏舰上。根据存储信号显示，这是整场战斗中最先对其它飞船发起攻击的几艘船之一。

然而事实证明这是个错误。

尽管我们已经有意尝试绕过飞船的高级系统，但飞船的电脑最终还是突然启动，并以高频脉冲攻击了我方飞船。由于我方为了增加行动可用带宽而在此之前关闭了战斗防火墙，这段高频脉冲便立即将附近所有我方飞船控制为己有。通讯切断前的最后几篇日志显示，飞船的所有生命支持系统均已失效，飞船被设置为前往[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]。

据推测，我方船员已全体阵亡。古代作战计算机也瞄准了我们的母星，我们得提前做好最坏的打算。
entries.en:
The engineering corps focused first on the massive dreadnought, indicated by the memorial signal to have been one of the first ships to turn on the others in that fated battle.

This turned out to be a mistake.

Despite conscious efforts to bypass the higher-level systems, the ship's computer suddenly came online and blasted our ships with a high-frequency pulse. With combat firewalls disabled to increase bandwidth during the operation, the burst transmission instantly slaved all nearby vessels to the reactivated dreadnought. The final logs before all transmissions were cut shows all life support systems being systematically disabled, and a course plotted for [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

With our crews presumed dead and an ancient combat computer setting its sights on our homeworld, we had best prepare for the worst.

entries.zh: 舰队被毁
entries.en: Of Fleets Destroyed

entries.zh: 无畏舰被摧毁，其余飞船已激活，事件结束
entries.en: dreadnought killed, event ends with remaining ships being activated

entries.zh: 舰队被毁
entries.en: Of Fleets Destroyed

entries.zh: 无畏舰被他人摧毁，其余飞船全部被毁
entries.en: dreadnought killed by others, all remaining ships destroyed

entries.zh: 剿灭海盗
entries.en: Of Pirates Destroyed

entries.zh: 威胁已被终结。或许，我们至少能部分利用起被海盗抢走的古老科技。
entries.en: The threat is ended. We might, at least, be able to make some use of the ancient technology the pirates plundered.

entries.zh: 但疑问尚未解开……
entries.en: But questions remain...

entries.zh: $anomaly.3120.a$
entries.en: $anomaly.3120.a$

entries.zh: 古代工厂
entries.en: Ancient Manufactory

entries.zh: 该轨道站似乎曾作为小行星的矿物开采与加工中心使用，设计上与我们的开采站有些许相似。\n\n科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为派出几位工程师——最好是已经驻扎在飞船上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——也许就可以使其恢复运转。
entries.en: The orbital station appears to have once functioned as a mineral extraction and processing center for the asteroid, not wholly dissimilar from our own mining station designs.\n\nScience Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] expects that a handful of engineers - ideally [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] already stationed on military vessels - just might be able to restore the station to working order.

entries.zh: 我们对异种残骸没有兴趣。
entries.en: We have no interest in xeno wreckage.

entries.zh: 我们重建这个太空港吧。
entries.en: Let us restore this station.

entries.zh: 最好不要多事。
entries.en: Better leave it alone.

entries.zh: 古代工厂：新开采站
entries.en: Ancient Manufactory: New Mining Station

entries.zh: 工程师们完成了任务，使用改装过的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]部件与控制机制翻修了这座破旧的开采站。
entries.en: The engineering corps completed their mission, retrofitting the decrepit mining station with adapted [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] parts and control mechanisms.

entries.zh: 古代工厂
entries.en: Ancient Manufactory

entries.zh: $anomaly.3126.desc$\n\n似乎这个工厂最初是用来开采和精炼贝塞里安石的————现在它已经恢复如初了。
entries.en: $anomaly.3126.desc$\n\nIt seems the manufactory was originally built for the mining and refining of Betharian Stones - functionality that has now been restored.

entries.zh: $anomaly.3126.desc$\n\n对于这个空间站最初的功能我们仍然还有很多不了解的地方。看来这里最初用于开采和精炼某些其它的资源，而非我们所感兴趣的矿物生产。以上推测还需进一步调查才能确认。
entries.en: $anomaly.3126.desc$\n\nThere remain some aspects of the station's original function that are not entirely clear to us. It appears the manufactory was originally intended to mine and refine something other than the production minerals we are interested in. This bears further investigation.

entries.zh: $anomaly.3126.desc$\n\n我们接到报告，从工厂的加工室中回收到某种未知物质——也许这个开采站曾经开采并精炼过我们从没见过的矿物。
entries.en: $anomaly.3126.desc$\n\nWe have received reports of an unknown substance recovered from the manufactory's processing chambers - it is possible that the station once mined and refined something other than the minerals we concern ourselves with.

entries.zh: 太好了。
entries.en: Most excellent.

entries.zh: 还有很多值得研究的地方。
entries.en: There is much we can learn.

entries.zh: 有趣有趣……
entries.en: Interesting...

entries.zh: 古代工厂：无人机启动
entries.en: Ancient Manufactory: Drones Activated

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]工程师们的探索一无所获。这个太空港过于破旧，已无法再次启动，很多建筑结构在尝试启动时就直接崩塌了。\n\n在工厂坍塌的同时，有什么东西从地底下爬了出来——它们用高能激光器切开了一条通路，直勾勾地瞪着[Root.GetFleetName]。
entries.en: The [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] engineers' prodding and probing has proven fruitless. The station is too dilapidated to bring online, large sections of the structure simply collapsing under the strain of attempted reactivation.\n\nAs the manufactory's structural integrity finally failed, something, some things, emerged from its depths - cutting their way out with high-powered lasers and setting their sights on the [Root.GetFleetName].

entries.zh: 古代工厂：惊动古代巢穴
entries.en: Ancient Manufactory: Nest Disturbed

entries.zh: 老旧的石层破开，有什么东西涌了出来。\n\n完全不是预想中光洁的矿石，尖利的锯齿状晶体边缘切碎了破旧的轨道站，随后又将注意力转向了[Root.GetFleetName]。
entries.en: As the old rock tumblers spin up, something spills out.\n\nFar from the polished mineral ore expected, jagged crystal edges shred the decrepit orbital station before turning their attention to the [Root.GetFleetName].

entries.zh: 古代工厂被毁。\n\n[Root.GetFleetName]正遭受攻击！
entries.en: The Ancient Manufactory is destroyed.\nThe [Root.GetFleetName] is under attack!

entries.zh: 辩论与探讨
entries.en: Debate and Discussion

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上确实存在过较为发达的文明，但还没来得及飞出[From.GetPlanetMoon]便自行消亡了。通过分析从星球表面取回的古代无线通讯站碎片，[Root.GetName]的船员逐渐还原了整个文明消逝的过程。\n\n在很久以前的某个时间点，该文明的看法分裂为两派，也就是我们今天所说的集体主义与个人主义。虽说这些哲学上的争论与[Root.Owner.GetName]人们的生活并没有什么太大关系，但这个文明却因不知采用何种意识形态和道德标准而最终分崩离析。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] was indeed once home to a somewhat advanced civilization, although one that brought about its own end before escaping [From.GetPlanetMoon]bound existence. By analyzing the few fragments that could be recovered from the ancient wireless information depots on the surface, the crew of the [Root.GetName] have pieced together the narrative of the civilization's demise.\n\nAt some point in the distant past, an ideological schism developed over the definitions of the philosophies we today know as collectivism and individualism. While the relevance of these philosophies seems highly questionable to the people of the [Root.Owner.GetName], this civilization evidently tore itself apart over the question of which moral stances should be attributed to which ideology.

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上确实存在过较为发达的文明，但还没来得及飞出[From.GetPlanetMoon]便自行死亡了。通过分析从星球表面取回的古代无线通讯站碎片，[Root.GetName]的船员逐渐还原了整个文明消逝的过程。\n\n在很久以前的某个时间点，该文明的看法分为两派，也就是我们今天所说的集体主义与个人主义。虽说集体主义的本质对于[Root.Owner.GetName]的人们来说再明显不过，但这个文明却因不知采用何种看法和心理标准而最终分崩离析。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] was indeed once home to a somewhat advanced civilization, although one that brought about its own end before escaping [From.GetPlanetMoon]bound existence. By analyzing the few fragments that could be recovered from the ancient wireless information depots on the surface, the crew of the [Root.GetName] have pieced together the narrative of the civilization's demise.\n\nAt some point in the distant past, an ideological schism developed over the definitions of the philosophies we today know as collectivism and individualism. While the nature of collectivism is blindingly obvious to the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], this civilization evidently tore itself apart over the question of which moral stances should be attributed to which ideology.

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上确实存在过较为发达的文明，但还没来得及飞出[From.GetPlanetMoon]便自行死亡了。通过分析从星球表面取回的古代无线通讯站碎片，[Root.GetName]的船员逐渐还原了整个文明消逝的过程。\n\n在很久以前的某个时间点，该文明的看法分为两派，也就是我们今天所说的集体主义与个人主义。虽说个人主义的本质对于[Root.Owner.GetName]的人们来说再明显不过，但这个文明却因不知采用何种看法和心理标准而最终分崩离析。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] was indeed once home to a somewhat advanced civilization, although one that brought about its own end before escaping [From.GetPlanetMoon]bound existence. By analyzing the few fragments that could be recovered from the ancient wireless information depots on the surface, the crew of the [Root.GetName] have pieced together the narrative of the civilization's demise.\n\nAt some point in the distant past, an ideological schism developed over the definitions of the philosophies we today know as collectivism and individualism. While the nature of individualism is blindingly obvious to the people of the [Root.Owner.GetName], this civilization evidently tore itself apart over the question of which moral stances should be attributed to which ideology.

entries.zh: 真是太糟糕了。
entries.en: This truly is something awful.

entries.zh: 这根本都不是真正的思潮啊……
entries.en: Those aren't even real ethics...

entries.zh: 保持冷静
entries.en: Stay Calm

entries.zh: 从荒芜的[From.GetName]星球回来时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]带回来了一张用植物纤维做成的针织物。虽然不清楚其来历和用途，但是实验证明了此物的吸水性极好。虽然此物对科学研究毫无帮助，不过[Root.GetLeaderName]却对它情有独钟，无论去哪里都把该物品随身携带。\n\n“[Root.GetLeaderName]真是个奇人。”船员们私底下评论道。
entries.en: Returning from the desolate surface of [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] brings with them a sheet of woven plant fiber. Its exact origin and purpose is unknown, but it has proven quite absorbent in tests. While useless to the sciences, [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken a shine to the thing and now carries it with them wherever they go.\n\n"Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is a real hoopy frood," the crew whisper.

entries.zh: 那是什么意思？
entries.en: What does that even mean?

entries.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]获得了一条毛巾。
entries.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] gains a towel.

entries.zh: 发现彗星
entries.en: Comet Sighted

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]天生就很有好奇心，而[Root.Capital.GetName]上空划过的彗星在我们的民众中引起了广泛的惊奇之情。\n\n他们坚信这是大事将至的先兆。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are naturally curious, and the appearance of a comet in the sky above [Root.Capital.GetName] has sown a widespread sense of wonder among our people.\n\nThey are convinced that this is a sign of great things to come.

entries.zh: 这是一个吉兆。
entries.en: It is a good omen.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]天生就很有好奇心，[Root.Capital.GetName]上空划过的彗星在我们的民众中引起了广泛的恭谦之情。\n\n他们热切地希望这样的奇迹终有一天能让全星系的所有生物团结一心。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are naturally curious, and the appearance of a comet in the sky above [Root.Capital.GetName] has sown a widespread sense of humility among our people.\n\nIt is their fervent hope that wonders like this one will someday bring all beings of the galaxy together.

entries.zh: 这是一个吉兆。
entries.en: It is a good omen.

entries.zh: 一颗彗星从平流层顶部擦过，熊熊燃烧的烈焰之羽炙烤着[Root.Capital.GetName]的苍穹。其天体轨迹展现出的强大力量给首都的人们留下了无比深刻的印象。\n\n他们用这条势不可挡的航迹来比喻[Root.GetName]终将攀上星系无上霸权的必然性。
entries.en: A fierce plume of flame sears the heavens of [Root.Capital.GetName] as a comet skirts the upper stratosphere. The sheer power evident in its cosmic trajectory has made a profound impression on the capital's populace.\n\nThey liken the intractability of its path to the inevitability of the [Root.GetName]'s ascension to galactic supremacy.

entries.zh: 愿胜利与我们同在。
entries.en: To victory.

entries.zh: 一道亮光划过[Root.Capital.GetName]的夜空，它柔和的弧线与缓慢运转的繁星们交相辉映，形成鲜明的对比。\n\n[Root.Capital.GetName]的居民将其视作上天认可我们的证明，也是对我们事业的微妙祝福。
entries.en: A light was seen moving in the night sky of [Root.Capital.GetName], its gentle arc standing in stark contrast to the slow revolution of the stars.\n\nThe citizens of [Root.Capital.GetName] see it as proof of recognition by the powers that be, and a subtle blessing of our cause.

entries.zh: 确实如此。
entries.en: Indeed.

entries.zh: 近日，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系发现一颗带有气体和尘埃尾部的小型天体。\n\n它的消逝平淡无奇。
entries.en: A small celestial object with pronounced gaseous and particulate tails was recently observed in the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system.\n\nIts passing was uneventful.

entries.zh: 了解。
entries.en: Acknowledged.

entries.zh: 一颗彗星带着光亮的尾迹划破了[Root.Capital.GetName]的地平线，宛如来自遥远星星的特使。[Root.GetSpeciesName]民众为之欢欣鼓舞，认为它冥冥之中预示着我们在宇宙中并不孤单。\n\n他们比以往任何时候都更加支持[Root.GetName]的雄心，以涨开双臂迎接整个星系。
entries.en: A comet blazes a trail across [Root.Capital.GetName]'s horizon, a bright envoy from distant stars. The [Root.GetSpeciesName] people find great joy in this reminder, vague as it is, that we are not alone in this universe.\n\nThey are more supportive than ever of the [Root.GetName]'s ambition to greet the galaxy with open arms.

entries.zh: 真是天大的好消息。
entries.en: Tremendous.

entries.zh: 一颗骇人的彗星在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中游荡。那一道久久未能消散的弧线，残酷地提醒着[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们难得独善其身。茫茫宇宙中，未知的令人惊骇也许比我们想的更加迫近了。\n\n我们应该将其视作一个信号，并对保持对外星生物毫不松懈的警惕态度。
entries.en: A dread comet haunts the skies of [Root.Capital.GetName]. Its implacable arc is a harsh reminder to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] that we are not alone, and that unknowable horrors from beyond the stars may be closer than they appear.\n\nWe must take this as a sign to remain ever vigilant against alien influence.

entries.zh: 这是一个凶兆。
entries.en: It is an omen.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的许多团体都观测到一颗彗星飞快地掠过[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空。这颗孤独又渺小的天体却令许人们感到巨大的不安。[Root.GetSpeciesName]与[Root.GetSpeciesName]互相确认着自己并不孤单以寻求慰藉。\n\n他们相信，这预兆着[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]社会将要面临孤立和离散的命运。
entries.en: Groups of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] watched a comet streak across the sky of [Root.Capital.GetName]. The appearance of this lonely stellar object caused seemingly disproportionate distress, and [Root.GetSpeciesName] turned to [Root.GetSpeciesName] for assurance that they are not alone.\n\nThey are convinced that this is a sign of coming isolation and splintering of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

entries.zh: 令人警醒。
entries.en: Alarming.

entries.zh: 一颗孤傲的彗星在[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系中滑行，在[Root.Capital.GetName]上清晰可见。它在宇宙中一路穿行，充满活力，势不可挡。\n\n这正是每位[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都想为之奋斗的理想。
entries.en: A lone, proud comet soars through the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system, clearly visible from [Root.Capital.GetName]. It forges its own path through the cosmos, vibrant and ever undeterred.\n\nThis is the ideal which all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] strive for.

entries.zh: 这是一个吉兆。
entries.en: It is a good omen.

entries.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]上的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]单元报告观测到了一个正在气化的小型冰质星系内天体，其赤纬交角为10.3度，赤经2度54分8秒。\n\n经测量，该天体相到恒星的距离大约为3.75个天文单位，其彗发的尺寸及可见度值得注意。这个天体的尺寸经计算大约为5×10×6立方公里。该次观测事件正常结束，没有意外发生。
entries.en: Planetside [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] units on [Root.Capital.GetName] report the sighting of a small, icy solar system body exhibiting outgassing at two hours, fifty-four minutes, eight seconds right ascension, ten-point-three degrees declination.\n\nThe distance of the body has been triangulated at roughly three-point-seven-five astronomical units to the sun, and the size and visibility of the body's coma have been classified as noteworthy. The body's dimensions are calculated to be approximately five by ten by six kilometers. The sighting event concluded without incident.

entries.zh: 收到。
entries.en: Received.

entries.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetStarName]系最近发现了一颗彗星。
在§H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!表面清晰可见的这颗彗星在大众心中激起了强烈的反响。

几乎无人能否认，在§H[GetCycleName]§!轮回中出现这样的一个天体毫无疑问是[GetCycleAttitude]的原因。
entries.en:
A comet was recently detected in the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system.
Clearly visible from the surface of §H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!, its appearance was met with an intense reaction from the planet's population.

There is little disagreement that the occurrence of such a celestial event during a §H[GetCycleName]§! is a cause for [GetCycleAttitude].

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯
entries.en: Wanderlust

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]研究部门的首席科学官失踪了。

他们的私人赞助的科研船试验机也不见了。

[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界一片哗然。
entries.en:
The Head of the [Root.GetName]'s Research Department has gone missing.

Along with their privately-funded, highly experimental prototype Science Ship.

The incident has the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] in an uproar.

entries.zh: 真奇怪呢。
entries.en: How odd.

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：早有谋划
entries.en: Wanderlust: With Purpose

entries.zh: 首席科学官——准确来说应该是前首席科学官——还没有找到。但是一些关于科研船试验机以及长官的私人研究的消息却已经传到了我们的耳朵里。虽然有一些太过离谱，但显而易见的是尽快寻回首席关乎着[Root.GetName]的利益。\n\n情报日志已更新。
entries.en: The whereabouts of the Head - now technically the former Head of Research - have yet to be ascertained. Certain details regarding the prototype Science Ship and the Head's private research have reached our ears, and while some aspects seem too fantastical to be true, it is clear that it is in the [Root.GetName]'s interest to find and recover the Chair as soon as possible.\n\nThe Situation Log has been updated.

entries.zh: 很好。
entries.en: Very well.

entries.zh: 开启“浪迹星涯：叛变科学官”事件链
entries.en: Begins the Wanderlust: Rogue Scientist Event Chain

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：死胡同
entries.en: Wanderlust: Dead End

entries.zh: 首席科学官并不在这个星系之内。\n\n这一趟要不就彻底是白忙活，要不就是线索早已经断了。
entries.en: The Research Head is not in this system.\n\nEither the lead was a dud, or the trail has gone cold.

entries.zh: 继续寻找。
entries.en: We will keep looking.

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：匆匆一瞥
entries.en: Wanderlust: A Glimpse

entries.zh: 科学家的船就在这个星系里——如果没猜错的话。\n\n我们没法通过探测器确定他们的位置，不过他们主动呼叫了我们。把他们的信号接到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
entries.en: The Researcher's ship is in this system - we think.\n\nWe are unable to lock in their position on sensors, but they are hailing us. Patching them through to [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 打开通讯系统。
entries.en: Open comms.

entries.zh: 首席科学官
entries.en: Head of Research

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]，鄙人向您传达我们诚挚的问候。\n\n我估计你不是单纯来寒暄问候的吧？
entries.en: Greetings and salutations, [Root.GetRulerTitle].\n\nI take it this is not a social call?

entries.zh: 这是什么意思？
entries.en: What is the meaning of this?

entries.zh:
您应该想问我从[Root.GetName]上消失的事。

我只是离开一小会，仅此而已。我在寻找真实之窗。但显然我并没找到。

它也不在这里。我必须继续我的研究了。不过我可不会带着这些找到的无人机。
entries.en:
I take it you are referring to my disappearance from [Root.GetName] space.

I needed some time away, is all. Well. Rather, I am looking for the Window. And the Window is certainly not there.

It is not here either. I must continue my search. I will not be bringing these drones I found, though.

entries.zh: 我们可以派船护送你回家。
entries.en: We can assign ships to escort you home.

entries.zh: 我现在不想回家。\n\n但是，为了表示我的诚意，请收下这些无人机吧，作为我送给[Root.GetName]的礼物。这些无人机是我在这个星系的外围发现的。经过彻底修理过后，我才发现它们根本不适合用作研究探测。
entries.en: I have no interest in returning home at present.\n\nBut please, as a token of my goodwill, take these drones. A donation to the [Root.GetName]. I found them drifting on the outskirts of this system, and only after extensive repairs did I realize that they are utterly unfit to function as research probes.

entries.zh: 你必须马上返回首都。
entries.en: You will return to the capital at once.

entries.zh: 对不起，我的研究才刚刚开始。使命在召唤我，这是为了科学。\n\n但是，为了表示我的诚意，请收下这些无人机吧，作为我送给[Root.GetName]的礼物。这些无人机是我在这个星系的外围发现的。经过彻底修理过后，我才发现它们根本不适合用作研究探测。
entries.en: I think not, this is but the beginning. Duty calls, for science, and so on.\n\nBut please, as a token of my goodwill, take these drones. A donation to the [Root.GetName]. I found them drifting on the outskirts of this system, and only after extensive repairs did I realize that they are utterly unfit to function as research probes.

entries.zh: 对话结束了。
entries.en: This conversation is over.

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：无人机
entries.en: Wanderlust: The Drones

entries.zh: 首席再次神秘地消失了。\n\n不过他们的确留下了一些无人机。这些无人机装备了武器，而且正在启动！
entries.en: The Chair has vanished, inexplicably, yet again.\n\nHowever, they did leave a number of drones behind, as promised. The drones are armed, and their weapons are powering up!

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：毁坏的无人机
entries.en: Wanderlust: The Drones Destroyed

entries.zh:
这些无人机的敌我识别系统的模组被拆除了，应该是首席干的。不过它们的威胁评估处理器还完好无损。由于此人的破坏行为，威胁等级有些升高。

首席科学官不像是想让它们攻击我们，但是它们很好地掩护了首席，让其成功逃走了。

查看情报日志的§Y特殊项目§!，以获得首席最后一次出现的位置。
entries.en:
The drones' IFF modules had been removed, likely a result of the Head Researcher's repairs, but their threat assessment processors remained intact and somewhat stressed by the Head's invasive procedures.

It is unlikely that the head meant for the drones to attack us, but fact remains that they covered the scientist's escape nicely.

Consult the Situation Log for a §YSpecial Project§! to track the Head from their last known location.

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：无人机被击毁
entries.en: Wanderlust: The Drones Defeated

entries.zh:
科学家留下的无人机似乎被某个人或者是某个东西击毁了。

我们应该抓住这个机会，寻找有关首席的线索。

一个§Y特殊项目§!已经添加到情报日志中。
entries.en:
It seems the drones left behind by the Researcher have been destroyed, by something or someone.

We should seize this opportunity to pick up the Head's trail.

A §YSpecial Project§! has been added to the Situation Log.

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：特殊项目已完成
entries.en: Wanderlust: Special Project Completed

entries.zh: 我们已经破译了首席留下的科研船上的能源信息，可以再度对其展开追踪。\n\n查看情报日志以获得更多细节。
entries.en: Having decoded the intricate web of energy signatures left behind by the Chair's elusive Science Ship, we are on their trail once again.\n\nConsult the Situation Log for details.

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：遇上麻烦了
entries.en: Wanderlust: In Trouble

entries.zh:
首席的科研船神出鬼没，侦测起来相当困难，但这还不是最难的。

传感器上显示的数据令人不解，上面显示首席的船两侧各有一艘虎视眈眈的护卫舰。

首席物理学家正在向我们致意。
entries.en:
The ephemeral Science Ship remains difficult to detect, but apparently not difficult enough.

The blur of confused sensor readings that we have come to associate with the Head's ship is flanked on both sides by a pair of rather nasty-looking corvettes.

The Physicist Head is hailing us.

entries.zh: 首席科学官
entries.en: Head of Research

entries.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您好。

请允许我向[Root.GetSpeciesName]的舰队致以热烈欢迎。恐怕我的突然出现激怒了这个星系的外星生物，现在他们的飞船把我包围了。

如果您能帮忙弥补一下我的失礼行为，那就再好不过了。事情解决后，我会很乐意与你们分享我的探险经历。
entries.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

[Root.GetSpeciesName] ships are a most welcome sight. I fear my own sudden appearance in this system may have angered the alien beings aboard the ships that now surround mine.

Any assistance in rectifying whatever faux pas I may have committed would be most appreciated. I will gladly share with you the nature of my expedition once this matter is settled.

entries.zh: 你为什么要跑？
entries.en: Why did you run?

entries.zh:
跑？我只是离开而已。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]，我知道你们都不太喜欢我的行为。但我不能让[Root.GetSpeciesName]科学界没完没了的派别斗争危害到我的研究。

而且，有些研究也需要实地考察。一直如此。
entries.en:
Run? I left.

I realize you are none too pleased with my actions, [Root.GetRulerTitle], but I could not risk my work being mired in the petty politics of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] scientific community.

Besides, I had some research to do in the field. Still do.

entries.zh: 先跟我们讲讲关于真实之窗的事。
entries.en: Tell us more about this Window, first.

entries.zh: 在这种节骨眼上，我不太方便讲述细节。我不太想，嗯，让自己看起来像个傻瓜。万一最后证明我是错的呢？\n\n但是我们也许最后都会变成全息影像。这又是否值得呢？
entries.en: I would be loath to go into details at this juncture. Would not, ah, want to look the fool. Should it turn out that I am mistaken.\n\nBut we may all turn out to be holograms in the end. Would it not be worth it?

entries.zh: 我们会帮你摆平局面的。
entries.en: We will try to get you out of this mess.

entries.zh: 阳炎海盗
entries.en: Sunblaster Pirates

entries.zh: 滚开！是我们先找到这艘破烂幽灵船的。\n\n谁先看见就是谁的，不是谁先登船就是谁的。它是我们的，不是你们的。而且它的舰长还死了。
entries.en: Get lost! We found the rotten ghost-ship first.\n\nOnce we figure out how to see it proper-like, it's as good as boarded. And ours. Not yours. And its captain dead.

entries.zh: 外星人渣，敢跟我们结梁子，你早晚要后悔。
entries.en: You will rue the day you crossed us, alien scum.

entries.zh: 真是丑人多作怪。野蛮人，这不是我们第一次交锋了。
entries.en: Big words from someone so ugly. This isn't our first rodeo, bucko.

entries.zh: 用150能量币换取飞船。
entries.en: 150 Energy Credits for the ship.

entries.zh: 武器预备。
entries.en: Ready weapons.

entries.zh: 现在滚还能留你一条活路。
entries.en: Leave now and you may yet live.

entries.zh: 虚张声势！丑八怪，这可不是你的领地。\n这些星星是阳炎海盗的。
entries.en: Empty threats! You are a long way from home, ugly.\nThe Sunblaster Pirates own these stars.

entries.zh: 阳炎海盗
entries.en: Sunblaster Pirates

entries.zh:
150能量币？这价格估计都算不上家猪用剩的一点小零头，真狡猾。但是……

哎，这艘混账幽灵船带来的麻烦比它的好处还要多。

弟兄们！我们走！
entries.en:
150 Energy Credits? Hardly a drop in the domesti-beast's piss-bucket, ugly. But...

Bah, the filthy ghost-ship has been more trouble than it's worth anyway.

Skitskur'r! We out!

entries.zh: 祈祷最好别再遇上我们吧，可怜虫。
entries.en: Pray that we do not meet again, degenerates.

entries.zh: 一切都是浮云，物质财富更是如此。
entries.en: All things are fleeting, material wealth especially so.

entries.zh: 金钱是万能的。如果做不到，说明你钱不够多。
entries.en: Money talks. Sometimes you have to raise your voice.

entries.zh: 请离开。
entries.en: Please leave.

entries.zh: 阳炎海盗
entries.en: Sunblaster Pirates

entries.zh: 这些傻子需要好好学学。\n\n弟兄们！拿起武器！
entries.en: The fool needs to be taught a lesson.\n\nSkitskur'r! Weapons!

entries.zh: 你们会见识到[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]军团的厉害。
entries.en: You will know the military might of the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 首席科学官
entries.en: Head of Research

entries.zh: 我忍不住听到了谈话中一些只言片语——毕竟他们是在开放频段上广播的。\n\n我想交易进行得还算顺利。
entries.en: I couldn't help but catch bits and pieces of that conversation - they were broadcasting on an open channel, after all.\n\nI gather the transaction went smoothly.

entries.zh: 首席科学官
entries.en: Head of Research

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]，我看到您一下子就除掉了那些海盗。\n\n作为一名科学家，我痛恨争斗……但我也深知在那种情形下这是必需的。如果我落入那些海盗之手，想必待遇不会太好。
entries.en: I see you made short work of the pirates, [Root.GetRulerTitle].\nAs a scientist, I abhor violence... But recognize that it may have been necessary in this case. I strongly suspect I would have been treated less than kindly at the hands of those pirates.

entries.zh: 确实如此。现在有话快说吧。
entries.en: Indeed. Now, speak.

entries.zh:
噢，好的。

就是……我不用细枝末节来烦扰您了，[Root.GetRulerTitle]，但是有一种观念，一切皆为虚妄。或者说我们所认知的真实其实并非如此，至少并非完全如此，甚至比其他事物更接近于虚妄。这也就是说，这一切——包括我，[Root.GetRulerTitle]您自己，以及我们认为是不可动摇的宇宙法则——都只不过是光的把戏而已。这个宇宙不过是镜花水月，是映像，抑或是全息投影，或是棱镜。终究只不过是散射了真正现实的迷人光线罢了。

明白了吗？这些光一定是从某个地方来的。从真实之窗来的。
entries.en:
Oh yes, of course.
There is... I will not bore you with the details [Root.GetRulerTitle], but there is this idea, if you will, that nothing is real. Or that what we think is real is not, that it is less real, less so than something else. That this, this is all - I, you yourself [Root.GetRulerTitle], the very laws of nature we consider absolute - nothing but tricks of the light. The universe as a reflection, hologram, or prism, simply breaking the brilliant rays of the truly real.

See? The light has to come from somewhere. Through the Window.

entries.zh: 你必须马上回到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
entries.en: You are to return to [Root.Capital.GetName] immediately.

entries.zh: 首席科学官
entries.en: Head of Research

entries.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您心里很清楚我是不会回去的。

事实上，我也考虑过其他的可能性。我想我短时间内很可能无法回去了。

我手头的所有研究数据，只要我觉得对[Root.GetSpeciesName]的人们有用，我就会上传到[Root.Capital.GetName]的数据库中。但是和真实之窗有关的数据我会自己保留。现在我觉得自己还没有准备好。不过显然，没人准备好。

我得走了。
entries.en:
You know I will not, [Root.GetRulerTitle].
In fact, having had some time to consider additional possibilities, I believe there is a significant risk I will not be able to return within a reasonable timeframe.

I have taken the liberty of uploading whatever research data I have that may benefit the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people to the databases on [Root.Capital.GetName]. The data related to the Window stays with me, though. I am starting to think I am not ready; certainly no one else is.
I will be going now.

entries.zh: 等等——
entries.en: Wait--

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：瞎子
entries.en: Wanderlust: The Blinds

entries.zh:
简单查看了一下，首席的确说到做到。[Root.GetName]的物理学研究整体得到了小幅度的提升。

科学家又一次消失了，但是这一次，这个人的行踪在离开这个星系之前就被我们侦测到了。

如果他们想去寻找这个真实之窗，那么我们也会去。
查看情报日志以获得更多细节。
entries.en:
A quick check confirms the Head's claims, and the [Root.GetName] has enjoyed a small but not insignificant boost to our collective body of physics research.

The Researcher has vanished once again, but this time their course had been divined before they were even out of the system.

If they are headed for this Window, then so are we.
Consult the Situation Log for details.

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：真实之窗开启
entries.en: Wanderlust: The Window Opens

entries.zh:
科研船原型机第一次清楚地出现在了我们的传感器上。它以极近的距离围绕着这个星系的恒星运转，不过其他地方并没有什么特别的。

只需简单的光学扫描，这艘船的秘密就暴露无遗。它的船身设计十分普通，没有什么独到之处。上面有许多十字形的金属网格，像是交流电压控制下的电磁铁。只要足够接近恒星，飞船就能稍微扭曲恒星发出的射线，将它们缠绕于自身附近，把自己伪装起来。

这个科技理论上听起来不错，但是实际应用中却有一些明显的问题。由于暴露在恒星的辐射中太久，它的整套设配都已经被烤焦而且变得毫无用处。
entries.en:
For the first time, the prototype Science Ship is plainly visible on sensors. It is orbiting dangerously close to the system's star, but appears otherwise unremarkable.

A simple optical scan reveals the ship's secret. Its hull is a standard design altered without much subtlety, now crisscrossed by a lattice of metal filaments likely acting as electromagnets at alternating, tightly-controlled voltages. By staying close to a star the ship can weakly warp its stellar emissions, wrapping them around itself as a form of camouflage.

While conceptually interesting, the technique has obvious practical drawbacks, as evidenced by the entire set-up now having been fried and rendered useless by prolonged exposure to solar radiation.

entries.zh: 首席科学官
entries.en: Head of Research

entries.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您好。

我有十足的理由相信你们将会继续追随我们。

所以我采取了一些措施。
entries.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

It seemed entirely reasonable to assume that you would follow, again.

So I did.

entries.zh: 首席科学官，你想做什么？
entries.en: What now, Head Researcher?

entries.zh: 我想我已经找到真实之窗了。至少是一扇真实之窗。也许还会有更多。说不定我们的真身就在那里。说不定所有东西的真身就在那里。不得不承认，我脑子里一点概念也没有。我知道我获得的这些知识也没办法造福什么人。但是如果我就此打住的话，那也太不负责任了。
entries.en: I have found the Window, I think. A window, at least. There may be more. Do our true selves lie beyond? Does anything? I must confess that I haven't the faintest idea. I recognize that no one else may very well benefit from whatever knowledge I gain. But to stop here would be utterly irresponsible.

entries.zh: 你想怎么做？
entries.en: What will you do?

entries.zh: 我会试着穿过真实之窗，前往真实。显然，来自真实的光不单单只是通过这里。整个宇宙就像是一大块玻璃窗，我们只是其中的一小块扭曲，一小块瑕疵而已。我们的生命来源于我们之上的那种光辉。\n\n这就是真实之窗，我相信它会开启的。
entries.en: I will attempt to pass through the Window, into reality. The light of the real does not solely shine through here, of course. The entire universe is like a vast pane of glass, and we are the minute warps and imperfections in it, given life by the brilliance beyond.\n\nThis is the Window, because I believe it opens.

entries.zh: 你的举动又鲁莽又危险。
entries.en: Your actions are harebrained and dangerous.

entries.zh: 首席科学官
entries.en: Head of Research

entries.zh: 我的行为带来了诸多麻烦，为此我深感抱歉，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。但是，我不欠[Root.GetName]任何东西，对他们我已经仁至义尽。现在我必须完成我的使命了。您凭着强大的毅力一路跟来，我对您的帮助非常感激，但是从一开始我就已经下定决心，不会改变主意。
entries.en: I truly regret all the trouble I have caused, [Root.GetRulerTitle], I do. However, I owe nothing to the [Root.GetName], I have paid my dues in full and of this I am sure. You came after me of your own volition, and I am grateful for your help, but I made my intentions clear at the outset.

entries.zh: 我们可以当这一切都没发生过，跟我们回家吧。
entries.en: We will forget about the whole thing, just come home.

entries.zh: 你必须接受审判。
entries.en: You will stand trial.

entries.zh: 首席科学官
entries.en: Head of Research

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]，窗口已开启。\n\n再见。
entries.en: The Window opens, [Root.GetRulerTitle].\n\nGoodbye.

entries.zh: 首席科学官？
entries.en: Head Researcher?

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：窗口关闭
entries.en: Wanderlust: The Window Closes

entries.zh:
科研船是空的。

所有用于舱外行动的衣服都好好地放在原处。飞船日志显示气闸从未向外打开过。

飞船还在围绕恒星运行，但现在受到[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的控制。
entries.en:
The Science Ship is empty.

All suits for extra-vehicular activity remain in their pods, and the ship logs state that the airlock has never been exit-cycled.

The ship still orbits the star, but is now under [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] control.

entries.zh: 真是令人害怕。
entries.en: An unnerving end.

entries.zh: 我们收回了科研船，飞船的基本功能仍可以正常使用。
entries.en: The Science Ship has been repossessed and its basic functions remain operational.\n

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：海盗已消灭
entries.en: Wanderlust: Pirates Destroyed

entries.zh: 威胁首席科学官的那些阳炎海盗已经被消灭了，不过不是出自我们之手。\n\n首席正在向我们致意。
entries.en: The Sunblaster Pirates threatening the Head of Research have been destroyed by some hand not our own.\n\nThe Head Physicist is hailing us.

entries.zh: 大灭绝
entries.en: Mass Extinction

entries.zh:
我们向§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!之上的虚空迈出的第一步并不单单只是受到好奇心或征服欲的驱使，更是一种必要之举。

§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!的生物圈经历了剧烈的变化。科学家们警告大灭绝将很有可能发生，这种周期性的生物灭亡是这个宇宙中行星生物的自然规律。

我们制定了一个研究项目，对象是几颗因重大天文灾害而变得不宜居行星。通过还原这些灾难性事件，我们预期可以避免§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!和§Y[Root.GetSpeciesName]§!一族重蹈覆辙。
entries.en:
Our first steps into the void beyond §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! were driven not just by curiosity or conquest but by necessity.

The biosphere of §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! has rapidly changed, with scientists warning of a potential mass extinction event, a cyclical purging of life inherent to planetary existence in the cosmos.

A research plan has been developed to study planets rendered uninhabitable by major astronomical incidents. By reconstructing these events, we hope to avoid a similar fate for §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! and the §Y[Root.GetSpeciesName]§! race.

entries.zh: 为了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的未来。
entries.en: For a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] future.

entries.zh: 目标位于别国领域。请另寻目标。
entries.en: It lies within foreign territory. Find another subject.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：崩坏的星球
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Broken Planet

entries.zh: 我们的天文学家们十分确信，这个星系的小行星带曾经是一颗宜居的行星，但是却被某种未知的力量击碎了。\n\n已发起§Y特殊项目§!来进一步研究小行星带中的主要天体。
entries.en: Our astronomers are confident that the asteroid belt in this system was once a habitable planet, torn asunder by unknown forces.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to study one of the major asteroids in the belt.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：烧焦的星球
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Burned Planet

entries.zh: 在围绕这颗恒星运转的行星中，其中一颗还清晰地留有灾难的痕迹。这颗行星的地表被半融未融的矿物海洋所覆盖着，大气炽热无比。然而[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]天文学家们却声称这里可能曾经出现过生命。\n\n已发起§Y特殊项目§!来进一步研究这颗炽热的行星。
entries.en: One of the planets orbiting this star bears the still-open wounds of some past calamity. Its surface is a roiling sea of half-melted minerals boiling into a superheated atmosphere, but [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] astronomers claim that it may once have supported life.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to study the molten planet.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：荒芜的星球
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Desolate Planet

entries.zh: 在这个星系里，有一颗行星以往生态圈所留下的化石痕迹依然清晰可见。是什么把欣欣向荣的生物圈变成了一片不毛之地？\n\n已发起§Y特殊项目§!来研究这一灾难性转变的成因。
entries.en: A planet in this system still wears the fossilized traces of a past ecology on its sleeve. What could turn a thriving biosphere into a blasted wasteland?\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to trace the source of this disastrous transformation.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：剧毒的星球
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Noxious Planet

entries.zh: 据称，这颗行星上的动植物会释放有毒气体使其他物种窒息，或许这是地壳之下在不断涌出的活性气体造成的。\n\n已发起§Y特殊项目§!来研究这一现象。
entries.en: Allegedly this planet's flora and fauna choked on their own poisonous emissions, likely helped along by the release of reactive gases from beneath the planet's crust.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to investigate the matter.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：寒冷的星球
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Chilly Planet

entries.zh: 这个星系中有一颗奇怪的行星，星球表面被一层又一层成分各异的寒冰所覆盖。可推测，这颗星球曾有过种类繁杂的生物群。\n\n已发起§Y特殊项目§!来调查这一可能性。
entries.en: The planet of interest in this system is covered in layer upon layer of dense ices of varying composition. Apparently it was once home to more varied and pleasant biomes.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to investigate this possibility.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：小行星
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Asteroid

entries.zh: 这颗小星球其实曾是一颗宜居——或许甚至有人居住过——的行星的一部分。其破裂形态富有规律但又相互重叠，可以看出这颗星球的毁灭是预先设计好的，尽管实施的时可能有些匆忙。\n\n所有的迹象都表明，这颗星球曾是某个物种的母星，但这个物种最后又摧毁了它。我们可能永远都不会知道是什么驱使它们做出毁灭星球这种行为，但是我们也许该为此感到庆幸。
entries.en: The asteroid is in actuality a chunk of what was once a habitable, and probably inhabited, planet. Regular but overlapping fracture patterns indicate that the planetary demolition was intentional and controlled, if somewhat rushed.\n\nAll signs point to this planet being the homeworld of whatever species destroyed it. We may never know what drove them to consider planetary annihilation to be the lesser evil, and perhaps we should be grateful for that.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：熔融
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Molten

entries.zh: 这颗星球的悲惨命运可以归结于宇宙的喜怒无常。\n\n我们科学家认为，一个由短暂时空异常导致的引力扰动，迫使这颗星球的轨道变得过于接近恒星。尽管它在缓慢地向自己的原有轨道作螺旋式运动，但仍是不断受到恒星的余热炙烤。
entries.en: The unfortunate fate of the planet can be laid squarely at the feet of cosmic whims.\n\nA gravitational disturbance, which our scientists suspect was a transient space-time anomaly, forced the planet from its natural orbit to one much too close to the sun. Although the planet is slowly spiraling back towards its original orbit, it has been cooking in the residual heat from the star ever since.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：荒芜
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Barren

entries.zh:
对这颗荒芜的星球上曾存在过的生命，它们的命运从一开始就注定了。

主体物种甚至还来不及演化出智能、发明农业，地理机制就已经让土壤严重酸化了。

从土壤下层和化石遗骸中提取的样品表明，对土壤再生极为关键的矿物质被当地生物的内骨骼消耗殆尽。

它们的骨骼会完全石化而非腐坏，它们光是存在就已经耗竭了脆弱的生态系统，使其发生了永久性的转变。
entries.en:
Life on the now-barren planet was doomed from the start.

The dominant species barely had time to awaken to sapience and invent agriculture before geological mechanisms caused the earth to sour.

Samples from lower soil strata and fossilized remains show that vital minerals needed to rejuvenate the soil ended up in the endoskeletons of the native beings.

Their bones fossilized instead of decaying, and their existence exhausted the fragile ecosystem, leaving it permanently transformed.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：剧毒
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Toxic

entries.zh:
我们一度以为行星地壳上的千沟万壑是由地质活动塑造的，然而它们实际上却是破土而入的巨大根茎所遗留下来的永恒伤疤。

在过去的某一个时间点，一种可能由智慧物种引发的变异导致当地的植物开始失控疯长。在下层大气环流的帮助下，许多这样的植物借助花粉进行繁殖。

这种影响起先看似轻微，却愈演愈烈，大气层中愈发浓密的颗粒物最终在几个月内将星球上所有的动物呛死了。
entries.en:
The cracks in the planet's crust, initially thought to be caused by tectonic activity, are actually lasting marks of enormous roots burrowing through the earth.

At some point in the past, a mutation, possibly induced by sapient beings, caused the native plant life to grow uncontrollably. Many of these plants reproduce through pollination, with countless gametes carried by currents in the lower atmosphere.

What was once a mild irritation escalated, as the increase in atmosphere-borne particles choked the life out of all animals on the planet within months.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：冰封
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Frozen

entries.zh:
大气成分的一次异常变化让这颗星球慢慢地进入了冰川期，这一过程早于[Root.Owner.GetName]的形成而且可能在我们都不在了以后仍将继续下去。

造成大气变化的确切原因尚不清楚，但是存在几种假说，例如环境改造失败或行星内恐怖主义活动等等。[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]科学共同体内的一些激进分子甚至认为，这种急剧的气候变化可能是大肆排放工业废气导致的。

只有少数科学家赞同这一观点。毕竟一个物种如果有能力完全实现工业化，又怎么会傻到一不小心就把自己给毁灭了呢？
entries.en:
An unnatural shift in the atmosphere's chemical make-up resulted in the slow onset of an ice age, beginning before the formation of [Root.Owner.GetName] and likely persisting long after our passing.

The exact cause is unknown, but possible explanations include failed terraforming attempts or intra-planetary terrorism. Some radical elements within the scientific community on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] suggest that the climate shift may have been caused by the unchecked emission of industrial by-products.

This view is confined to the fringe, as it is unlikely any race intelligent enough for industrialization would be foolish enough to wipe themselves out.

entries.zh:
大气层化学成分非自然剧变导致这个星球缓慢却不可避免地进入了冰川期——这一时期在[Root.Owner.GetName]建立之前就已经开始，而且很有可能在我们灭亡之后还未结束。

因为我们自己的行星上发生过的工业化经历，我们对其原因感到相当熟悉：向大气层无休止地排放工业废气导致了剧烈的气候变化，而且他们的科技还没发展到能够解决这一问题的程度。

这一结论引起了我们科学界的一定关注，尽管多数人指出我们的科技“大概”已经发达到足以避免这种灭绝事件的程度了。
entries.en:
An unnatural shift in the atmosphere's chemical make-up resulted in the slow but irreversible onset of an ice age - one that began before the formation of the [Root.Owner.GetName] and is likely to persist long after our passing.

The cause appears familiar from our experience of industrialization on our own planets: the unchecked emission of gaseous industrial by-product into the atmosphere caused dramatic climatic shifts which they lacked the technology to counteract.

This conclusion has caused some concern among our scientific community, although most point out that at our technological level such an extinction event could "probably" be avoided.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：研究已完成
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Study Complete

entries.zh: 这次科研探险我们得到了许多意料之外的收获。[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]科学家现在掌握了空前庞大的数据，能够为[Root.Capital.GetName]的未来建立精确的模型。\n\n最初的报告显示，刨除诡异的宇宙活动和[Root.GetName]的突然崩溃，[Root.Capital.GetName]至少在百年内都不会真正遇到危险。
entries.en: While the research expedition often yielded unexpected results, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] scientists now have access to an unprecedented wealth of data with which to accurately model the future of [Root.Capital.GetName].\n\nInitial reports suggest that [Root.Capital.GetName] will be in no real danger for at least a dozen generations, save from freak cosmic events or the violent collapse of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们还能从这些行星上学到什么呢？
entries.en: What else can we learn from these planets?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]的人们可以放宽心。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] people should be put at ease.

entries.zh: 把这些行星数据公之于众。
entries.en: Make the planetary data public.

entries.zh: 大灭绝：调查已完成
entries.en: Mass Extinction: Surveyed

entries.zh: 尽管这份数据对所有的星系都一概而论，未免有失偏颇，但通过对个别行星展开研究，[Root.GetName]能够推断出其所在星系的调查数据。
