entries.en: High-Value Mining Targets

entries.zh: 使用古代采矿无人机的评估系统中的技术，我们定位了一些矿产资源丰富的天体。
entries.en: Using techniques derived from the Ancient Mining Drones' assessment systems, we have pin-pointed a handful of stellar bodies that are likely to be particularly rich in minerals.

entries.zh: 地质调查已完成
entries.en: Deposits Surveyed

entries.zh: 富含矿产资源
entries.en: Mineral Riches

entries.zh: 使用古代采矿无人机的评估系统中的技术，我们定位了一些星系，其中的星球很可能富含大量矿产。
entries.en: Using techniques derived from the Ancient Mining Drones' assessment systems, we have pin-pointed a handful of star systems that are likely to have particularly mineral-rich planetary bodies.

entries.zh: 流云
entries.en: Drifting Clouds

entries.zh: 所有的虚空之云在量子层面上都是相连的；这些散发能源的个体样本很可能就是一个单独的亚空间实体的多个表示形式。\n\n对一个虚空之云进行了仔细研究之后，我们找到了其他可能富含这些云的星系。
entries.en: All Void Clouds are entangled with one another on the quantum level; it is possible that the energies animating the individual specimens are nothing but multiple instances of a singular sub-space entity.\n\nThrough careful study of one Void Cloud, we have been able to locate a number of systems that are likely to house other Clouds.

entries.zh: 虚空之云已观察
entries.en: Clouds Watched

entries.zh: 虚空之云星系
entries.en: Void Cloud Systems

entries.zh: 根据量子纠缠理论，这些星系就是虚空之云的家。
entries.en: Quantum entanglement points to these systems being home to Void Clouds.

entries.zh: 恒星系坐标
entries.en: Solar Coordinates

entries.zh: 一件外星人文物提供了一个特定星系的坐标。
entries.en: An alien artifact provides the coordinates for a particular system.

entries.zh: 太阳
entries.en: The Sun

entries.zh: 送出这个文物的种群应该是来自这里。最好还是调查一下。
entries.en: Whatever beings sent the artifact into space seem to have originated here. It would be prudent to investigate.

entries.zh: 发现外星星系
entries.en: Alien System Found

entries.zh: 首个疑似古龛的位置
entries.en: First likely shrine location

entries.zh: 辐射度测量指数显示一个同未叙尊者的古龛类似的物体正在环绕这颗恒星。
entries.en: Radiometric findings indicate that an object similar to the shrine to the Untold might orbiting this star.

entries.zh: 第二个疑似古龛的位置
entries.en: Second likely shrine location

entries.zh: 辐射度测量指数显示另一个同未叙尊者的古龛类似的物体正在环绕这颗恒星。
entries.en: Radiometric findings indicate that another object similar to the shrine to the Untold might be orbiting this star.

entries.zh: 第三个疑似古龛的位置
entries.en: Third likely shrine location

entries.zh: 辐射度测量指数显示第三个同未叙尊者的古龛类似的物体正在环绕这颗恒星。
entries.en: Radiometric findings indicate that a third object similar to the shrine to the Untold might be orbiting this star.

entries.zh: 恒星古龛
entries.en: Stellar Shrine

entries.zh: 供奉我们的古神之一的古龛，遗失在了宇宙之中。
entries.en: A shrine dedicated to one of our people's old gods, lost in space.

entries.zh: 供奉我们的古神之一的古龛，遗失在了宇宙之中。
entries.en: A shrine dedicated to one of our people's old gods, lost in space.

entries.zh: 古神神殿
entries.en: Shrines to the Old Gods

entries.zh: 在发现神秘的未叙尊者的小行星古龛之后，首席科学官认为可能还有其他关于我们——或者自以为是我们——供奉的古神宫殿存在于附近的恒星系中。
entries.en: After the discovery of the mysterious asteroid-shrine to the Untold, top scientists have proposed that there may be additional shrines dedicated to our - or what we believed was only our - pantheon, in neighboring systems.

entries.zh: 已搜寻古龛
entries.en: Shrines Searched

entries.zh: 星际绑架者
entries.en: The Ransomeers

entries.zh: 一群自称为“星际绑架者”的海盗关押了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]私人运输飞船的船员。\n\n我们想在海盗们提出条件之前就救出他们。
entries.en: A band of pirates calling themselves the "Ransomeers" have kidnapped the crew of a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] private transport vessel.\n\nWe intend to free them before the pirates can make any demands.

entries.zh: 已救出被绑架的船员
entries.en: Captive Crew Rescued

entries.zh: 星际绑架者基地
entries.en: Ransomeer Base

entries.zh: 星际绑架者在一个废弃的外星开采站建立了一个基地。
entries.en: The Ransomeers have made a home out of an abandoned alien mining station.

entries.zh: 漂流的战场
entries.en: Drifting Battlefield

entries.zh: 千年之前，某舰队里的成员背弃了盟约，将枪口对准了彼此。在知己知彼的情况下，盟友的飞船顷刻之间就被消灭了，只留下了失去压力的飞船外壳。\n\n我们收集了足够的信息，可以对这些舰队残骸在宇宙中缓慢漂移的过程进行建模。
entries.en: Millennia ago, treachery saw a fleet of allied ships turn on each other. With swift strikes to critical systems and known weak points in the hull designs, the formerly allied crews were wiped out with ruthless efficiency, supposedly leaving the depressurized hulks of the ships largely intact.\n\nWe have gleaned enough information to model this ship graveyard's slow drift through the cosmos.

entries.zh: 预计位置
entries.en: Projected Location

entries.zh: 我们已经计算出漂移战场在当前星系的大致位置。有机会的话，最好能去调查一下现场。
entries.en: We have calculated the drifting battlefield's current position to be somewhere in the indicated system. It would be prudent to investigate the site, given the opportunity.

entries.zh: 战场已调查完毕
entries.en: Battlefield Investigated

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：叛变科学官
entries.en: Wanderlust: Rogue Scientist

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]理论科学委员会的主席和一架非常规科研船原型机一起消失了。\n\n我们已经将他们的下落锁定到三个可能的地点，可以依次排查。
entries.en: The Chair of the [Root.GetName]'s Abstract Sciences Board has gone missing along with an unorthodox Science Ship prototype.\n\nTheir current whereabouts have been narrowed down to three likely locations, to be investigated in turn.

entries.zh: 可能的地点已搜索完毕
entries.en: Likely Locations Searched

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：热力追踪
entries.en: Wanderlust: Hot Pursuit

entries.zh: 首席再次消失，但这一次他们留下了一些踪迹。
entries.en: The Chair has vanished again, but this time they left a trail.

entries.zh: 已追踪到科学官
entries.en: Scientist Pursued

entries.zh: 浪迹星涯：对峙
entries.en: Wanderlust: Confrontation

entries.zh: 无论他们的动机是什么，必须把首席带回[Root.Capital.GetName]。\n\n他们是要写下革命性的论文还是只受到纪律处分呢？我们拭目以待吧。
entries.en: Whatever their motives may be, the Chair must be brought back to [Root.Capital.GetName].\n\nWhether they will write a revolutionary thesis or simply face disciplinary action remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 已抓捕科学官
entries.en: Scientist Apprehended

entries.zh: 最后的已知地点
entries.en: Last Known Location

entries.zh: 首席的科研船最后的已知地点，在[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系边界之外。
entries.en: The last known location of the Chair's Science Ship, outside of the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system's borders.

entries.zh: 最后提到的目的地
entries.en: Last Stated Destination

entries.zh: 根据他们传给[Root.Capital.GetName]的最后信息来看，这就是首席的目的地。
entries.en: The Chair's destination, as per their last message to [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 预计超光速终点
entries.en: Projected FTL Endpoint

entries.zh: 碰巧的是，[Root.Capital.GetName]的一个远距离传感列阵检测到了疑似超光速旅行留下的微弱能源信号。\n\n此路径与已知的任何航线均不匹配，很可能是首席科学官留下的。
entries.en: As luck would have it, a long-distance sensor array on [Root.Capital.GetName] picked up faint energy signatures that may or may not have resulted from FTL travel.\n\nThe trajectory does not match any known flight paths, making the Chair a likely suspect.

entries.zh: 继续追踪
entries.en: The Hunt Continues

entries.zh: 在破解了科研船原型机的特殊能源特征后，我们又进行了一些复杂的数学运算，终于知道首席逃到了哪个星系。
entries.en: Having deciphered the prototype Science Ship's peculiar energy signatures and applied some fairly complex mathematics, we now know what system the Chair fled to.

entries.zh: 一丝机会
entries.en: The Window

entries.zh: 看来首席快要到达他们的最终目的地了。
entries.en: It seems the Chair is about to reach their final destination.

entries.zh: 古往今来的大灭绝
entries.en: Mass Extinction Through the Ages

entries.zh: 为了避免[Root.Capital.GetName]上可能发生的大灾难造成严重后果，我们必须研究其他星球上的灾难都造成了什么后果。
entries.en: To avoid a potential apocalypse on [Root.Capital.GetName], we must study the effects that major calamities have had on other planets.

entries.zh: 重建大灭绝场景
entries.en: Mass Extinctions Reconstructed

entries.zh: 崩坏的行星
entries.en: Broken Planet

entries.zh: 环绕行星的小行星带成了曾经巨大灾难的唯一见证。
entries.en: An asteroid belt orbits a star as the only witness to some great cataclysm.

entries.zh: 燃烧的行星
entries.en: Burned Planet

entries.zh: 这个行星被自身地狱般的熔岩吞噬了。
entries.en: This planet wallows in its own infernal crucible.

entries.zh: 荒芜的行星
entries.en: Desolate Planet

entries.zh: 这个行星虽然非常适合生命的繁衍，但十分荒芜。
entries.en: This planet is impressively barren, despite advantageous conditions for sustaining life.

entries.zh: 充满毒气的行星
entries.en: Noxious Planet

entries.zh: 充斥整个行星的大气层的毒气似乎是最近突然出现的。
entries.en: The toxic fumes that now dominate this planet's atmosphere appear to have originated fairly recently and suddenly.

entries.zh: 寒冷的行星
entries.en: Chilly Planet

entries.zh: 天文观测数据显示这颗星球过去没这么寒冷荒芜。
entries.en: Astronomical records indicate that this planet was not always a frozen wasteland.

entries.zh: 滑动
entries.en: Slithering

entries.zh: 有什么东西正在[Root.GetName]的沙中移动……
entries.en: Something moves with near-purpose through the sands of [Root.GetName]...

entries.zh: 似乎是某种近亲
entries.en: Kinship, of a Sort

entries.zh: 有什么东西正在[Root.GetName]下面移动……
entries.en: Something moves with near-purpose down on [Root.GetName]...

entries.zh: 水生生物
entries.en: The Life Aquatic

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的海域及其周边都有非常明显的生命迹象。
entries.en: There are distinct signs of life in and near the seas of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 监视荒漠
entries.en: Stalking the Wastes

entries.zh: 即使是性能较弱的光学阵列也能轻易识别出[Root.GetName]地表的生物活动迹象。
entries.en: Even weak optical arrays can easily pick out traces of biological activity on the surface of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 陆与海之间
entries.en: Between Land and Sea

entries.zh: 即使在一个一半是岩石类土壤的陆地、一半是海水的行星上生命也能顽强地生存下来。
entries.en: It seems life has found a way, even on a planet torn between the extremes of rocky soils and liquid seas.

entries.zh: 相当潮湿
entries.en: Fairly Humid

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的环境很适合生命繁衍，至少很适合微生物——再大些的生物应该也行。
entries.en: The conditions on [Root.GetName] are ideal for life, at least on the microbial level - and maybe beyond.

entries.zh: 低温生物
entries.en: Cryostatic Biology

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]天寒地冻，光学扫描效果不好，但热度特征显示地表下存在一些生命活动。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] is frozen and anonymous to optical scans, but heat signatures indicate some activity just below the surface.

entries.zh: 在厚厚的冰上
entries.en: On Thick Ice

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的永冻层与暴风雪之间有生物在移动。
entries.en: Somewhere below the ice-storms and above the permafrost of [Root.GetName], there is movement.

entries.zh: 漫天黄沙
entries.en: Billowing Sands

entries.zh: 很难想象[Root.GetName]上会有生命，地表是无尽的硅酸盐分子海洋。但就算这样……
entries.en: It is hard to imagine life on [Root.GetName], its surface an endless sea of silicate particles. And yet...

entries.zh: 匍匐于行星表面
entries.en: Crawling, on the Planet's Face

entries.zh: 节肢动物们在[Root.GetName]上轻松地移动。
entries.en: Arthropodal herds navigate [Root.GetName]'s blasted surface with ease.

entries.zh: 近距离观察的话，小行星[From.From.GetName]非常宁静。[Root.GetLeaderName]的一个助手终于承认他们可能误读了仪器数据。
entries.en: On closer inspection, the asteroid [From.From.GetName] is found to be silent. One of [Root.GetLeaderName]'s assistants eventually confesses that they may have misread the instruments.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]艰难的在[From.From.GetName]周围密集的遗骸区域中航行。等到[Root.GetLeaderName]和船员抵达的时候，之前传感器上捕捉到的数据已经消失了。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] struggles to safely navigate the dense debris field surrounding [From.From.GetName]. Whatever their sensors picked up on is gone by the time [Root.GetLeaderName] and crew arrive.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的探针对[From.From.GetName]地表的数次扫描无功而返。我们把时间和资源对此行星进行详尽的调查，却最终没有什么成果，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]为此向大家诚挚道歉。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName]'s probes find over the course of their many sweeps over [From.From.GetName]'s surface. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has issued a formal apology for wasting time and resources on a detailed, fruitless, survey of the planet.

entries.zh: 在太空中看到的壮丽景象离近了往往就没那么好看。[Root.GetName]已经绕[From.GetName]运行了一段时间来研究它的磨损情况，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]最终确认行星的结构并非智能生命之功，而是由普通的气象学因素造成的。
entries.en: What appeared from space to be impressive structures are, up close, somewhat disappointing. The [Root.GetName] remained in orbit around [From.GetName] for a time to study the planet's weather patterns, after which Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] was able to confirm that the planetary structures are the result of mundane meteorological factors and not the efforts of intelligent life.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的船员能够准确将来自[From.From.GetName]极热地表的求救信号进行三角测量之前，信号就消失了。鉴于没有准确的地理位置信息，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]觉得贸然发起营救行动太过危险。
entries.en: Before the crew of the [Root.GetName] could decisively triangulate the distress signal from the super-heated surface of [From.From.GetName], it disappeared. Without a specific geographic point to focus on, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] deems a rescue attempt too dangerous to pursue.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.From.GetName]的地表结构根本不是我们的关注点，继续研究下去就是浪费时间。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] of the [Root.GetName] reports that the structures on the surface of [From.From.GetName] are utterly beneath our notice and their time is better spent elsewhere.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的成员报告称被雕刻成寺庙状的小行星确实很漂亮。\n\n以上为报告的全部内容。
entries.en: The crew of the [Root.GetName] report that the asteroid, carved into the likeness of some sort of temple, is indeed pretty.\n\nThat is all.

entries.zh: 登上[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetLeaderName]小队发现[From.From.GetName]的独特声音其实是星球上的野生生物在一起唱歌的声音。\n\n他们觉得继续调查下去并不合适。
entries.en: [Root.GetLeaderName]'s crew aboard the [Root.GetName] have determined that the unique aural features of [From.From.GetName] are due to the wildlife on the planet coming together in a capella renditions of unknown, alien songs.\n\nThey did not see fit to investigate the matter further.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]未能从冰冻气体星球[From.From.GetName]取得任何有价值的样本。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] was unable to recover any samples of interest from the ice giant [From.From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的探测器发现了一个非常原始的外星科技构造。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]急切地要启动它，结果反倒破坏了它。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName]'s exploratory probe uncover a fairly slapdash configuration of alien technology. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s ill-advised attempts to activate the thing unfortunately lead to its destruction.

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]起草了一份报告，称他们对不得不研究[From.From.GetName]感到很不满意，因为从中没有发现任何有价值的东西。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has issued a report indicating that they are none too pleased having been ordered to study [From.From.GetName], where they have found nothing of interest.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]已经绕[From.GetName]运动了一段时间了，全天候检测它的放射物。此时科学专员[Root.GetName]决定穿上宇航服登上这颗小行星采集一些矿物样本。\n\n他们登上行星表面之后，[From.From.GetName]的类无线电波传输功率突然呈几何倍数增加。微波在几分钟之内就把[Root.GetLeaderName]活活烤死了。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] had been orbiting [From.GetName] for some time, monitoring its emanations without incident, when Science Officer [Root.GetName] decided to suit up and spacewalk on the asteroid and procure some mineral samples.\n\nAs they touched down on its surface, [From.From.GetName]'s radio-like transmissions suddenly and drastically started increasing in intensity. The microwaves boiled [Root.GetLeaderName] alive within minutes.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]进入[From.From.GetName]周围密集的碎片区后不久就与我们失去了联系。\n\n几天之后，我们在场的边缘发现了一个救生舱；科学专员[Root.GetName]活了下来，但不记得[Root.GetName]和她的船员遭遇了什么事。
entries.en: We lost track of the [Root.GetName] shortly after it entered the dense field of debris surrounding [From.From.GetName].\n\nDays later, we recovered an escape pod from the edge of the field; Science Officer [Root.GetName] survived, but has no memory of what became of the [Root.GetName] or her crew.

entries.zh: 科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]对[From.GetName]粗鲁的探测惹恼了行星轨道上的两只巨大的§Y缇扬奇§!。这些生物对[Root.GetName]构成了巨大威胁。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s careless probing of [From.GetName] has angered the two massive §YTiyanki§! that orbit the planet. These creatures pose a substantial threat to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]上的奇特结构是个古老的陷阱。在[Root.GetName]着陆之前，飞船就被几个古代战斗无人机偷袭了。
entries.en: The curious formations on [From.From.GetName] are an ancient trap. Before the [Root.GetName] was able to land, the ship was set upon by a small number of old combat drones.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在低飞搜寻求救信号的过程中被[From.From.GetName]表面的岩浆喷发击中了。\n\n没有生还者。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] was struck by a sudden eruption of magma from the surface of [From.From.GetName] as it was flying low, trying to get a lock on the distress signal.\n\nThere were no survivors.

entries.zh: 根据[Root.GetName]的报告，[From.From.GetName]关注点是这里之前有专属的娱乐场地。这个建筑距今多长时间，当初为何会建在[From.From.GetName]上，尚不确定。\n\n[Root.GetName]的船员还报告了科学专员的逝世，他被“摩天轮”般的建筑砸死了。
entries.en: The point of interest on [From.From.GetName] was once, according to reports from the [Root.GetName], some sort of area dedicated to recreation and amusement. Its age is uncertain, as is the reason why it was established on [From.From.GetName] in the first place.\n\nThe crew of the [Root.GetName] also report the regrettable passing of their Science Officer, who was crushed by a toppling structure identified only as a "Ferris wheel."

entries.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]依然坚称[Root.GetName]的船员在雕刻华丽的中空的[From.From.GetName]里没有任何发现。\n\n但科学家身上出现了一些变化。
entries.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] remains adamant that the crew of the [Root.GetName] found nothing within the ornately sculpted, hollowed-out [From.From.GetName].\n\nBut something about the scientist has changed.

entries.zh: 在他们的最后一条信息里，[Root.GetName]的成员在靠近[From.From.GetName]地表时观测到一些声响。之后通讯就中断了，飞船和全体船员失踪，可能已经死亡。
entries.en: In their last message, the crew of the [Root.GetName] reported aural activity spiking on [From.From.GetName] as they were approaching the surface. Communications were cut off shortly after, and the ship and all aboard are missing, presumed dead.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员为了收集尽可能多的冰层样本，使得飞船的飞行高度低于最低安全高度。大气中的超临界流体进入了飞船的后部推进器，造成了灾难性的后果。\n\n没有人活了下来。
entries.en: The crew let the [Root.GetName] slip below minimum safe altitude in their attempt to gather as many ice samples as possible. By some happenstance atmospheric supercritical fluids got into the ship's rear thrusters, with disastrous results.\n\nThere were no survivors.

entries.zh: 当[Root.GetName]靠近[From.From.GetName]时，它被一些充满敌意的走私船拦截了。这些家伙攻击了小行星，摧毁了他们之前在上面活动的一切证据。下一个目标应该就是[Root.GetName]了。
entries.en: As the [Root.GetName] approaches [From.From.GetName], it is intercepted by a couple of less-than-friendly smuggling ships. The hostiles turn their weapons on the asteroid, destroying all evidence of whatever operation they were running there. The [Root.GetName] is next, it seems.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的成员报告称科学专员对[From.From.GetName]的雨特别感兴趣，用他们的话说，“那里的雨水居然是紫色的”。\n\n不幸的是，这些矿藏样本非常的不稳定，在[Root.GetName]的实验室引起了一场爆炸，科学专员当场死亡。
entries.en: The crew of the [Root.GetName] report that the ship's Science Officer took a particular interest in the rain on [From.From.GetName], as it is, in their words, "kind of purple."\n\nUnfortunately, the precipitation samples retrieved turned out to be highly volatile, and once unsealed in the lab aboard the [Root.GetName] the liquid violently combusted, killing the Science Officer instantly.

entries.zh: 在他们发出的最后一条信息里，[Root.GetName]的成员在靠近[From.From.GetName]地表时观测到一些声响。之后通讯就中断了，飞船和全体船员失踪，可能已经死亡。
entries.en: In their last message, the crew of the [Root.GetName] reported activity spiking on [From.From.GetName] as they approached the surface. Communications were cut off shortly thereafter, and the ship and all aboard are missing, presumed dead.

entries.zh: 实际上[Root.GetName]对旧式结构体系统的狂热探查已经适得其反了。\n\n在古老电路彻底熔断之前，[Root.GetName]设法远程启动了轨道站的变位推进器——及时的将其踢出了原有轨道，使其进入了该行星的重力井中。这次任务的不幸结果对从这一经历中成长起来的指挥官[Root.GetLeaderName]产生了深远的影响。
entries.en: It appears as if the [Root.GetName]'s enthusiastic probing of the old construct's systems has, quite literally, backfired.\n\nBefore the ancient circuits finally fried, the [Root.GetName] managed to remotely activate the orbital station's positional thrusters - promptly knocking it out of its gentle orbit and into the star's gravity well. The mission's unfortunate outcome has had a profound impact on the ship's commander, [Root.GetLeaderName], who has grown from the experience.

entries.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]……把它发射到恒星里去？
entries.en: [Root.GetLeaderName]... launched it into the sun?

entries.zh: §Y古代工厂§!已被摧毁。
entries.en: The §YAncient Manufactory§! is destroyed.\n

entries.zh: 序幕
entries.en: A Prelude

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]的卫星上有异动。

初步扫描显示一些古代科技已经被启动，或许是对我们的殖民行为作出的反应。

我们的几个顶级科学家非常想去调查一下这个卫星，并为此准备好了一项特殊研究项目。
entries.en:
Something stirs on the moon of [Root.GetName].

Preliminary scans indicate that some ancient technology has become active, possibly as a response to our colonization efforts.

Several of our top scientists are eager to take a closer look at the moon, and have prepared a special research project.

entries.zh: 他们当然感兴趣了。
entries.en: Of course they have.

entries.zh: 古代无人机：发现
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Discovery

entries.zh:
这当然是一群难以控制的无人机。

无人机对我们的错误敌我识别令早先的失望一扫而空——它们把我们当成已经逝去的主人的种群！见到我们似乎让他们很激动——如果这么老的人工智能有“激动”这种功能的话。但不幸的是，这些无人机很快就再次进入了休眠状态，我们也无法重新唤醒它们。

这样的话，不如拆开来看看吧。
entries.en:
It is a gaggle of wayward drones, of course.

Initial disappointment was swept away by the drones' erroneous IFF classification of us - they think we are a race affiliated with their long-dead masters! They seemed very excited, if old AI constructs can be excited, to see us. Unfortunately, the drones again lapsed into inactivity shortly after and we have been unable to resuscitate them.

Or take them apart, for that matter.

entries.zh: 时刻注意情况。
entries.en: Keep an eye on the situation.

entries.zh: 古老无人机：觉醒
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Awakening

entries.zh: 这些无人机从休眠中苏醒，并来到了[Root.GetName]的地表。它们礼貌的拒绝了我们的友好沟通，并开始将行星上的一小片地区环境改造。我们不清楚他们这种行为有何目的，但对殖民地似乎是无害的。
entries.en: The drones woke from their slumber and descended to the surface of [Root.GetName]. Attempts to communicate were met with polite dismissal as they set about terraforming a small area of the planet. We do not know the nature of whatever ancient directive they are executing, but it does not seem detrimental to the colony.

entries.zh: 呃，只要他们的行为能对我们有益就好……
entries.en: Well, as long as their activities benefit us...

entries.zh: 无人机从地表移走了一个随机的£blocker£§Y地块障碍§!，没有碰其他的地方。\n
entries.en: The drones remove a random £blocker£ §YTile Blocker§! from the surface, leaving the planet otherwise untouched.\n

entries.zh: 古老无人机：到达过去的天空
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Reaching For Past Skies

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]卫星上陆陆续续有休眠的无人机再苏醒过来，它们做的事情也让人喜忧参半。\n\n在天上无数监视器的监视下，它们在夜色中于我们在[Root.GetName]上的主要殖民地外不远处建立起了一个巨大建筑的初步架构。工程师认为这是叫做“太空电梯”的过时产物，或许在我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]进入星际旅行之前的那个时代很常见。最终我们还是要摧毁它，因为它阻碍了殖民地的发展，不过安全的摧毁它还是需要花些时间。我们的工程师正好想近距离研究一下这个东西。
entries.en: The old drones fitfully dormant on [Root.GetName]'s moon have become active again, and their work is a mixed blessing.\n\nUnder the cover of night and spotty airspace surveillance, they have erected the framework of some gigantic structure a short distance away from our primary settlement on [Root.GetName]. Our engineers are convinced it is the realization of some outmoded concept known as a "space elevator," perhaps a common sight in the times before we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] first took to the stars. It will eventually have to be razed as it stands in the way of our expansion plans for the colony, and bringing it down safely will take some time. At least our engineers are giddy with excitement at the prospect of studying the thing up close.

entries.zh: 随他们去吧。
entries.en: Good for them.

entries.zh: 古老无人机：本性慷慨
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Spontaneous Generosity

entries.zh: 再次苏醒之后，这些无人机暂时在传感器上消失了。回来的时候，它们拖着一大箱不知从什么地方运来的矿物。在发出一个损坏严重的猝发传输信号表明他们已经完成了指定任务后，它们就把这些矿物丢在了[Root.GetName]的地表。\n\n之后它们就回到了月球上。
entries.en: After waking yet again, the drones briefly disappeared from sensors. When they returned, it was with a large cache of minerals of unknown origin in tow. They dumped it on the surface of [Root.GetName] after sending a badly corrupted burst transmission indicating that they had fulfilled a requisition request.\n\nThen they went back to the moon.

entries.zh: 免费的矿物，这种好事不常有。
entries.en: Free minerals. No complaints.

entries.zh: 古老无人机：远亲
entries.en: Ancient Drones: An Estranged Relative

entries.zh: 卫星上的信号激增提醒我们[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的无人机已再次苏醒。这次它给我们带来了一个好东西：深层出土的古老卫星。并且它们已经对其进行了一定程度的整修。我们不清楚卫星是怎么跑到这里来的，也不知道无人机为什么到现在才把它挖出来。尽管如此，即使它的数据库里只有一小部分保存了下来，也足够我们了解这些无人机的主人曾经所在的帝国的日常生活情况了。
entries.en: Frantic signal bursts from the moon alerted us to the fact that the old drones on [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have woken yet again. This time they bring us a significant prize, as they have unearthed an ancient satellite from the depths of their moon and partially repaired it. We do not know how the satellite ended up there, nor why the drones have ignored it until now. Regardless, if even a fragment of its databanks have survived, there is a lot we can learn about day-to-day life in the empires that the drones first served.

entries.zh: 古代无人机：无人机的崩溃
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Drone Debacle

entries.zh:
一直沉睡的无人机发生了巨大转变，不再做不规则运动。一部分苏醒了过来，像往常一样进入[Root.GetName]的大气中，却一头全速撞向了行星的地面。

相同的情况一直在发生。

殖民地没有受到多大损失，但这些脆弱无比的无人机却变成了一团团闪着蓝色火花的废铁，好像在诉说着它们自我毁灭的决心和力量。
entries.en:
The erratic behavior of the narcoleptic drones have taken a violent turn. A number of them woke and entered the atmosphere of [Root.GetName], as is their wont, only to slam into the surface of the planet at full thrust.

Repeatedly, in many cases.

Damage to the colony was negligible but the nigh-invulnerable drones were destroyed in bright showers of blue sparks, indicative of the tremendous force of, and dedication to, their self-destruction.

entries.zh: 我们能搞清楚它们到底是怎么了吗？
entries.en: Can we find out what was wrong with them?

entries.zh: 古代无人机：寻找无人机
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Looking For Drones

entries.zh: 自毁事件之后，剩余的无人机就消失了。[Root.GetName]的历史学家认为它们仍徘徊在附近，在某些失落科技的保护下隐蔽不见，但它们并没与在本应苏醒的时间苏醒过来。\n\n对自毁无人机遗迹的深度分析进展缓慢，但应该马上就会有突破了。
entries.en: The surviving drones have been missing since the suicide incident. History buffs on [Root.GetName] are convinced the drones are still in close proximity, shielded from view by some lost technology, but the expected time window for their next activation has come and gone.\n\nProgress on deep analysis of the destroyed drones' remains has been slow, but a breakthrough is expected soon.

entries.zh: 有新消息随时通知我。
entries.en: Keep me posted.

entries.zh: 古代无人机：淘金
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Panning For Gold

entries.zh: 从破碎的无人机内部找寻故障所花费的时间比预计的长得多，因为每个无人机的内部结构和组装部件都不尽相同。知晓了这一点，那当务之急就是要找出相同的部件。单独来看这些部件的话，如果是外星人制作的，那肯定是现代的东西。如此就很可能是有人做了我们做不到的事情，篡改了这些无人机。
entries.en: Sorting out the errant innards of the shattered drones took much longer than anticipated, as each drone seems to have been built from a slightly different design, assembled from slightly different parts. Once this fact was established, one thing stood out - the parts that were identical. Separated from the rest, it is clear these parts are of somewhat modern, if alien, make. It is likely that someone has done what we could not, and tampered with the drones.

entries.zh: 这需要我们进行深入调查。
entries.en: This warrants further investigation.

entries.zh: 古代无人机：外星人没见过的
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Alien to the Aliens

entries.zh: 将它们组装起来之后，我们的专家认为这些无人机残骸内部的外星部件是单向通讯设备。它们并未处在接收状态，所以我们可以推断出这些无人机不是在第三方的指令下进行活动，而是有什么个体一直在监视这些无人机的活动。建议对此事进行进一步调查。
entries.en: Having pieced them together, the foreign objects inside the destroyed drones have been identified by our experts as one-way transmitters. Since they are not set to receive, it is safe to assume that the drones were not acting at the behest of some third party. Rather, some entity has been keeping tabs on the drones' activities. It is advisable to look into this matter.

entries.zh: 继续进行监视。
entries.en: Continue our monitoring efforts.

entries.zh: 古老无人机：上天的回答
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Answers Above

entries.zh:
我们找到了剩下的无人机，它们漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上。

我们已经了解到它们只是某些派系周密计划里的小喽啰。根据我们了解的类似行动的掌握，这个派系很可能是某个特别古老而智慧的海盗集团。他们比我们先发现了这些无人机，做了我们做不到的事情，改装了这些无人机。虽然听起来没那么厉害—他们做的只是将单独的外星科技放进无人机里，但是这些外星海盗的科技水平比我们高出许多，至少在某些领域是这样。安装完毕之后，这些海盗将它们放回太空，他们知道这些无人机的目的是为了帮助原主人建设殖民地，而随着时间的流逝，这些无人机鉴别主人的能力正在减弱。无人机一直在帮我们建设殖民地，而海盗一直在监视，一直在等待发动攻击的好时机。

我们的战斗分析员预测这些海盗会在两年之内发起攻击。
entries.en:
We have found the remaining drones, drifting into orbit around [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. We have learned that they are unwitting pawns in an elaborate scheme set up by an unknown faction.

Going by the modus operandi of this operation, this faction is most likely a particularly old and particularly clever pirate syndicate. They must have found the drones drifting through space and done what we could not; modified them. While not as impressive as it sounds - all they did was introduce self-contained alien technology into the drones - fact remains that these alien pirates possess a technological know-how far in advance of our own, at least in certain areas. Having installed their comms devices in the drones, the pirates let them drift through space again, knowing that they are set to assist their original masters' colonists and that the drones' ability to accurately identify such colonists has degraded with age. The drones have essentially been fattening up our colony as the pirates watch, waiting for the ideal time to strike.

Our military analysts predict that the pirates will strike within the next two years.

entries.zh: 尽管来吧。
entries.en: Let them come.

entries.zh: 夺取无人机，用它们毁灭它们将来的主人。
entries.en: Capture the drones, send them to destroy their would-be masters.

entries.zh: 我们不能再放任这种事情发生。拆除所有无人机。
entries.en: We must not let this happen again. Dismantle the drones.

entries.zh: 古代无人机：永诀
entries.en: Ancient Drones: A Final Goodbye

entries.zh: 我们夺取了无人机，在其中装满了高爆炸药。我们知道了如何拆解，对它们进行重新设置就没那么难了，我们在海盗舰队可能会经过的位置给他们准备了一份大餐。顶级[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]科学家们植入了我们的敌我识别技术来把误伤平民的几率降到最低。
entries.en: We have captured the drones and fitted them with explosive charges. Reprogramming them proved to be a relatively easy task now that we know how to break them open, and we have plotted a course for the estimated location of the pirate fleet. Top [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] scientists have implemented our own IFF technology to minimize the risk of the drones attacking innocents.

entries.zh: 让它们去吧。
entries.en: Let them fly.

entries.zh: 古代无人机：伤痕累累，惶恐不安
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Wounded and Volatile

entries.zh: 海盗舰队来袭，比预期早一些。我们的先发制人成功地打击并激怒了他们——舰队规模比预期少了30%。
entries.en: The pirate fleet is inbound, earlier than expected. It is likely our preemptive strike was successful both in provoking and damaging them - their fleet is roughly 30% smaller than projected.

entries.zh: 古代无人机：他们无所不在
entries.en: Ancient Drones: They're Everywhere

entries.zh: 海盗舰队来袭，比预期晚一些。从舰队的组成和阵型来看，他们为了尽快消灭[Root.GetName]而找来了盟友。
entries.en: The pirate fleet has arrived, somewhat later than expected. Judging by the makeup of the fleet and formations used, they have rallied their allies in an effort to pillage and burn [Root.GetName] as quickly and decisively as possible.

entries.zh: 绝不允许他们这么做。
entries.en: They will do no such thing.

entries.zh: 古代无人机：决战
entries.en: Ancient Drones: Showdown

entries.zh: 时间到了，海盗舰队准时到达。
entries.en: The time has come, and the pirate armada arrives on cue.

entries.zh: 我们早已迫不及待地想战斗了。
entries.en: This fight has been a long time coming.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：花之魅力
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Floral Fascination

entries.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]建立了殖民地，当地的一些植物在释放大量含有复杂化学成分的花粉。\n\n为此准备了一项特别研究计划，来研究这种植物。
entries.en: Several plants native to [Root.GetName], where we recently established a colony, exude copious amounts of a pollen with an astounding chemical complexity.\n\nA special research project has been prepared for further study of this flora.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：唤醒嗅觉
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Olfactory Arousal

entries.zh: 长期暴露在[Root.GetName]大气中的花粉会对信息素受体产生轻微催情效果，随之而来的是一种不易察觉的“兴奋”。而效果最强的植物在这颗星球各处都很常见；被[Root.GetName]的科学家储存在了一个隐蔽的地方，在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]当地语言中被称为“玛琳·卡琳”。
entries.en: Long-term exposure to the pollen naturally occurring in [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere acts on the colonists' pheromone receptors with a mild aphrodisiac effect, accompanied by a barely-perceptible "high." The plant that produces the most potent strain is a flower common to all areas of the planet; squirreled away into some obscure taxonomic nook by scientists on [Root.GetName] but known in the local [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] dialect as "Mharin Kharin."

entries.zh: 我们不能让这种影响心智的东西留在大气中。
entries.en: We cannot allow mind-altering particles in the atmosphere.

entries.zh: 我们能彻底消灭这种植物的手段。
entries.en: We do not have the resources to exterminate the plant.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：准备应付花朵
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Making Time for Petals

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]的报告显示最近的工作效率开始下降，在比[Root.Owner.GetName]的平均值低好几个百分点的地方稳定下来。

这有可能是由星球上的刺激性花粉造成的。

很可能是。

已发起§Y特殊项目§!来进一步，以期提高生产线效率来弥补损失。
entries.en:
Reports from [Root.GetName] indicate that worker productivity has declined recently, becoming stable at levels several percent lower than the [Root.Owner.GetName] average.

This may or may not be due to the stimulating effects of the pollen native to the planet.

It probably is.

A §YSpecial Project§! has been prepared should we wish to make our production pipelines more efficient to make up for the loss.

entries.zh: 我们看看能做点什么。
entries.en: Let's see what can be done.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：研究花朵
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Work Over Flowers

entries.zh: 通过对[Root.GetName]上的时间管理模型进行深刻革命，并对所有生产领域的责任和各项职责进行重新分配，我们收到了良好的效果。大众的要求显而易见，而外界观察者会将其称作公开需求，那就是要与当地的植物群落保持紧密的联系。\n\n可是即使运用合理的时间分配和额外的即时检查，生产效率仍旧很低，只是至少已经脱离了不可接受的最低水平。
entries.en: Far-reaching changes to time management paradigms and the way responsibility is delegated within all fields of production and other duties on [Root.GetName] have produced good results. The populace has an evident desire - outside observers would call it an outright need - to be in close proximity to the native flora.\n\nWith clever scheduling and additional checks in place, productivity remains low but has risen above the lower limit of what can be deemed acceptable.

entries.zh: 干得好。
entries.en: Good work.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：无法移动
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Rooted in Place

entries.zh: 最近的调查报告显示，[Root.GetName]上的居民比[Root.Owner.GetName]的其他居民更不愿意迁移到其他殖民地。\n\n玛琳·卡琳和它的近亲植物会造成一种轻度的心理上的感知依赖。但是调查报告中并没有指明两件事情之间有任何关联。
entries.en: A recent survey indicates that residents of [Root.GetName] are much less likely than other denizens of the [Root.Owner.GetName] to migrate to other colonies.\n\nThe survey does not address whether this could be due to a psychological dependency on the low-level sensory arousal caused by Mharin Kharin and its sibling-plants.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：通信故障
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Transmission Trouble

entries.zh: 尽管星球上的生产力不再下降了，[Root.GetName]上殖民城市和[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上首府之间的通信却开始崩溃。[Root.GetName]上的高级官员之间开始变得越来越冷淡，我们的办事员不断抱怨说即使只是发送一个简单的指令现在都变成了一件困难重重的事。
entries.en: While productivity is no longer declining on the planet, communications between the colony on [Root.GetName] and the capital on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] are breaking down. Senior officials on [Root.GetName] are growing increasingly distant, and our clerks are complaining that even relaying simple directives is becoming an exercise in frustration.

entries.zh: 哎。
entries.en: Sigh.

entries.zh: 派遣一支行政特遣队。代号淡紫。
entries.en: Deploy an administrative task force. Code mauve.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：高层统治者的背叛
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Upper Management Betrayal

entries.zh: 我们送去[Root.GetName]处理问题的行政小队好像背叛了。幸运的是，他们的计划起到的作用简直是微乎其微。他们的计划进行得极慢，一下子就被我们发现了，真是一点都不令人感到惊奇。风水轮流转——这只是个比喻而已——我们最后的手段就是废除当地的政府，然后直接从首府那里管理殖民地的事务。
entries.en: It appears that the crack team of administrators we sent to [Root.GetName] in order to set things straight have been turned. Fortunately for us, their plot to do as little work as possible was, unsurprisingly, sloppily executed and easily discovered. Heads will roll - metaphorically speaking of course - as our last recourse is to depose the local government and manage the colony's affairs from the capital.

entries.zh: 结果可能会有点难看。
entries.en: It won't be pretty.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：远处来的铁腕
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: With an Iron Fist, From Afar

entries.zh: 我们的从属政策已经在[Root.GetName]上根深蒂固了。它成功地控制了花粉植物玛琳·卡琳的繁殖。它还成功减少了人们对“使用”这种植物的接受度——这成就可不小，因为这种行为和闻闻花香一样没什么可指摘的。
entries.en: Our remote-government of [Root.GetName] is now firmly established. It has met with some success in suppressing the proliferation of the pollen-bearing plant Mharin Kharin as well as in eroding the community's acceptance of "using" it - no small feat considering the act is as innocent as smelling a flower.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：砍掉，烧掉
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Slash and Burn

entries.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上面的从属治理一直在进行着生硬而卓有成效的管理。据说掌控大权的国会——显然他们更喜欢躲在房间里呼吸玛琳·卡琳的花粉——已经控制了我们安排在星球上面的一支军团。从属治理希望用这些部队对那些花发起一次进攻，让他们安装一些大气过滤机，并把这种植物从市区完全抹除。
entries.en: Our remote-governance of [Root.GetName] continues to be a somewhat awkward but effective arrangement. The council in charge has allegedly secured the loyalty of a faction of our armed forces on the planet - apparently they prefer staying indoors to breathing in the Mharin Kharin pollen. The remote-government wishes to use these troops to mount an offensive on the flower, having them erect atmospheric purifiers and wiping the plant from all urban areas entirely.

entries.zh: 我们早就该这么做了。
entries.en: We should have done this a long time ago.

entries.zh: 这种会使人头脑不清的植物现在已经被严格管控了。它被隔离在人口密集的局域之外。这会移除所有与之相关的修正。\n
entries.en: The intoxicating plant is strictly controlled and contained outside of populated areas, removing all related modifiers.\n

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：花粉崇拜
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Pollen Worship

entries.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的边缘分子联合起来，组成了一个准宗教事务性质的组织。他们想要控制玛琳·卡琳的种植。他们的领袖，一个自封为“圣花宫殿”的“绿色祭司”的人，宣称他为[Root.GetName]上的整个生态圈代言，并要求获得这种植物的独家贸易权。

这当然是不可能的，我们也不会接受。[Root.GetName]当地植物体系并没有什么战略或经济价值，因此依法也不能运送到其它星球。

不幸的是，他们似乎很不情愿接受这个现实。
entries.en:
Fringe elements on [Root.GetName] have banded together to form a quasi-religious organization seeking to control all aspects of the Mharin Kharin flower and its cultivation. Their leader, a self-styled "Green Hierophant" of this "Flower Temple" claims to speak for all flora and fauna of [Root.GetName] and demands exclusive trading rights for the plant.

This is of course completely unacceptable and impossible, as the native flora of [Root.GetName] is of little strategic or economic value and thus may not be brought off-world by law.

Unfortunately, they are unlikely to accept this fact gracefully.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：花粉末日的先兆
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Beginning of Pollen's End

entries.zh: 圣花宫殿和它的追随者们的人数现在在[Root.GetName]的总人口中占了不小的比例。报告显示，他们组织的运动出现了一些可疑的改变。他们越来越不热心于走私玛琳·卡琳。圣花宫殿似乎逐渐转变成了一种相信世界末日的宗教事务。大气检测器发现玛琳·卡琳的花粉近期出现了一些变化，也许此事和圣花宫殿的改变有关联。\n\n已发起§Y特殊项目§!来评估此事可能会带来的风险。建议在可能的灾难发生前完成这个项目。
entries.en: The Flower Temple and its followers now make up a sizable minority of the population on [Root.GetName], and reports indicate a disturbing change in the movement. Their futile attempts to smuggle Mharin Kharin specimen off-world have been growing less enthusiastic by the day, as the Flower Temple seems to be transitioning into a doomsday cult. There is likely a correlation with the recent changes in the Mharin Kharin pollen's chemical makeup, detected by atmospheric sensors.\n\nA §YSpecial Project§! has been prepared to assess the risks associated with this, and it is recommended to complete it before something goes horribly wrong.

entries.zh: 很好。
entries.en: Very well.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：灾难已避免
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Disaster Averted

entries.zh:
坚决而迅速的反制措施使我们迅速发现了[Root.GetName]上原生花朵的花粉变化所带来的危险。我们迅速采取了必要措施。

我们彻底疏散了星球上的人群，并且针对玛琳·卡琳及其近亲植物进行了多轮战术性除草轰炸。

这些植物很快就变得对除草剂免疫了。如果这些花粉没有被清除的话，它们就会开始散发一种神经剧毒。所有拥有嗅觉器官的[Root.GetName]生物都会受到致命威胁。

殖民议会的科学家认为这是[Root.GetName]上的一种自然循环。虽然花粉会对我们产生种种不良影响：使我们的当地管理瘫痪，引导圣花骑士教团建立，甚至最终产生剧毒。但是这其实只是偶然的副作用，而不是植物为了自卫而设计的阴谋诡计。

如今，星球的表面上如今已经见不到这些花的踪迹了。我们的殖民地居民们也得到了安全保障，再也不用受到花粉的威胁了。
entries.en:
Quick and decisive action allowed us to identify the risks associated with the rapid changes in the pollen native to [Root.GetName] and take the necessary steps.

The necessary steps were a complete planetary evacuation and a planet-wide tactical pesticide bombing run, targeting the Mharin Kharin flower and its ilk.

The plants were rapidly mutating and their unique pollen would, had they not been destroyed, soon have begun delivering a potent neurotoxin to the olfactory organs of all sapient life on [Root.GetName].

The scientists on the colonization council theorize that this is part of a natural cycle on [Root.GetName] and that the pollen's adverse effects on us, in the form of a crumbling local administration, the rise of the Flower Temple cult, and eventual pollen toxicity, were chance side-effects rather than the product of a plant's sinister self-defense mechanism.

Regardless, any and all traces of the flower have been wiped from the planet's surface, and our colonists are safe and free of the pollen's influence.

entries.zh: 真是大团圆的结局。
entries.en: All's well that ends well.

entries.zh: 这颗星球上的危险花类已经被清除，所有与之相关的修正也都被移除。\n
entries.en: The planet has been purged of the dangerous flower, removing all related modifiers.\n

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：我们的花粉末日
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: The Pollen's End of Us

entries.zh:
灾难降临了。

无数的玛琳·卡琳开始自发地进行变异，就像野火那样一发不可收拾地蔓延开来。它们的花粉开始变得剧毒，我们已经束手无策了。

因为我们发现的太晚，我们没能撤离星球上的居民，中和花粉的尝试也以失败告终。[Root.GetName]上的居民遭受了灭顶之灾。

[Root.GetName]上的植物获得了胜利，但是它们也将付出代价，尽管这件事对我们来说只是一种毫无意义的安慰。玛琳·卡琳所属的种群由于过度繁殖，导致土壤中缺少它所需要的某种营养物质——很快，这些植物就会死亡。要经过非常长得一段时间以后，这些植物才能重新在生态系统中找到自己的落脚点。谁知道它们到底会不会找到。

[Root.GetName]的居民都丧生了。星球的大气由于植物排放的气体而暂时变得有毒。
entries.en:
Something went horribly wrong.

Vast swaths of Mharin Kharin flowers spontaneously mutated in unison, spreading like wildfire and turning their pollen poisonous, and we were too late.

Both our evacuation efforts and our attempts to neutralize the pollen fell short of the mark and the inhabitants of [Root.GetName] paid the price.

The plant life of [Root.GetName] achieved only a pyrrhic victory, though this fact is scant consolation. The whole genus that Mharin Kharin belonged to burned in the fire of its own unnaturally rapid proliferation. The soil is starved of the specific nutrients the pollinating plants need - once the currently living specimens die, which will be soon, it will be a long time before that flora can again establish a foothold in the ecosystem, if it ever will.

The inhabitants of [Root.GetName] are dead, and the planet's atmosphere is temporarily noxious with plant emissions.

entries.zh: 我们不会忘却这场悲剧的。
entries.en: We will not forget this tragedy.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：一个新的开始
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: A New Beginning

entries.zh: 行星调查队伍汇报说，两年之前导致殖民地毁灭的植物毒性瘴气如今已经挥发殆尽了。这颗星球如今已经不同了。在玛琳·卡琳的怒放之后，它现在变成了一颗寸草不生的沙漠星球，大气中到处弥漫着花粉。\n\n两年也许不足以令我们遗忘[Root.Owner.GetName]曾经居住的那些人所遭遇的悲剧，但是至少现在这颗行星对智慧生命不再抱有敌意了。
entries.en: A planetary surveillance team reports that the toxic miasma that enveloped a planet two years ago and led to the destruction of our colony has lifted. The planet is different now, changed into a desert world after the violent blooming of Mharin Kharin and the atmosphere becoming saturated with pollen.\n\nIt will take more than these two years for the [Root.Owner.GetName] to forget the tragic fate of those who lived there, but the planet itself is no longer actively hostile to sapient life.

entries.zh: 我知道了……
entries.en: I see...

entries.zh: 你的前殖民地如今已经变成了一颗荒芜的星球，如果有正确的技术，您可以将其变成一个可居住的地方。
entries.en: Your former colony has changed into a desert planet, and can be colonized with the right technology.

entries.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：花蕊的沉思
entries.en: Mharin Kharin: Pistil Pondering

entries.zh: 在仔细检查之后，我们发现[Root.GetName]上的植物其实构造非常简单。其中一些花粉有淡淡的刺激性以及迅速变异的倾向；但没有其他的特别之处，没有什么战略用途，也不是什么奢侈品资源。
entries.en: On closer examination, the plants native to [Root.GetName] turn out to be rather dull. Some excrete pollen that have a mild stimulating effect and they are likely to have a propensity for rapid genetic change; hardly impressive enough to warrant adopting as a strategic or luxury resource.

entries.zh: 通讯截获
entries.en: Communications Intercepted

entries.zh: 我们截获了一条发往[CommSpreader.GetName]的消息，我们发现他们和另一个我们尚未发现的帝国建立了定期联系。我们追踪这条消息，与这位星系中的神秘角色建立了通讯线路。
entries.en: By intercepting a message sent to the [CommSpreader.GetName], we have learned that they are in regular contact with another spacefaring empire that we ourselves have no contact with. By tracing this message to its source, we have been able to establish our own line of communications with this previously unknown actor on the galactic stage.

entries.zh: 有趣有趣……
entries.en: Interesting...

entries.zh: 与[contact_empire.GetName]建立联系。
entries.en: Establishes communications with the [contact_empire.GetName].

entries.zh: 新的联络
entries.en: New Contact

entries.zh: 我们从一个太空深处的未知帝国那里收到了一份公报，他们自称§H[From.GetName]§!。他们还声称，他们从我们与另一个帝国的通讯中发现了我们的存在。
entries.en: We have received a communiqué from a previously unknown spacefaring empire that call themselves the §H[From.GetName]§!. They claim to have learned of our existence by listening in on the communications of another empire we are in contact with.

entries.zh: 有趣有趣……
entries.en: Interesting...

entries.zh: 与[From.GetName]建立联系。
entries.en: Establishes communications with the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]暗杀[Root.GetRulerTitle]！
entries.en: [From.GetName] assassinate [Root.GetRulerTitle]!

entries.zh: 似乎作为我们不仅同[From.GetName]停滞圣权开战，更是随后接受了战败这一事实的惩罚，和平谈判结束之后，[From.GetAdj]特工出现在了[Root.GetRulerTitle][rulername.GetName]身旁。\n\n他们用闻所未闻的武器处决了我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。行凶后他们就消失在虚空之中，就好像从未出现过一样。
entries.en: As if to punish us for not only warring with the Stagnant Ascendancy of the [From.GetName] but for then accepting defeat, [From.GetAdj] agents appeared by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [rulername.GetName]'s side after the peace negotiations concluded.\n\nThey dispatched our [Root.GetRulerTitle] with unseen weaponry and practiced brutality before melting away as if they were never there.

entries.zh: 我们战败了，我们被羞辱了，但是我们还会东山再起的。
entries.en: We are defeated and humiliated, but will rise again.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetRulerTitle][rulername.GetName]§R丧生了§!。§!
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetRulerTitle] [rulername.GetName] §Rdies§!.§!

entries.zh: 来自§H[From.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 傲慢的虫子啊！你们认为[Root.GetSpeciesName]玷污者我们圣地的殖民者能够不被注意到吗？立即离开我们的星球或者面对我们舰队的力量吧！
entries.en: Arrogant little wretch! Did you think that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] colonists sullying our holy places would go unnoticed? Leave our worlds immediately or face the might of our fleets!

entries.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
entries.en: We have no choice but to accept...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]绝不会受到欺凌！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be bullied!

entries.zh: 来自§H[From.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们发现你们正在笨拙地尝试创造人工智能，认为你们正在走上灵魂自毁的错误道路上。立即停止这个愚蠢的举动，否则我们会帮你停止。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your fumbling attempts at creating artificial intelligence and come to the conclusion that you are headed down the path of spiritual self-destruction. Abandon this foolish endeavour at once, or we will MAKE you.

entries.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
entries.en: We have no choice but to accept...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]绝不会受到欺凌！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be bullied!

entries.zh: §H$policy_artificial_intelligence_policy$§!政策将被改为§H$ai_outlawed$§!。
entries.en: §H$policy_artificial_intelligence_policy$§! policy will be set to §H$ai_outlawed$§!.

entries.zh: 来自§H[From.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]野蛮人！别以为没人发现你们的暴行。你们肆意的屠杀和奴役行径正在威胁整个星系的未来。我们给你个选择的机会：停止你野蛮的行径，否则就做好准备面对我们的正义制裁吧。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName] barbarians! Your crimes have not gone unnoticed. The enslavement and butchery that you are so wantonly engaging threatens the future of the entire galaxy. We present you with a choice: end your barbarous practices, or prepare to face our righteous might.

entries.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
entries.en: We have no choice but to accept...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]绝不会受到欺凌！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be bullied!

entries.zh: §H$policy_slavery$§!政策将被改为§H$slavery_not_allowed$§!。\n§H$policy_purge$§!政策将改为§H$purge_not_allowed$§!。
entries.en: §H$policy_slavery$§! policy will be set to §H$slavery_not_allowed$§!.\n§H$policy_purge$§! policy will be set to §H$purge_not_allowed$§!.

entries.zh: 来自§H[From.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 顽固的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]！这是对你们冒犯我们领地的最后一次警告！马上撤走，不然我们会替宇宙清除污秽——也就是你们这悲哀渺小的物种。
entries.en: Filthy [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]! You have encroached upon our space for the last time! Withdraw immediately, or we will cleanse the stain upon the universe that is your worthless species.

entries.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
entries.en: We have no choice but to accept...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]绝不会受到欺凌！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be bullied!

entries.zh: 来自§H[From.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 无知的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们对长者的不敬简直大错特错。匍匐在我们面前乞求宽恕，我们或许有可能放过你们那毫无价值的小帝国。
entries.en: Foolish [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The lack of respect you show for your elders will be your undoing. Prostrate yourselves before us and beg our forgiveness, and we may refrain from annihilating your worthless little empire.

entries.zh: 不和谐的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。难道你们没有发现自己是在带来杂音逼我们动手吗。好自为之，不然我们会来帮你们调调音准的。
entries.en: Disharmonious [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Don't you see that by inviting chaos you force us to intervene. Harmonize now or we will tune you.

entries.zh: 愚昧的[Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们拒绝成长演化就是对生命本身的亵渎。乖乖听话，否则我们会把你们连根拔起，反正我们再种下新的种子亦非难事。
entries.en: Stagnant [Root.GetSpeciesName], your refusal to grow and evolve is an affront to life itself. Embrace our teachings, or we will uproot your failure and sow the seeds of progress ourselves

entries.zh: 怯懦的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的帝国就是脆弱的教科书。把你们的弱点咽下去，好好道歉，然后准备接受我们的挑战——否则我们可以随手把你们化为齑粉，用更有价值的人来替代你们。
entries.en: Cowardly [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your empire is a testament to frailty. Now swallow your weakness, apologize, and get ready to meet our challenge - or we will shatter you and replace you with someone more worthy.

entries.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
entries.en: We have no choice but to accept...

entries.zh: 与[from.GetName]结束宿敌关系\n[Root.GetName]失去了所有针对[from.GetName]境内恒星系的宣称。
entries.en: Ends rivalry with [from.GetName]\n[Root.GetName] loses any claims to the [from.GetName]'s systems

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]绝不会受到欺凌！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be bullied!

entries.zh: 来自§H[From.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 对神灵不敬的[Root.GetSpeciesName]啊！你竟敢在亡者之殿中肆意妄为，践踏历史，不敬亡魂。不能再允许你们胡闹下去了！若你们再打扰死者的宁静，就准备面对生者的愤怒吧——没错，就是我们。
entries.en: Blasphemous [Root.GetSpeciesName]! You tread carelessly in the halls of the dead, crushing history underfoot, thinking nothing of the spirits whose rest you disturb. No more! Leave the dead in peace or answer to the living - to us.

entries.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
entries.en: We have no choice but to accept...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]绝不会受到欺凌！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be bullied!

entries.zh: 遭遇$holy_planet$
entries.en: $holy_planet$ Encountered

entries.zh: 我们并不是[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的[from.GetName]的第一位访客。这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球上所蕴含的待开发资源已经足以引人注目，而我们更是发现了一座停泊于高层轨道的古老且装饰华丽的信标。[from.GetName]显然属于某个远古的太空文明，但我们尚未发现他们在此处有任何的定居或勘探的迹象。\n\n可能的理论有很多，但证据迫使我们考虑存在这么一个古老的文明，崇敬着这个郁郁葱葱的星球。我们只能猜测他们目前的下落——也就是说，假设他们仍然存在。
entries.en: We are not the first to visit [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. This [from.GetClassAdj] world is remarkable enough for its abundance of untouched resources, but we also found an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy perched in high orbit. [from.GetName] was clearly known to some ancient, spacefaring civilization, but we can find no evidence that they settled or even prospected here.\n\nTheories abound, but evidence compels us to consider an ancient civilization which once revered this lush world. We can only guess as to their current whereabouts - that is, assuming they still exist.

entries.zh: 在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中，[from.GetName]有过神圣触碰的痕迹。我们位于[root.GetName]上的研究人员表示这个地方充满着深深的崇敬感，在高轨道上发现的一座古老的、装饰华丽的标记信标更加印证了这一说法。
entries.en: There is a touch of the Divine about [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Our researchers aboard the [root.GetName] suggest an aura of deep reverence about this place, backed by their discovery of an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy in high orbit.

entries.zh: $fallen_empires.100.desc.spi_intro$\n\n我们相信[from.GetName]曾一度被视为圣体或者圣地而得到崇拜。至于是谁，我们尚且不知道——我们最好的猜测是，他们是一个已经衰落的唯心主义文明。
entries.en: $fallen_empires.100.desc.spi_intro$\n\nWe believe [from.GetName] may once have been worshipped as a deity, or else it was considered a holy place. To whom, we do not yet know - but our best theories suggest a spiritually-minded civilization which has since fallen into decline.

entries.zh: 我们对[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系中的这颗郁郁葱葱的行星[from.GetName]进行了调查，结果表明，它曾经是另一种未知生命形式非常感兴趣的对象。我们在高轨道上发现了一个古老的导航信标，这表明，这颗行星曾有过外星访客，但在过去的几个世纪里，没有任何登陆或殖民的证据。相反，似乎有什么东西可以在保护这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球——但就目前情况而言，对于这样一个假定的实体，其命运和下落我们依旧不得而知。
entries.en: Our survey of [from.GetName] suggests this bountiful world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was once a subject of keen interest to some other, as yet unknown, life-form. An ancient navigation buoy in high orbit implies the planet has seen alien visitors, but there is no evidence of landfall or colonization in the past few centuries. Instead something seems to have preserved this [from.GetClassAdj] world - but the current fate or whereabouts of such a hypothetical entity are as yet unknown to us.

entries.zh: 我们怀疑，对于[from.GetName]而言，还存在比丰富的资源和原始的自然环境更重要的东西。奇怪的是，[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系里的这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一座古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。这台装置的外壳上蚀刻着复杂的图案，虽然还不是非常肯定，但我们相信这种美术形式应该源自附近的[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]。\n\n他们对我们的态度相当捉摸不透，所以我们只能猜测[spi_fallen_empire.GetAdj]对这颗星球有何规划。至少没有迹象表明我们对[from.GetName]的兴趣冒犯到了他们……
entries.en: We suspect there is more to [from.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [from.GetClassAdj] world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system lies curiously untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit. Intricate designs have been etched into the hull of this device, and though we cannot say with certainty: we believe the origins of this artistry lie with the nearby [spi_fallen_empire.GetName].\n\nSo inscrutable is their attitude towards us, we can only speculate upon [spi_fallen_empire.GetAdj] designs for this world. There is at least no indication yet that our interest in [from.GetName] has caused them any offense...

entries.zh: $fallen_empires.100.desc.spi_intro$\n\n我们相信[from.GetName]被视为圣体而崇拜，或者说是被视为圣地一般。信标的装饰风格暗示，可能就是[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]在崇拜这个地方。不清楚现在是否还是如此。
entries.en: $fallen_empires.100.desc.spi_intro$\n\nWe believe [from.GetName] was worshipped as a deity, or else has been regarded as a holy place. The decorative styling on the buoy suggests it may even be the [spi_fallen_empire.GetName] who once revered this place. It is unclear whether or not that is still the case.

entries.zh: 我们对[from.GetName]的调查表明，这颗位于[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系中的丰饶行星曾经是一个先进——但多愁善感的——生命形式所热衷的对象。其高轨道上有一个停用已久的导航信标，蚀刻着一些与§H[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]§!文化相似的设计纹路。\n\n似乎[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曾经发誓要保护这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球，但至于现在是否仍是如此我们不得而知。
entries.en: Our survey of [from.GetName] suggests this bountiful world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was once a subject of keen interest to an advanced - though sentimental - life-form. A long-disused navigation buoy in high orbit has been etched with intricate designs similar to those displayed by the §H[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]§!.\n\nIt seems the [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] once sought to preserve this [from.GetClassAdj] world, though they give no indication if that is still the case.

entries.zh: 我们也应该崇敬这个地方。
entries.en: We shall honor this place also.

entries.zh: 现在它是我们的了。
entries.en: It is ours for the taking.

entries.zh: 我们可以在此发展繁荣。
entries.en: We could thrive there.

entries.zh: 颓败的[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]。
entries.en: Decadent [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult].

entries.zh: 傲慢的异教徒。
entries.en: Arrogant heathens.

entries.zh:
从[from.GetName]的船员发回了一封紧急讯息，在[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中找到了§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!。

“[fromfrom.GetName]”……光是这个名字本身就已是传奇，有许多传说都是从摹照[overlord.GetName]流传下来的。[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们都知道这个地方是天堂，是无形的希望的灯塔。尽管我们肉眼可见其神圣性，但我们现在也面临着一个残酷的事实：这个神话般的圣地在现实中确实存在。

[overlord.GetName]还没有对我们的发现发表任何言论，但我们发现了他们非常密切地关注着这颗星球的证据。他们知道我们在这里，我们不知道如何解释他们对此一言不发。
entries.en:
Priority dispatch from the crew of [from.GetName], in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system: we have found §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!.

"[fromfrom.GetName]"... Its very name is the stuff of legends, many of which were handed down in scripture from the [overlord.GetName]. Many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know this place to be paradise - a beacon of intangible hope - and though we can see that it is indeed divine, we are now also faced with a blunt fact: this mythical, holy place actually exists.

The [overlord.GetName] have yet to say anything about our discovery, but we found evidence that they watch this world very closely. They know we are here; we do not know how to interpret their silence.

entries.zh: 真可疑……
entries.en: Suspicious...

entries.zh: 我们的先辈显然信任着我们。
entries.en: Our elders clearly have faith in us.

entries.zh: 圣地宣言
entries.en: Holy World Proclamation

entries.zh: 宗教学者和宗教实践者都在为发现一颗神圣的星球而欢欣鼓舞，曾有人担忧这星球只不过是一则神话传说罢了。
entries.en: Religious scholars and lay practitioners alike are rejoicing in the discovery of a Holy World - once feared by some to be little more than a myth.

entries.zh: 圣地质疑
entries.en: Holy World Suspicion

entries.zh: 这个社会正在接受这样一个事实：守护者向他们隐瞒了某些真相——尤其是一颗已知的圣地星球的存在和下落。
entries.en: This society is coming to terms with the fact its keepers hid certain truths from them - not least the existence and whereabouts of a known Holy World.

entries.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]上可远远不止是有着丰富的资源和原始的生态系统。[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中的这颗[fromfrom.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一个古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。
entries.en: There is more to [fromfrom.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [fromfrom.GetClassAdj] world in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system lies untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit.

entries.zh: $origin.13.desc.intro$\n\n这件装置高度的复杂性甚至可以比肩[overlord.GetAdj]的科技；因此我们相信这座信标属于附近的[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]。至于其作用：我们尚无法完全确定，但似乎[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将这颗星球视作神圣。
entries.en: $origin.13.desc.intro$\n\nThe sheer sophistication of this device parallels that of even [overlord.GetAdj] technology; we therefore believe the marker belongs to the nearby [spi_fallen_empire.GetName]. As to its purpose: we cannot say for sure, but it seems likely the [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] consider this world to be holy.

entries.zh: $origin.13.desc.intro$\n\n这件装置高度的复杂性甚至可以比肩[overlord.GetAdj]的科技，然而其设计却截然外物。因此我们只能假定这座信标属于现存或过去存在过的某个与他们相当的文明。按其外表所刻蚀的许多符号判断，它似乎用于标定一处圣地。
entries.en: $origin.13.desc.intro$\n\nThe sheer sophistication of this device parallels that of even [overlord.GetAdj] technology, however its design is distinctly alien. We must therefore assume the marker belongs to some contemporary of theirs, past or present. Judging by the various symbols etched onto its exterior: it may even be marking out a holy site.

entries.zh: 真是荒谬。
entries.en: Preposterous.

entries.en: §H[From.GetName]§! will be very angry, and are likely to attack us.

entries.en: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 请收下这份礼物，作为[Root.GetName]对[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]服务的奖赏。你们会发现这份奖励绝对算得上丰厚。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have decided to grace your empire with a gift of resources as a token of our esteem. Do not squander our generosity or take our favor for granted.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们的种群真可谓是宇宙中很有价值的存在。为了证明对你们的尊重，我们决定赠与你们一份包含着宝贵矿物与其他资源的大礼。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], your species is a most worthwhile addition to the galactic community. As a token of our esteem, we have decided to bestow on you a generous gift of valuable minerals and resources.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！你们的种族十分杰出，而你们对教义的坚持也令人敬佩。出于我们无尽的仁慈，请收下这份资源作为礼物。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your species is a worthy one, and your adherence to the immutable doctrines of faith are to be commended. Accept this gift of resources as a token of our boundless benevolence.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们的技术效率太低了，让我们都看不下去了。作为我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]的麾下干将，我们决定跟你分享我们对宇宙的一些见解。我们并不是对任何物种都这样做，所以一定要继续对我们保持有用——忘恩负义，对一个小孩来说是不需要的特质。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], the sheer inefficiency of your technology pains us. As you are a valuable client to the [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName], we have decided to share with you some of our understanding of the universe. This is not something we do for just any species, so be sure to continue to be of use to us - ingratitude is not a desirable trait in children.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们对你们停滞不前的科技发展投入了长足的关注。照你们目前的进度，恐怕在有生之年是没有办法展现全部的潜力了。为了对你们进行帮助，我们会将一个[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的科学知识数据库赠与你们。你们绝对会发现，其中的内容对你们非常有用。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your lack of technological progress with concern. At your current pace, we fear that you will never reach your true potential before you wipe yourselves out or are conquered by a more advanced species. In order to help you along, we will transfer a data cache of [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] scientific knowledge. You will no doubt find its contents to be of invaluable worth to your empire.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！你们的种族十分杰出，而你们对教义的坚持也令人敬佩。出于我们无尽的仁慈，请收下这神圣的知识作为礼物。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your species is a worthy one, and your adherence to the immutable doctrines of faith are to be commended. Accept this gift of sacred knowledge as a token of our boundless benevolence.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，作为[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的客户，你们的舰队实力也会反映我们的战斗军力。可是你们的飞船还不够强大。为此我们特决定将我方闲置的一队护卫舰飞船赠送给你，以确保你们的安全。\n\n我们已经用较为简单的部件替换了其中一些较为复杂的部件，以方便你们操作。其余的部件也安装了防拆解设备，所以请勿拆卸。因为这其中的内部构造对你们来说可能太过复杂。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], as a [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] client the state of your fleets also reflects on us, and those crude hulks you call "warships" reflect very poorly indeed. To this end we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships that should look most impressive to the other savages you regularly interact with.\n\nWe have replaced some of their more advanced components with cruder devices so that you are not overly confused by their operation, and the rest have been fitted with anti-tinkering devices, so do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ships. You would be unlikely to understand their inner workings regardless.

entries.zh: 我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]认为，为保护宇宙的平衡与种群的多样性，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的存续是十分重要的。但我们担心的是，你们的舰队实力不足以和其他具有侵略性的种群抗衡。为了帮助你们进行自卫，我们决定将闲置的一队护卫舰飞船赠送给你。\n\n我们已经用[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]较为熟悉的科技部件替换了其中一些较为复杂的部件，以方便你们操作。其余的部件也安装了防拆解设备，所以请勿拆卸。
entries.en: We [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] believe that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an important species for maintaining the balance and biodiversity of the galaxy, but we worry that your fleets are simply too weak for you to be able to stand against other, more aggressive species. To help you defend yourselves, we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships.\n\nWe have replaced some of their more advanced components with technology that should be more familiar to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so you should have no trouble operating them. Also, please do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ships, we would not wish you to hurt yourselves!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！我们的先知说你们的种族将在信仰之路上扮演重要的角色。为了确保你们能够胜任，我们决定将一支闲置的小型护卫舰舰队赠送给你们，应该足以保护你们的安全。\n\n不要胡乱改造舰船上的系统，尽管它们对我们来说是老旧型号，可仍远远超出你们当前的理解能力。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! We have consulted the oracles and determined that your species has an important role to play in the great undertaking of the faith. To ensure that you can carry out this task, we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships that should be more than adequate to destroy any primitive fleets of the other lesser races that might stand in your path.\n\nDo not be tempted to tamper with the ships' systems, they may be older models of ours, but are still far beyond your current level of intellectual development.

To this end we have decided to gift you a surplus battlecruiser that should look most impressive to the other savages you regularly interact with.\n\nWe have replaced some of its more advanced components with cruder devices so that you are not overly confused by their operation, and the rest have been fitted with anti-tinkering devices, so do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ship. You would be unlikely to understand its inner workings regardless.

entries.en: We [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] believe that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an important species for maintaining the balance and biodiversity of the galaxy, but we worry that your fleets are simply too weak for you to be able to stand against other, more aggressive species. To help you defend yourselves, we have decided to gift you one of our surplus battlecruisers.\n\nWe have replaced some of its more advanced components with technology that you should be more familiar to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so you should have no trouble operating them. Also, please do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ship, we would not wish you to hurt yourselves!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！我们的先知说你们的种族将在信仰之路上扮演重要的角色。为了确保你们能够胜任，我们决定将一艘闲置的战列巡洋舰赠送给你们，应该足以保护你们的安全。\n\n不要胡乱改造舰船上的系统，否则可能对你们自己造成伤害。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! We have consulted the oracles and determined that your species has an important role to play in the great undertaking of the faith. To ensure that you can carry out this task, we have decided to gift you a surplus battlecruiser that should be more than adequate to destroy any primitive fleets of the other lesser races that might stand in your path.\n\nDo not be tempted to tamper with the ships' systems, they may be older models of ours, but are still far beyond your current level of intellectual development.

entries.zh: 我们欣然接受。
entries.en: We graciously accept.

entries.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们一定已经知道了，我们§H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]§!致力于研究并保存宇宙中的所有生命形式。我们已经研究了你们的种群，并认为[Root.GetName]最多只能维持几个世纪。为确保极端情况下[Root.GetSpeciesName]的存续，我们希望贵帝国能有一部分人口，加入我们的§H濒危种群保护区§!。我们会专门创建一片保护区，完全复制你们种群的自然生存环境，其所有居民也会获得全面的照顾与保护，你也不用担心他们的安危。\n\n那么，你觉得怎么样？我们会致力保存并保护你们的种群。那你是否愿意为这份事业做出自己的贡献呢？
entries.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As you no doubt know, we §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]§! are dedicated to the study and conservation of all forms of life in the galaxy. We have studied your species and determined that the [Root.GetName] is unlikely to last for more than a few centuries at best. To ensure the continuation of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species should the worst befall your empire, we would like to acquire a part of your population for our §HEndangered Species Preserve§!. We will construct a special reservation that perfectly mirrors the natural habitat of your species, and its population will be well taken care of and protected from all harm, so you need not worry on their behalf.\n\nSo, what do you say? Will you contribute to our preserve and safeguard the future of your species?

entries.zh: 很好，我们愿意尽力。
entries.en: Very well, you will have your contribution.

entries.zh: 我们是绝不会将自己的人民交到外星人手中的！
entries.en: We will never surrender our population to alien hands!

entries.zh: 我们的人民可不是商品，[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Our people are not for sale, [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]本就属于[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] belong in the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 不，我们不会抛弃我们的人们。
entries.en: No, we need our population.

entries.zh: 一组§H[Root.GetSpeciesName]人口§!将从你的帝国移除。
entries.en: A group of §H[Root.GetSpeciesName] Pops§! will be taken from your empire.

entries.en: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的尊贵[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，我们认为你们是一支具有巨大潜力的种群。虽说你们年纪尚轻，却似乎能够理解生物与社会多样性的重要性，在面对不同的生物与社会时不会尽全力压制或进行摧毁，反而会予以理解和接受。不幸的是，并不是所有年轻种群都具有这种智慧。尤其是§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!，他们一直在排除异己。我们不便直接进行干涉，所以希望能够将阻止恶行的任务交给你方。对他们发起攻击，阻止他们进行人口净化。我们将感激不尽。
entries.en: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and accept that which is different, rather than suppress and destroy it. Unfortunately, not all of the younger races are so wise. The §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, in particular, appear to take pride in "cleansing" the galaxy of all forms of life they deem unsuitable. While we cannot intervene ourselves directly, we would like to charge your government with the task of bringing an end to their evil deeds. Attack them and force them to ban the practice of purging, and we will be most grateful indeed.

entries.zh: 我们会制止错误行为的！
entries.en: We will stop any further atrocities!

entries.zh: 我们可不想去找[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的麻烦。
entries.en: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

entries.zh: 来自§H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 干得不错，年轻的[From.GetSpeciesName]。§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!已经精疲力竭，至少现在已经无力继续他们的错误行为了。我们感激不尽，也衷心希望其他的年轻种群都能像你们这样有为。
entries.en: You have done well, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. The §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! have been brought to heel, and at least for the moment, their atrocities have been stopped. We are most grateful, and wish all of the younger races exhibited as much promise as yours.

entries.zh: 确认
entries.en: OK

entries.zh: 来自§H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 我们真是失望透顶啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们许诺要阻止§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!的一切不当行为，现在却看到他们仍然肆意妄为、横行霸道。我们曾以为你们能够阻止他们，但现在看来，是我们搞错了。
entries.en: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.

entries.zh: 确认
entries.en: OK

entries.zh: 来自§H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 你好，年轻的[From.GetSpeciesName]。前一阵我们要求你们阻止§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!的人口净化行为。目前看来，我们的要求已经没有必要了，因为[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经下令禁止了这种活动。不知这是出于他人的胁迫还是自愿为之，反正已经没有必要对他们进行攻击了。
entries.en: Greetings, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. A while ago we tasked you with ending the practice of purging in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. It appears our request is no longer necessary, as the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have already banned the practice. Whether forced to by others or electing to do so themselves, there is no longer a need for aggressive action against them.

entries.zh: 确认
entries.en: OK

entries.zh: 来自§H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 这是怎么回事，[From.GetSpeciesName]？！你是想开玩笑吗？！你们不仅没能制止§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!的错误行为，居然还打算效仿他们！作为正义的一方，我们绝不会姑息。
entries.en: What is this, young [From.GetSpeciesName]?! Do you think to mock us?! Not only do you fail in stopping the atrocities in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, you have now elected to legalize those very same practices in your own empire! Know that we will not be made fools of. There will be repercussions for this, mark my words.

entries.zh: 呃……抱歉？
entries.en: Uh... oops?

entries.zh: 来自§H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!的通讯
entries.en: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们要提醒你§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!正在做着危险的事情。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经开始研究异端科技，不断地制造出更加复杂的人工智能以制造出真正拥有自我意识的机器。我们曾目睹过这种研究的下场，并觉得有义务警告你，这不仅威胁到他们自己，也威胁到其他种族。建议你们主动出击，阻止他们进一步的研究。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artificial intelligences in pursuit of truly self-aware machines. We have seen where this path leads and feel it is our duty to warn you of the danger this poses not only to their own souls, but to those of all the younger races. We advise you to use your military might to attack them and force them to place a ban on any further such research.

entries.zh: 必须阻止它们！
entries.en: They must be stopped!

entries.zh: 我们可不想去找[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的麻烦。
entries.en: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们已经阻止了§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!的不当实验，现在他们的灵魂暂时安全了。感谢你们为我们的伟大事业做出贡献。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! You have done well to end the heretical experimentations of the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! have been stopped, and for the moment, their souls are safe. Know that you have our gratitude for the small part you played in our great endeavour.

entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Despite our warnings, you have elected to do nothing about the heretical research being carried out in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. It appears your species may not be worth saving after all.

entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Your assistance in ending the heretical research carried out by the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! is no longer needed, as a ban has already been placed on all further machine intelligence research in that empire. While you did not play any part in doing so, at least this threat to the spiritual well-being of the galaxy is dealt with.

entries.zh: 你们是瞧不起我们吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？！难道你们以为我们不会注意到，在同意终结§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!进行的不当实验后，你们自己却开始进行了同样的实验！？我们无法容忍你们这样阳奉阴违的做法。准备迎接我们的回应吧。
entries.en: Do you think us fools, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?! Do you think we would not notice that, after agreeing to end the heretical research in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, you yourselves would begin to pursue the very same lines of research?! We will not be mocked by worthless little savages that have barely even mastered the atom. Prepare yourselves for our response.

entries.zh: 呃……抱歉？
entries.en: Um... oops?

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]。我们得知，你们的帝国收留了一位天才。§H[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName]§!的天才在[Root.GetName]有点大材小用了，而我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的各项活动一向需要经验丰富的科学家。因此，我们特为你们提供一个绝佳的机会，只要将[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]借给我们，就能赢得我们的好感。我们已派出了一只飞船接应[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]，你只需要说一声“是”，就算万事俱备了。\n\n你们应该会同意的……对吧？
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We understand that your empire is home to an individual whose brilliant mind transcends the tragic primitiveness of your species. While the talents of §H[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName]§! are sadly wasted in the [Root.GetName], we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] always have a use for skilled scientists to work in our archives. As such, we are offering you a unique chance to earn our favor by allowing us to take charge of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]. We already have a ship en route to pick [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer] up, so you need only say "yes" and everything will be settled.\n\nI'm sure you won't want to disappoint us... do you?

entries.zh: 很好，就把[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]借给你们吧。
entries.en: Very well, you may take [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer].

entries.zh: 没门！

entries.en: It is not up to us to decide!

entries.zh: 将我们最聪慧的人才拱手相送？还是免了。
entries.en: Give up our brightest mind? I think not.

entries.en: No, we need [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer].

entries.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们了解到，你们的帝国在一个濒危种群的星球找到了一份数据存储。该存储包含了这个种群的大脑扫描结果。虽说你们还过于原始，无法将这数据化为实用，但我们还是要赞美你们为保存这曾经辉煌的文明最后的遗物而做出的努力。为了在我们的§H濒危种群保护区§!中留存此种群并加以记录，我们希望你们能将这份数据交给我们，并使用我们的克隆技术复活几个该种群的生物。能不能将这数据与我们分享，方便我们合力完成这种群的遗愿呢？
entries.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive to utilize this data, we laud your efforts in preserving this last remnant of a once vibrant civilization. As part of our efforts to conserve and catalog endangered species in our §HEndangered Species Preserve§!, we wish to take this data and use our cloning technologies to bring a small number of this species back to life. Will you share it with us so we can fulfill their last wish together?

entries.zh: 我们会给你拷贝一份的。
entries.en: We'll make a copy for you.

entries.zh: 我们还是自己留着比较好。
entries.en: I think we'll hold onto it.

检测到主动净化中枢。重激活协议已启动。正在试图联系中央处理器…§R<<错误：亚空间链路离线>>§!

无法连接至中央处理器。正在查询处理单元…§Y4.1853%§!标准容量处理中。中止完全重激活进程。启用备用协议…启用备用协议…启用太空港供电…激活战争设施。

最终防御指令已激活。记录消息如下：
§H智慧生物！我们是[From.GetSpeciesName]。很久以前我们和你们称为肃正协议的腐化体展开了一场大战。我们认为自己是强大的，不可战胜的。我们一次又一次地击退他们，他们一次又一次地卷土重来，烧毁星球，击毁我们强大的舰队。我们同那个时代所有剩下的有机文明团结在一起，发动了一场决战，希望能一劳永逸地彻底消灭它们。

如果你听到这个消息，那证明我们已经失败了。无论我们伟大的文明遗留下来什么，我们将至赠予你，我们的继承人，以面对即将到来的战斗。不要重蹈覆辙！摧毁中枢！彻底消灭这个威胁！全星系的未来取决于这一战。§!
entries.en:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... §R<<ERROR: SUBSPACE LINK OFFLINE>>§!

Central Processing unreachable. Querying processing units... processing at §Y4.1853%§! of standard capacity. Abort full reactivation process. Engaging fallback protocols... powering shipyards... activating war assets...

Final Defense Directive activated. Recorded message follows:
§HSapient! We are the [From.GetSpeciesName]. Long ago we fought the Corruption, that which you call the Contingency. We thought ourselves superior, undefeatable. Time and again we fought them back, time and again they returned, sterilizing worlds and wearing down our mighty fleets. We embarked on a campaign to defeat them once and for all together with what remained of the biological civilizations of our time.

If you are hearing this message, then we have failed. Whatever remains of our great civilization we bequeath to you, our successors, in your own battle to come. Do not make our mistake! Destroy the Nexus! End this menace once and for all! The future of the galaxy depends on it.§!
