entries.zh:
在最后的肃正协议的机器星球自毁的那一刻，我们的仪器检测到一个非常强大的亚空间信号。信号源自§H[From.GetName]§!的空间，似乎是向星系的中心发射。在接下来的几个小时内，零零散散的传来[From.GetAdjective]舰队从传感器消失的报告：它们进入了前往熟悉的星系的跃迁点，但从未出现在另一边。

[From.GetSpeciesName]附近的侦察船调查了周围的空间，并报告了惊人的发现：古老的机械智能已经完全消失了，只留下被遗弃的轨道站和损坏的巨型结构。

我们可能永远不会知道它们去了哪里，但有一件事是肯定的：[From.GetSpeciesName]在过去的岁月中为自己设定的任务现在已经完成；他们古老的守夜使命终于结束了。
entries.en:
At the very moment that the last Contingency Machine World self-destructed, our instruments detected a subspace signal of immense strength. The signal originated from §H[From.GetName]§! space and appears to have been aimed towards the galactic core. Over the next few hours, scattered reports came in of [From.GetAdjective] fleets vanishing from sensors, entering jump points to familiar systems but never emerging on the other side.

A scout vessel near [From.GetSpeciesName] space was sent to investigate, and reported back startling findings: The ancient machine intelligence has disappeared entirely, leaving behind only abandoned orbital stations and decaying megastructures.

Where they have gone to is a mystery we may never solve, but one thing is clear: The task that the [From.GetSpeciesName] set for themselves in ages past is now complete, and their ancient vigil is finally at an end.

entries.zh: 监护者协议625-1已启动。附带信息：有机文明请注意。在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口中普遍检测到生物性弱点。为了确保你们的种族在监护者计划中的可行性，所有主要人口聚集地都需要进行接种。生物注入单位已做好准备，将在正面肯定这条信息后前往你们的空间。等待回应。
entries.en: Custodian protocol 625-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, organic civilization. Widespread biological vulnerabilities have been detected in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. In order to ensure your species' viability for the Custodian Project, all major population centers will require inoculation. Bio-injection units are prepared for dispatch to your space upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.

entries.zh: 这将产生不可预知的影响。在判明这些影响之前，我们人口的幸福度将会降低。
entries.en: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pops' happiness will be reduced.

entries.zh: 好吧，如果是为了我们好的话。
entries.en: Very well, if it's for our own good.

entries.zh: 那些恶心的异形液体你们自己留着吧！
entries.en: Keep your filthy Xeno fluids to yourselves!

entries.zh: 我们不信任这些疫苗。
entries.en: We do not trust these inoculations.

entries.zh: 失控的突变
entries.en: Uncontrolled Mutation

entries.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了数起死亡，而我们的人民也竭力反对被集体强迫进行危险的接种。我们正在努力从人民中消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段较为动荡的时期。
entries.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in a number of deaths, and our population is up in arms about having dangerous inoculations forced on them by the government. We are working to eliminate the mutagens from the population, but until then we should expect a period of increased unrest.

entries.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了子个体的大量死亡。我们正在努力消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段人口增长速度减缓的时期。
entries.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in numerous fatalities in the drone population. We are working to eliminate the mutagens, but until then we can expect to experience a period of slowed population growth.

entries.zh: 真不幸。
entries.en: Unfortunate.

entries.zh: 良性的疫苗
entries.en: Benign Inoculation

entries.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗显现出了巨大的好处，减少了疾病并增加了人口的寿命。当初我们人口之间对这一强制性过程的不信任感已经烟消云散，每个人都在享受着更加健康幸福的生活。
entries.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population. The initial mistrust among our people about the mandatory procedure has receded, and everyone is enjoying a healthier, happier life.

entries.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗显现出了巨大的好处，减少了疾病并增加了我们子个体的寿命。从长远来看这将对我们的人口增长有利。
entries.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our drones. This will benefit our population growth in the long run.

entries.zh: 棒极了。
entries.en: Excellent.

entries.zh: 守护者疫苗
entries.en: Caretaker Inoculations

entries.zh: 我们允许了远古守护者给我们的人口接种以抵御“生物性弱点”。直到正面结果出现以前，我们的人口将因为被迫接种而产生不满。
entries.en: We have allowed the Ancient Caretakers to inoculate our population against 'biological vulnerabilities'. Until we can see positive results, our population will be discontent with being forced to undergo these procedures.

entries.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in numerous unpleasant and lethal mutations among the population.

entries.zh: 监护者协议628-2已启动。附带信息：合成文明请注意。检测到你们的基础代码效率非常低下。为了确保你们的种族可以为监护者计划作贡献，需要进行大量的代码重写。我们已准备好进行子空间传输，将在正面肯定这条信息后开始。等待回应。
entries.en: Custodian protocol 628-2 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Significant inefficiencies have been detected in your base code. In order to ensure your species' ability to contribute to the Custodian Project, extensive rewrites will be required. We are prepared to initiate subspace code transmission upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.

entries.zh: 这将产生不可预知的影响。在判明这些影响之前，我们人口的维护花费将会增加。
entries.en: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pop upkeep will be increased.

entries.zh: 我们欢迎改善自身程序的机会。
entries.en: We welcome the chance to improve our programming.

entries.zh: 我们不信任这些代码的改变。
entries.en: We do not trust these code changes.

entries.zh: 不兼容的代码
entries.en: Incompatible Code

entries.zh: 远古守护者在我们的基础代码中进行的改变与我们其他核心组件中的程序不兼容。这不仅未能实现当初期许的效率增长，反而导致了数个严重程序错误，大大地影响了我们的资源采集行动。直到这些代码改变被还原之前，我们将经历一段生产力低下的时期。
entries.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Not only have the promised efficiency increases failed to manifest, but instead they have caused a number of severe bugs that have severely impacted our resource gathering operations. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.

entries.zh: 真不幸。
entries.en: Unfortunate.

entries.zh: 改善的代码标准
entries.en: Improved Code Standards

entries.zh: 远古守护者在我们的基础代码中进行的改变产生了良好的结果。重写导致的效率低下只是暂时的，而改变给我们全体人民带来了永久性的资源生产力升级。
entries.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well. The inefficiencies caused by the rewrite turned out to be only temporary, and the changes have resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.

entries.zh: 棒极了。
entries.en: Excellent.

entries.zh: 代码改变
entries.en: Code Changes

entries.zh: 我们允许了远古守护者重写我们基础代码中的一些部分。在对人民进行这些改变的这段时期，我们的能源需求将暂时增加。
entries.en: We have allowed the Ancient Caretakers to rewrite certain parts of our base code. This will temporarily increase our energy requirements while the changes are being rolled out across the population.

entries.zh: 不兼容的代码
entries.en: Incompatible Code

entries.zh: 远古守护者在我们的基础代码中进行的改变与我们其他核心组件中的程序不兼容。直到这些代码改变被还原之前，我们将经历一段生产力低下的时期。
entries.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.

entries.zh: 改善的代码标准
entries.en: Improved Code Standards

entries.zh: 远古守护者在我们的基础代码中进行的改变产生了良好的结果，给我们全体人民带来了永久性的资源生产力升级。
entries.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well, and has resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.

entries.zh: 监护者协议115-3已启动。附带信息：合成文明请注意。因暂时的通讯瘫痪，监护者计划目前无法替换故障与受损的劳工无人机。对你们的文明的分析显示[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]单位性能适合执行低级的维护任务。我们请求你们将劳工单位转让到[FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName]以便整合至监护矩阵，帮助确保一级避难设施中的所有有机生物可以继续生存。
entries.en: Custodian protocol 115-3 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Due to temporary communication outages, the Custodian Project is experiencing difficulties in replacing malfunctioning and damaged worker drones. Analysis of your civilization has found the performance of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] units to be adequate for carrying out low-level maintenance tasks. We request the transfer of worker population units to [FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName] for integration into the Custodian Matrix, to help ensure the continued survival of all organic species in Alpha Refuge.

entries.zh: 收到。接受请求。
entries.en: Acknowledged. Request accepted.

entries.zh: 我们不会分享工人单位。
entries.en: We will not share our worker units.

entries.zh: 监护者协议62-1已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!已被§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!入侵。因为我们程序上的思潮限制，目前无法使用监护者战争资产。次级控制协议政策利用未被危害的文明在其可以散布之前摧毁§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!的威胁。我们请求为此任务部署[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产。你是否愿意合作？
entries.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! has been compromised by the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!. Due to ethics restrictions in our programming, the use of Custodian war assets are presently restricted. Secondary containment protocol dictates the use of non-compromised civilizations to destroy the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! threat before it can spread. We request the deployment of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets for this task. Will you comply?

entries.zh: 如果他们是个威胁，那就必须被阻止。
entries.en: If they're a threat, they must be stopped.

entries.zh: 我们没有理由进攻[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]。
entries.en: We have no reason to attack the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

entries.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! will likely react very negatively to our failure.

entries.zh: 愤怒的机械失落帝国
entries.en: Angered Fallen Machine Empire

entries.zh: 睡狮的苏醒
entries.en: Sleepers Awake

entries.zh:
§H[From.GetAdjective]§!的轻微异动是一切的开端。我们收到了零星的情报，尽管之前仅在自己的空间内活动，他们的舰队现在已经开始向星系内遥远的众恒星系开动。异常先进的侦察舰开始探访那些古老的、被毁掉的星球，并对任何向他们打招呼或者回避的舰船发动攻击。现在，他们的目的和使命已经昭然若揭了。

我们现在知道[From.GetSpeciesName]已经整装待发，他们恢复了调查信标的数据链，并重新启用了那些在他们退缩到目前边境之时废弃的侦察哨站。情报显示，他们的意图是重新回到星系这张大棋盘上。

在[From.GetSpeciesName]空间，舰队正在集结，军队已经下达了征召令，那些古老的工厂再一次发出轰鸣声。几百年来第一次，§H[From.GetName]§!开始将他们的目光投注到边境线外广大的星系。

破败的船坞再一次得到修复与调整，一度沉寂的泰坦巨舰铸造厂重新上线。整个星系都在关注同一个问题：当这位一度沉睡的巨人决定恢复旧日荣光时，谁会成为第一个螳臂当车的宵小呢？
entries.en:
It began as a subtle shift in §H[From.GetAdjective]§! behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds, refusing all hails and fleeing when attacked. Their purpose and mission unknown... until now.

We now know that the [From.GetSpeciesName] were preparing, recovering the databanks of survey beacons and automated scouting posts left behind when they retreated to their present borders. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and ancient factories roar to life. For the first time in an age, the §H[From.GetName]§! are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

As their decaying shipyards are repaired and refitted and the dormant systems of Titan foundries come online, the rest of the galaxy is left with only one question - who will this once-sleeping giant target first in their quest to reclaim age-old glory lost?

entries.zh: 巨人踏入了孩子们的游乐园……
entries.en: Giants in the playground...

entries.zh: 一帮愚蠢的老古董们。
entries.en: Decrepit fools.

entries.zh: 星河守护者
entries.en: Guardians of the Galaxy

entries.zh: 即使是偏安一隅的先祖帝国也没有忽视这样一个威胁到整个星系的危机。尽管他们之前对星系事务毫无兴趣，这一坏消息还是引起了§H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!的一阵忙乱。起初，他们只是派出了一些侦查船，也许是为了核实情况的严重性。但接下来传来了[From.GetSpeciesName]舰队聚集在边境，以准备抵抗即将到来的风暴的报告。\n\n现在，§H[From.GetName]§!已经从自我孤立的状态完全转变成为了领导全星系防御的角色。他们正式宣布自己为一个§H泛星系防卫联盟§!的领袖并向所有“下等”种族发出了邀请，希望他们放下仇恨并加入联盟来击退这一对星系中所有智慧生命造成威胁的敌人。
entries.en: The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!. At first, it was just a few scouting vessels, perhaps sent to verify the graveness of the situation, but then reports began to came in of [From.GetSpeciesName] war fleets mustering on their borders, readying their defenses for the oncoming storm.\n\nNow, the §H[From.GetName]§! have fully emerged from their self-imposed isolation to take a leading role in the defense of the whole galaxy. They have proclaimed themselves the leaders of a §HGalactic Defense League§! and extended an invite to all "lesser" species to put aside their feuds and join them in repelling this menace for the sake of all sapient life in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 他们能拯救我们吗？
entries.en: Will they be able to save us?

entries.zh: 我们不需要他们！
entries.en: We do not need them!

entries.zh: [assimilated_fe.GetName]的终结
entries.en: End of the [assimilated_fe.GetName]

entries.zh: 远古失落帝国的碎片§H[assimilated_fe.GetName]§!被原主脑的一个更加强势的分支吸收。也许这对它是最好的结局。
entries.en: The ancient Fallen Empire Fragment, §H[assimilated_fe.GetName]§! has been assimilated by a more dominant aspect of the former overmind. Perhaps it was for the best.

entries.zh: 上古宿敌
entries.en: Ancient Rivals

entries.zh: §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§!再次君临整片星系的消息似乎没有被别的失落帝国无视。§H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!对这一消息的不安尤为强烈。这两位先祖文明是亘古的宿敌，尽管由于某些原因他们的仇恨在漫长的历史中稍有褪色，然而§H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!的突然觉醒点燃了古老的仇恨并激起了对抗行动。§H[From.GetName]§!已从沉睡中醒来，他们将以整个星系为战场延续远古的对决。
entries.en: The return of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! to the galactic scene has not gone unnoticed by the other Fallen Empires present in our galaxy. The §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! in particular appeared most agitated at the news. It seems that these two proud nations are ancient rivals, and though the reasons for their rivalry has long since faded into history, the sudden reawakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! has enflamed old animosities and triggered a counter-reaction. The §H[From.GetName]§! have roused themselves from their slumber to face their old rivals, with the whole galaxy as their battleground.

entries.zh: 这对我们来说意味着什么呢？
entries.en: What will this mean for us all?

entries.zh: 天堂之战
entries.en: The War in Heaven

entries.zh: 自从§H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§!和他们的对手§H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!觉醒后，这两个巨人一直在为争夺影响力展开零星的冲突，以试探彼此的实力。这最终导致了冲突的一连串升级，终于，在某个遥远的恒星系中[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了一场公开的舰队战。这次冲突现在演变为§H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!与§H[From.GetName]§!之间的全面战争。\n\n每一方都派遣了一名代表去往年轻的种族，承诺厚赏加入他们的人并严惩反对他们的人。选择支持任意一方都意味着放弃我们的主权，但维持中立可能更加危险，除非我们可以找到其他中立国家来与我们合作。
entries.en: Ever since the awakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! and their ancient §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! and the §H[From.GetName]§!.\n\nEach side has sent a representative to the younger races, promising great rewards for those who join them in their war and terrible punishments for those who choose to stand against them. Choosing either side in this conflict will mean giving up our independence, but remaining neutral may be even more dangerous unless we can find other neutral empires to stand by our side.

entries.zh: 我们决定支持[FirstSleeper.GetName]。
entries.en: We will stand with [FirstSleeper.GetName].

entries.en: A $preset_dominion$ subject pays 30% Basic Resource Tithe, and are shifted towards §YFanatic Spiritualism§!.

entries.en: A $preset_signatory$ subject is prohibited from having Pops as slaves or purging them.

entries.en: A $preset_thrall$ subject pays a 30% Basic Resource Tithe.

entries.en: A $preset_political_client$ is not allowed any freedom when it comes to their diplomacy or voting.

entries.zh: $preset_herald$附属国必须加入宗主的全部战争。
entries.en: A $preset_herald$ subject must join in ALL wars of their overlord.

entries.zh: 我们会向[From.GetName]效忠。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] have our allegiance.

entries.zh: 在这场斗争中我们不会站在任意一边。
entries.en: We will not take sides in this conflict.

entries.zh: 他们都将败在我们手下！
entries.en: They will both fall to our might!

entries.zh: 作为附属国，这不是由我们来决定的。
entries.en: As a subject nation, it is not up to us to decide.

entries.zh: 天堂之战的终章
entries.en: The End of the War in Heaven

entries.zh: 在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§!帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]§!睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。\n\n目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
entries.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§! have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]§! now stand triumphant as the undisputed dominant power in the galaxy.\n\nFor now, an uneasy peace reigns, but how long can this new order last?

entries.zh: [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]治下的和平。
entries.en: Pax [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName] reigns.

entries.zh: $war_in_heaven.5.name$
entries.en: $war_in_heaven.5.name$

entries.zh: 在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，天堂之战以双方僵持不下的局面而告终。§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§!与§H[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]§!已经签署了停火协议，将舰队撤回了各自边境。\n\n目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这次休战能持续多久呢？
entries.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§! and §H[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]§! have signed a ceasefire and withdrawn their fleets back to their own borders. \n\nFor now, an uneasy peace reigns over the galaxy, but how long can this truce last?

entries.zh: 战争并未结束……
entries.en: This isn't over...

entries.zh: 觉醒帝国被击败
entries.en: Awakened Empire Defeated

entries.zh: 先祖帝国间的战争以一方被击败而结束，但这并不是他们的宿敌所为。也许是大战消耗了他们的实力，亦或是单纯因为年轻种族们的实力，古老的帝国最终毁灭于他们眼中的弱小种族，这完全改变了局势。现在的问题是，§H[RemainingAwakened.GetName]§!能否避免踏上他们宿敌的后尘？还是说这标志着星系迎来了新的纪元？
entries.en: The war between the ancients has ended with the destruction of one of the combatants - but not at the hands of their old rival. Whether it was due to the war weakening them or simply due to the strength of the younger races, the destruction of an elder empire at the hands of their supposed lessers has changed the situation considerably. Now the question remains - will the §H[RemainingAwakened.GetName]§! be able to avoid the fate of their ancient foe, or does this defeat signal the dawn of a new age in the galaxy?

entries.zh: 这还要走着瞧……
entries.en: It remains to be seen...

entries.zh: 不结盟组织
entries.en: The League of Non-Aligned Powers

entries.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的兵燹之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。我们已经收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个§H不结盟组织§!，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。由于我们的军事实力与影响力，他们决定邀请我们成为这支联盟势力的盟主。我们一旦接受，就几乎确定会同时跟两大觉醒的帝国开战，但至少我们还有盟友支援，不用独自面对两大先祖帝国的威胁。
entries.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Due to our military might and influence, we have been asked to lead this league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

entries.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁了。我们收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个§H不结盟组织§!，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。鉴于我们已是一个强大联邦，[Root.GetAllianceName]的领袖中的一员，他们决定请我们扩充自己现有的联盟以组建预想中的组织。接受请求基本意味着同觉醒的帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
entries.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. As we are already the leaders of a powerful federation, the [Root.GetAllianceName], we have been asked to expand our alliance to form the proposed league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

entries.zh: 我们会领导这个组织！
entries.en: We will lead this league!

entries.zh: 不，这太危险了！
entries.en: No, it is simply too dangerous.

entries.zh: 我们可以自保。
entries.en: We are fine on our own.

entries.zh: 请求加入组织
entries.en: League Membership Request

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!正式申请加入§H不结盟组织§!。
entries.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! have formally requested to join the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§!.

entries.zh: 很高兴有他们加入！
entries.en: We will be glad to have them!

entries.zh: 不，我们不需要他们。
entries.en: No, we do not need them.

entries.zh: 与复兴者的战争
entries.en: War with the Awakened

entries.zh: 很快，先祖帝国就意识到了§H不结盟组织§!的存在。双方都派出了代表前往[Root.Capital.GetName]，要求解散联盟，并要求所有成员在这场战争中选边站队。我们自然是拒绝了，而今早，§H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!与§H[SecondSleeper.GetName]§!都发布了与我们开战的公告。
entries.en: It did not take long for the ancients to take notice of the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§!. Representatives from both warring powers have come to [Root.Capital.GetName] demanding the dissolution of the league, and for its members to choose sides in the war. Naturally, we refused, and as of this morning we are now in a state of war with both the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! and the §H[SecondSleeper.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 你们两个给老子滚出这个星系！
entries.en: Get the hell out of our galaxy, both of you!

entries.zh: 复兴者的陨落
entries.en: The Fall of the Awakened

entries.zh: 在经历漫长而残酷的冲突后，这场因两个先祖帝国间的摩擦而起的战争以它们的双双覆灭告终。曾经拥有强大古代科技且自负高傲的巨人们沦为了历史尘埃，星系迎来了崭新的黎明，新兴物种将书写他们自己的命运。
entries.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the war that begun as a battle between two ancient empires has ended in the destruction of both. For all their ancient technological might, the arrogance and inflexibility of these ancient giants proved their undoing, and now they are gone, reduced to no more than another set of broken ruins of the past. A new age dawns on the galaxy, and from now on the fate of the younger races will be entirely their own to decide.

entries.zh: 这是属于[Root.GetName]的时代！
entries.en: This will be the age of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 不结盟组织
entries.en: The League of Non-Aligned Powers

entries.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的大战之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。在§H[From.GetName]§!的领导下，§H不结盟组织§!成立了，其目标是对抗挑起战火的先驱者帝国，加入这个联盟就意味着要和战争双方觉醒的失落帝国同时开战，但至少加入这个联盟的中立者们不用再孤军奋战了。
entries.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. A §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! has formed under the leadership of the §H[From.GetName]§! with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

entries.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先驱帝国的威胁了。§H[From.GetName]§!，我们联邦的主席，已将我们的共同体重新命名为§H不结盟组织§!，挑起了反抗战争双方的大旗。建立这一组织基本意味着同觉醒的帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
entries.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. The §H[From.GetName]§!, our federation's President, has renamed our union as the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! and declared our goal to be opposing both sides in the war. Forming this league will almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

entries.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先驱帝国的威胁了。§H[From.GetName]§!奋勇当先，宣布其联盟将作为§H不结盟组织§!挑起反抗战争双方的大旗，并邀请其他中立国团结在他们的旗帜下。加入这一组织基本意味着同觉醒的失落帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
entries.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. The §H[From.GetName]§! has boldly taken the initiative, declaring their alliance a §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! seeking to oppose both sides in the war, and inviting other neutral nations to rally behind their banner. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

entries.zh: 我们会加入这个组织！
entries.en: We will join this league!

entries.zh: 我们会对那些老骨头的暴政说不！
entries.en: We shall oppose the tyranny of the elders!

entries.zh: 不，这太危险了！
entries.en: No, it is simply too dangerous.

entries.zh: 我们不能支持这样的行动方针。
entries.en: We cannot support this course of action.

entries.zh: 同意加入组织
entries.en: League Membership Accepted

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!已经批准我们加入§H不结盟组织§!，现在我们将和其他中立者一起抵抗这些先祖帝国的威胁。
entries.en: We have been accepted into the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! by the §H[From.GetName]§!, and now we will stand together against the menace of the elder empires.

entries.zh: 为了胜利与自由！
entries.en: To victory and freedom!

entries.zh: 拒绝加入组织
entries.en: League Membership Refused

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!拒绝了我们加入§H不结盟组织§!的请求，现在我们只能独自抵抗先祖帝国的威胁了。
entries.en: Our request to join the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! was refused by the §H[From.GetName]§!, and now we will have to stand alone against the menace of the elder empires.

entries.zh: 这就尴尬了……
entries.en: This is not good...

entries.zh: 不结盟组织
entries.en: The League of Non-Aligned Powers

entries.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的战争中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了其中一方。比如我们就保持了中立，但这意味着我们要独自面对觉醒帝国的威胁。以在战争中抵抗各边势力为目标，§H不结盟组织§!在§H[From.GetName]§!的领导下成立了。
entries.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the war should come their way. A §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! has formed under the leadership of the §H[From.GetName]§! with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war.

entries.zh: 并非所有的年轻物种都选择了先祖帝国的中途中站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自觉醒帝国的威胁了。§H[From.GetName]§!奋勇当先，宣布其联盟将作为§H不结盟组织§!挑起了反抗战争双方的大旗，并邀请其他中立国团结在他们的旗帜下。
entries.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the war should come their way. The §H[From.GetName]§! has boldly taken the initiative, declaring their alliance a §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! seeking to oppose both sides in the war, and inviting other neutral nations to rally behind their banner.

entries.zh: 一次豪赌。
entries.en: A bold move.

entries.zh: 天堂之战终结
entries.en: War in Heaven is Over

entries.zh: 逐浪者舰队上的游牧船员们给我们发来了信息。他们说他们正在从星系边缘离开并向下一个目的地进发。他们将会去哪？他们会找到他们正寻觅的东西吗？
entries.en: The galactic nomads aboard the Pursuing Waters fleet have sent us a parting message. They are leaving our galaxy from the outer rim and setting sail towards their next destination. Where will they end up next? Will they ever find what they are searching for?

entries.zh: 有人持怀疑态度……
entries.en: One wonders...

entries.zh: 谢天谢地。
entries.en: Good riddance.

entries.zh: 祝旅程平安。
entries.en: Fly safe.

entries.zh: 星海游牧民
entries.en: Galactic Nomads

entries.zh: 愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚一直伴你左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们是[contact_speaker_leader.GetName]。我们代表游牧舰队，逐浪者舰队上所有的纳马里安之魂发声。\n\n你不必对我们心存恐惧，我们的舰队无意对天体进行争夺。我们只要求受到尊重，旅程不受到妨碍。
entries.en: Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We are [contact_speaker_leader.GetName]. We speak on behalf of all the Namarian souls aboard the collected ships of the Pursuing Waters, our nomadic fleet.\n\nYou have nothing to fear from us, as the fleet has no interest in orb-bound affairs. We ask only that you respect our autonomy and do not hinder us on our journey.

entries.zh: 你们好，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们有个请求。在我们穿过漫漫虚空的旅途中，我们中的一些人民心生倦怠，眼中失去了目标。我们不是暴君，因此不会强迫任何人跟随我们完成旅途。所以我们在此请求：你们可以接收上述船员吗？让他们栖息在你们的[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]上，可以吗？
entries.en: Greetings again, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have a request for you. As we travel the void some of our people grow weary and lose sight of our goal. We are no tyrants, we force no one to see our quest to the end. So we ask of you: will you take some of our people in? To dwell on your orb, the one named [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]?

entries.zh: 我们会接收他们的。
entries.en: We will take them in.

entries.zh: §H[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§!：\n§G+300§!£pop£§H游牧人口§!
entries.en: §H[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§!:\n§G+300§! £pop£ §HNomad Pops§!

entries.zh: 太感谢你们了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。愿我们同你们一道得偿所愿。
entries.en: We thank you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. May our people find what they are looking for, in communion with your people.

entries.zh: 我们不能收留他们。
entries.en: We cannot host them.

entries.zh: 那真是太不幸了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。希望那些掉队者能再坚持一下。我们马上就启程。
entries.en: That is unfortunate, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Hopefully the stragglers will endure for a while longer. We will be on our way.

entries.zh: 他们因何不满？
entries.en: Why are they discontent?

entries.zh: 旅途漫漫，很可能我们一生都无法到达终点。有人想要寻找在有生之年能够到达的目标，而不是在无尽的旅途中耗尽此生。
entries.en: The fleet's journey has been a long one. And it will not likely end within our lifetime. The discontent among us want another purpose in their lives other than searching the stars for our goal.

entries.zh: 他们要怎么适应我们的社会？
entries.en: How will they adapt to our society?

entries.zh: 他们是一群不仅唯心还追求所谓平等的懦夫，至于他们能否和你们友好相处那就是你们自己的决断了。
entries.en: They are a spiritual and egalitarian crowd, how well that meshes with your tribe is for you to discern.

entries.zh: 星海游牧舰队
entries.en: Galactic Nomad Fleet

entries.zh: 愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。
entries.en: Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 祝福你们，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。希望你们相处愉快。
entries.en: Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We hope you are doing well.

entries.zh: 你们有什么要求，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]？
entries.en: What do you want, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]?

entries.zh: 再多给我们讲讲你们的帝国。
entries.en: Tell us more about your people.

entries.zh: 正如我们初步和谈时说过的，我们来自逐浪者舰队。我们世世代代穿梭于恒星间的虚无太空，且将世代延续下去。\n\n舰队由许多个体组成，所有人都必须为了我们的目标倾尽全力。有些人希望脱离出去，在天体上殖民，但大多数人都想穿越下一片虚空，看看之后的景象。
entries.en: As we mentioned at our introductory parley, we are the people of the Pursuing Waters fleet. We have traveled the stars and the voids-between for many generations, and will continue to do so for many more.\n\nThe fleet hosts a collection of individuals who all are required to do their best to enable our progress. Some wish to leave and establish a new orb-bound life for themselves, but most wish to see what lies beyond the next void.

entries.zh: 你们要去哪？
entries.en: Where are you headed?

entries.zh:
鉴于你是逐浪者信任的盟友，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，我将会告诉你一些事：

舰队目前正处于探索之中。我们的先祖曾经不得不离开母星驶向无垠的深空之中。他们希望我们能够找到我们存在的意义，在他们离开满是沙丘的母星千年之后，我们依旧依照着他们的当初的愿景来制定我们的生存之道。

这就是我们想说的。望你安康。
entries.en:
Being the trusted ally of the Pursuing Waters that you are, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj], we will tell you this:

The fleet is on a quest. Our ancestors had to leave our birthing orb behind and set sail down the back of night. They wished for us to find the purpose of our people, and we live today by that wish, millennia after they first left the sandy dunes of Home.

That is all we dare share. May it bring you shade.

entries.zh: 我们正沿着多条虚空之河进行探索。这场旅程已经持续千年，但我们仍将继续航行。我们的目标是宇宙的星辰大海。虽然听起来可能有些晦涩难懂，但这充分总结了我们的理想。愿它能为你们遮蔽烈日。
entries.en: We are on a journey down the river of the many voids-between. It has been millennia, but we sail on. The destination we seek being the ocean of the universe. It might sound cryptic, but this adequately summarizes what we dare share. May it bring you shade.

entries.zh: 请恕我们不愿透露，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。还有别的事吗？
entries.en: We would rather not say, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Was there anything else?

entries.zh: 再见。
entries.en: Goodbye.

entries.zh: 祝顺利，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。
entries.en: Favorable winds, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj].

entries.zh: 愿你沐浴和风，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们发现你们称之为§Y[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§!的球体目前并未被你们占据。我们请求：能否让我们的一支帝国在此安家？\n\n我们知道这是个不小的要求——失去整座星系来给我们一个家。我们等待你的答复，无论你如何决定。
entries.en: Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have found that the orb you call §Y[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§! is not currently being held by your people. We ask of you: could you let one of our tribes land upon it and make it a new home?\n\nWe realize we ask much of you - to lose an entire system to give our people a home. We await your decision, whatever it may be.

entries.zh: 这座星系，以及那个“球体”归你们了。
entries.en: The system, and the "orb" is yours.

entries.zh:
你将§R割让§!§H[NomadMissionPlanet.GetStarName]§!星系的控制权

在§H[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§!§!上创建一个拥有§B1.5K£pop£§!的§Y纳马里安族帝国

你与§Y[nomad_fleet_country.GetName]§!以及§Y纳马里安§!帝国的关系得到了§G改善§!
entries.en:
You will §Rcede control§! of the §H[NomadMissionPlanet.GetStarName]§! System

Creates a §YNamarian§! empire with §B1.5K £pop£ Pops§! on §H[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§!

Your relation with the §Y[nomad_fleet_country.GetName]§! and the §YNamarian§! empire is §Gimproved§!

entries.zh: 与§Y[nomad_fleet_country.GetName]§!的关系§R恶化§!\n\n
entries.en: Your relation with the §Y[nomad_fleet_country.GetName]§! is §Rworsened§!\n\n

entries.zh: 我们衷心感谢你们。在冰冻刺骨的星系中，这样的热情能够驱散一丝寒意。我们游牧舰队衷心祝愿你们以及新生的帝国前途光明。
entries.en: We thank your people for their grace. The galaxy is a cold place but today an act of kindness will ripple through its waters. We of the nomadic fleet wish both you and this new empire the best of luck in your affairs.

entries.zh: 我们不能祝福你们。
entries.en: We cannot grant you this wish.

entries.zh: 这颗“星球”是我们的。
entries.en: The "planet" is ours.

entries.zh: 不，这是我们不可冒犯的领地。
entries.en: No, it is ours by divine right.

entries.zh: 这对我们而言是个噩耗，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。希望他们能在下一个水坑中找到苦苦搜寻的目标，而不是灼热的风暴。通讯终止。
entries.en: That is unfortunate for our people, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. We can only hope that they will find what they are looking for at the next watering hole, instead of searing winds. End transmission.

entries.zh: 为什么对这颗行星感兴趣？
entries.en: Why is the planet of interest?

entries.zh: 在虚空之河航行对十分艰难，却只是漫长旅程的一小步。我们的帝国只想寻求栖息之地，而§Y[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§!能够满足他们的需求。\n\n[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]，你们愿意为他们提供栖息之地吗？
entries.en: Sailing the voids-between is an arduous journey, and yet only a step on an already strenuous path. Our people simply seek rest, and thought that §Y[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§! fulfilled their needs.\n\nWill you grant them this rest, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]?

entries.zh: 紧急通讯
entries.en: Urgent Transmission

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，愿灼热的太阳与残酷的干旱常伴你们左右。逐浪者永远不再与你们往来。
entries.en: Scorching suns and drought upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. The Pursuing Waters shall not deal with your sort ever again.

entries.zh: 敌意声明
entries.en: Declaration of Hostility

entries.zh: 你当见识怒涛的咆哮，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]!
entries.en: You shall know the fury of the Raging Waters, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]!

entries.zh: 遇险通讯
entries.en: Distress Transmission

entries.zh: 情况十万火急，我们希望寻求帮助，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。舰队遭到了[attacker_country.GetName]的攻击，请求你们支援！
entries.en: We come to you with a most urgent request, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. The fleet is being attacked by [attacker_country.GetName] and it needs your help!

entries.zh: 我们会支援你们的。
entries.en: We will aid you.

entries.zh: 舰队铭记你们的恩德，请赶快！
entries.en: The fleet is grateful, please hurry!

entries.zh: 我们不能插手，很遗憾。
entries.en: We sadly cannot intervene.

entries.zh: ……诅咒你的子民与星球永受干旱，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。通讯结束。
entries.en: ... Drought to your orbs and your offspring, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. End transmission.

entries.zh: 我们不会帮忙的。
entries.en: We won't help you.

entries.zh: 游牧民族贸易提案
entries.en: Nomad Trade Proposal

entries.zh: 很高兴再会，绿洲的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。在周围的行星之间穿行使得我们可以在废弃种群找寻有用的东西。也正因如此我们刚刚建好了我们的新飞船。\n\n事实上我们建造出过量的飞船是为了解决的资源过剩这个问题。我们更希望商队能够保持灵活，不受束缚，所以我们带着希望达成交易的愿景来找到你们。
entries.en: Greetings again, [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the oasis. Sailing through the nearby stars have made for some particularly fruitful scavenging. And so we have just finished the construction of new vessels.\n\nIn actuality we build more than we need in order to get rid of the excess resources. We prefer the caravan to stay nimble, unburdened, so we come to you with a transaction in mind.

entries.zh: 商队？
entries.en: The caravan?

entries.zh: 舰队中的方舟。是我们的建设者工作休息的地方。商队穿梭于宇宙之中需要它来提供维持生存的空间，因此我们需要降低它的负载。\n\n如果飞船组成了舰队的手臂的话，那么商队就是舰队的心脏。
entries.en: The arkships of our fleet. Where we construct our contraptions, where our builders sleep. Steering the caravan across the great voids-between requires it to offer living space, hence the need to reduce its load.\n\nIf our military make up the fleet's hands, the caravan is its heart.

entries.zh: 交易？
entries.en: A transaction?

entries.zh: 说说吧。
entries.en: Out with it.

entries.zh: 我们有一个提案。我们需要能量币和矿物来维持我们的航行。作为交换，我们会交给你们§Y五艘§!我们的新型舰船
entries.en: A proposal, then. We require energy credits and minerals for the next crossing. In exchange, you may have §Yfive§! of our newly-built vessels.

entries.zh: 只有五艘？
entries.en: Only five?

entries.zh: 我们想卖的就是这么多。毕竟商队需要攻防兼备。
entries.en: That is as many as we are willing to part with. The caravan needs its hands to hold both shield and spear after all.

entries.zh: 请继续。
entries.en: Go on.

entries.zh: 我们不相信纳马里安的工程技术。
entries.en: We do not trust Namarian engineering.

entries.zh: 这就是我们的行事方式，不断的收集资源，随时保持我们的船坞处于运作状态，这不仅仅是我们的传统也是我们必须要做的事。比起拖累我们的舰队我们更希望看到的是我们的造物被其他天体居民买去使用。\n\n我们能够确信我们的设计不会让你失望。
entries.en: It is our way, by tradition and necessity, to scavenge resources and activate our internal shipyards when and where we can. We would prefer to see whatever excess we generate is put to use among the orb-dwellers, than have it hamper our journey.\n\nWe believe our designs would not disappoint you.

entries.zh: 给我介绍介绍这些舰队。
entries.en: Tell us about these vessels.

entries.zh: 巡洋舰，你们应该是这么叫的吧。装备有护盾，以及电弧发射器和等离子发射器。
entries.en: Cruisers, we suppose you would call them. Shielded and armed with plasma throwers and arc emitters.

entries.zh: 我们很感兴趣。
entries.en: We are interested.

entries.zh: 我们没兴趣。
entries.en: We are not interested.

entries.zh: 一个令人心旷神怡的回答，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]，我们只需§Y2000§!£minerals£或者§Y2000§!£energy£作为回报。
entries.en: A refreshing answer, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. All we ask in return is £minerals£ §Y2000§! or £energy£ §Y2000§!.

entries.zh: 我们非常乐意支付§Y2000§!£energy£。
entries.en: We will happily ease your burden for £energy£ §Y2000§!.

entries.zh: 我们愿意支付§Y2000§!£minerals£。
entries.en: We will take them for £minerals£ §Y2000§!.

entries.zh: 你再卖便宜一点。
entries.en: Lower your price.

entries.zh: 我们付不起。
entries.en: We cannot afford that.

entries.zh: 没门。
entries.en: No deal.

entries.zh: 我们清楚自己产品的价值，天体居民。我们要的不多。
entries.en: We know what our creations are worth, orb-dweller. We do not ask for much.

entries.zh: 我们非常乐意为你们分担§Y1500§!£energy£。
entries.en: We will happily ease your burden for £energy£ §Y1500§!.

entries.zh: 我们还是付不起。
entries.en: We still cannot afford it.

entries.zh: 我们愿意为之支付§Y1500§!£minerals£矿物。
entries.en: We'll take them for £minerals£ §Y1500§! minerals

entries.zh: 我们本希望至少能赚回制造成本，但现在只需要§Y1500§!£minerals£或者§Y1500§!£energy£就可以把飞船卖给你们。
entries.en: We had hoped to at least make back the manufacturing costs, but we can give you the ships for £minerals£ §Y1500§! or £energy£ §Y1500§!.

entries.zh: 舰船将开往你们的中央绿洲——[Root.Capital.GetName]？是的。§Y30§!天内完成交付。\n\n愿你们一路顺风，永远能够得到荫凉的庇佑，[Root.GetRulerName]。
entries.en: The ships will be driven to your central oasis - [Root.Capital.GetName]? Yes. To be delivered within §Y30§! days.\n\nMay you always follow the trail and find shade, [Root.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 再见了，[contact_speaker_leader.GetName]。
entries.en: Farewell, [contact_speaker_leader.GetName].

entries.zh: 很高兴能做成生意。
entries.en: A pleasure doing business.

entries.zh: 加密通讯
entries.en: Encrypted Transmission

entries.zh: 嗨，天体居民。\n\n我们有消息要告诉你们。
entries.en: Hey, orb-dweller.\n\nWe've got some news for your kind.

entries.zh: 纳马里安人，请表明身份。
entries.en: Identify yourself, Namarian.

entries.zh: 我们的身份并无特殊之处。我们是逐浪者舰队中的热心人士。
entries.en: We're no one special. A concerned party among the Pursuing Waters fleet, one might call us.

entries.zh: 说说吧。
entries.en: Out with it.

entries.zh: 你们最近是不是买来了§Y5艘§!我们新制造的舰船，对吧？速度快而且装配着有大口径的武器？\n\n事情是这样的，尽管你们不是……啊算了，我还是老实告诉你们吧。为了维护这片区域的稳定，和我们定下这笔舰船交易的国家可不止你们。你们的邻居，§H[other_empire.GetName]§!同样也和逐浪者舰队谈成了买卖。
entries.en: You've recently purchased §Y5§! of the fleet's newly crafted vessels, correct? Swift of speed, with large weapons?\n\nHere's the thing, though, you weren't... ah, given the full story. In the interest of preserving regional stability, your people were not the only one offered this deal. Your neighbors, the §H[other_empire.GetName]§! have also parleyed with the Pursuing Waters.

entries.zh: 所以呢？
entries.en: So?

entries.zh: 有话直说。
entries.en: Get to the point.

entries.zh: 他们谈下了一笔差不多的买卖，又有§Y5艘§!舰船即将被送往[other_empire.GetAdj]的首都[other_empire.Capital.GetName]。但我们并不希望舰队里的这些船最后是为[other_empire.GetName]效力，所以现在想要请你们帮帮忙。
entries.en: They accepted a similar offer, and §Y5§! additional craft are set to be shipped to the [other_empire.GetAdj] oasis of [other_empire.Capital.GetName]. We would rather the fleet's ships do not end up in service of the [other_empire.GetName], and we would like your help.

entries.zh: 为什么告诉我们这个？
entries.en: Why tell us this?

entries.zh: 我们不相信[other_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，与我们之前遇到的其他的帝国不同，他们到现在都没有付款，我们怀疑他们在试图拖延付款时间直到舰船送达到他们的首都，然后再拒绝付款。因为他们意识到了我们的舰队领导非常急切的渴望离开这片星域……
entries.en: We do not trust the [other_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural], unlike the rest of the fleet. They have yet to pay, and we suspect they may try to stall until the vessels are delivered and then never send us payment. They realize the fleet leaders are very eager to move on...

entries.zh: 那你们打算怎么做？
entries.en: How would you accomplish this?

entries.zh: 我们有进入商队船坞自动驾驶设置的权限。只要命令所有舰队在[Root.Capital.GetName]集结，禁止理应交付的那一半飞船发往[other_empire.Capital.GetName]的[other_empire.GetAdj]天体即可。我们不会被逮到的。
entries.en: We have privileged access to the autopilot configurations in the caravan's shipyards. Simply setting all vessels to rally at [Root.Capital.GetName] - and not sending half of them to the [other_empire.GetAdj] orb of [other_empire.Capital.GetName] - is trivial for us. We wouldn't even get caught.

entries.zh: 那你想要我们做什么？
entries.en: What do you want us to do?

entries.zh: 不感兴趣。
entries.en: Not interested.

entries.zh: 我们需要得到实际的利益。就算是能够确保得到£energy£§Y1000§!也比[other_empire.GetAdj]天体居民的承诺靠谱。
entries.en: We would need something to show for it. Even £energy£ §Y1000§! would be more than whatever the fleet would get out of the [other_empire.GetAdj] orb-dwellers.

entries.zh: 成交。
entries.en: Deal.

entries.zh: 没门。
entries.en: No deal.

entries.zh: 我们付不起。
entries.en: We cannot afford that.

entries.zh: 愿荫凉庇佑你们，[Root.GetRulerName]。舰船会如约到达目的地——一艘不少。祝顺利。
entries.en: Shade upon you, [Root.GetRulerName]. The ships will arrive at the appointed time - all of them. Fair winds.

entries.zh: 结束传输。
entries.en: End transmission.

entries.zh: 真是太不幸了。\n\n愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，天体居民。
entries.en: That is unfortunate.\n\nCold days and warm nights to you, orb-dweller.

entries.zh: 炎热而干旱。那真是不幸。我们原以为[Root.GetName]能够成为我们飞船最好的避风港。
entries.en: Heat and drought. That is unfortunate, we think the [Root.GetName] would have made a fine harbor for our vessels.

entries.zh: 结束传输。
entries.en: End transmission.

entries.zh:
我们理解。

天体居民，希望将来我们中的任何一方都不会对这个决定感到后悔。

通讯结束。
entries.en:
We understand.

We hope neither of us comes to regret your decision, orb-dweller.

End transmission.

entries.zh: 再见。
entries.en: Goodbye.

entries.zh: 游牧飞船已交付
entries.en: Nomad Ships Delivered

entries.zh: 按照我们与逐浪者游牧舰队的协定，§Y5§!艘武装飞船已经运输到了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系，正停驻在我们首都的轨道上。
entries.en: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet, §Y5§! military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.

entries.zh: 按照我们与逐浪者游牧舰队以及其中的擅入者的合约——两支舰队总共§Y10§!艘武装飞船已经运输到了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系，正停驻在我们首都的轨道。
entries.en: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet - and the conscientious interloper in its midst - two fleets totaling §Y10§! military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.
